words.enDefinition: Keeping teaching and study going through a period of disruption

examples.en: The department explained how it would support academic continuity during repairs.
examples.zh: 院系说明了维修期间会怎样支持「学业持续开展」。

examples.en: The notice mentioned academic continuity alongside updates about the temporary rooms.
examples.zh: 通知在临时教室的动态旁提到了「学业持续开展」。

words.enDefinition: Room for changes in study arrangements to accommodate difficulties

examples.en: The adviser discussed academic flexibility after I explained the housing disruption.
examples.zh: 我说明住宿受到影响后，顾问谈到了「学业安排弹性」。

examples.en: The email described who would answer questions about academic flexibility.
examples.zh: 邮件说明了谁负责回答有关「学业安排弹性」的问题。

words.enDefinition: A notice indicating that entry into an area is limited

examples.en: The map showed "Access restricted" beside the path leading to the bridge.
examples.zh: 地图在通往大桥的小路旁显示「通行受限」。

examples.en: I checked which gate the notice marked "Access restricted" that morning.
examples.zh: 我查了当天早上通知把哪个门标为「通行受限」。

words.enDefinition: a road that provides a way into a particular property or site

examples.en: The staff member waited at the start of the access road beside the sports field.
examples.zh: 工作人员在运动场旁的「进出通道」入口等候。

examples.en: A barrier on the access road prevented vehicles from reaching the rear entrance.
examples.zh: 「进出通道」上的路障挡住了车辆，后门开不过去。

words.enDefinition: An emergency exit route designed to be usable by people with accessibility needs.

examples.en: The accessibility map showed an accessible evacuation route starting at the back of the auditorium.
examples.zh: 无障碍地图上标出了一条从礼堂后部开始的「无障碍疏散路线」。

examples.en: Our group asked whether the accessible evacuation route had changed after the lobby was renovated.
examples.zh: 我们小组询问，大厅翻新后「无障碍疏散路线」是否变了。

collocations: an accessible evacuation route on a floor plan

words.enDefinition: an emergency call that was placed unintentionally

examples.en: The call handler logged it as an accidental emergency call after speaking to me.
examples.zh: 接线员与我通话后，将其记录为一次「误拨紧急电话」。

examples.en: Staff discussed what an accidental emergency call looked like during the orientation session.
examples.zh: 迎新会上，工作人员解释了什么情况属于「误拨紧急电话」。

collocations: respond to an accidental emergency call

words.enDefinition: A record confirming payment for a place to stay

examples.en: I found the accommodation receipt in the hotel's confirmation message.
examples.zh: 我在酒店的确认消息里找到了「住宿收据」。

examples.en: The adviser asked which nights the accommodation receipt covered that week.
examples.zh: 顾问问「住宿收据」涵盖那周哪几晚。

collocations: a copy of the accommodation receipt

words.enDefinition: a status saying the user can use their account again

examples.en: The help desk marked the request account access restored after I confirmed I could sign in.
examples.zh: 我确认能登录后，技术服务台把申请标为「账号访问已恢复」。

examples.en: I received an account access restored message from the university's support team that evening.
examples.zh: 那天晚上，我收到学校支持团队发来的「账号访问已恢复」消息。

collocations: mark a ticket account access restored

words.enDefinition: To verify where everyone in a group is after an evacuation or other event.

examples.en: The hall staff compared two lists to account for everyone after the practice evacuation.
examples.zh: 疏散练习结束后，宿舍工作人员对照两份名单「确认了每个人的去向」。

examples.en: Our supervisor wanted to account for everyone before the exercise was officially declared over.
examples.zh: 在演习正式宣布结束前，我们的主管想「确认每个人的去向」。

collocations: make sure you can account for everyone
account for everyone on the list
account for everyone after the drill

words.enDefinition: the process of regaining access to an account you cannot currently use

examples.en: I contacted the campus help desk about account recovery after losing my old phone.
examples.zh: 旧手机遗失后，我联系了校园技术服务台咨询「账号找回」。

examples.en: The website showed the expected waiting time for account recovery under my case reference.
examples.zh: 网站在我的工单编号下显示了「账号找回」预计需要的等待时间。

words.enDefinition: on the other side of the street from a place

examples.en: We're waiting across the street from the residence hall, beside the bus shelter.
examples.zh: 我们在「宿舍楼的街对面」等，就在公交候车亭旁。

examples.en: The pharmacy across the street from campus has a bright sign above its entrance.
examples.zh: 「校园街对面」的药店入口上方有一块很亮的招牌。

words.enDefinition: an urgent incident that is still happening and requires a response

examples.en: The receptionist asked whether it was an active emergency or something from earlier.
examples.zh: 前台人员问，这是「仍在发生的紧急情况」，还是之前发生的事。

examples.en: The dispatcher received a new call about the same active emergency outside campus.
examples.zh: 调度员又接到一通电话，报告校外同一起「仍在发生的紧急情况」。

words.enDefinition: the insurance value of property in its pre-loss condition, taking account of age and wear

examples.en: The insurer estimated the actual cash value of my desk after checking its age.
examples.zh: 保险公司核对书桌的使用年限后，估算了它的「实际现金价值」。

examples.en: The statement showed the actual cash value beside the cost of a new laptop.
examples.zh: 结算单把「实际现金价值」与购买一台新笔记本电脑的费用并排列出。

collocations: a payment based on actual cash value

words.expression: add information to a police report
words.lemma: add information to a police report
words.zhGloss: 给警方事件记录补充信息
words.enDefinition: to provide additional details about an incident that has already been reported to police
acceptedZhAnswers: 给警方事件记录补充信息
acceptedEnVariants: add information to a police report

examples.en: I called to add information to a police report after finding my original receipt.
examples.zh: 找到原始收据后，我打电话「给警方事件记录补充信息」。

examples.en: The officer told me whom to contact to add information to a police report.
examples.zh: 警员告诉我，要「给警方事件记录补充信息」可以联系谁。

collocations: call to add information to a police report
ask to add information to a police report
form to add information to a police report

words.enDefinition: Extra costs of living away from an unusable insured home

examples.en: The statement had a separate section for additional living expenses.
examples.zh: 那份说明专设一节，列出了「额外生活开支」。

examples.en: I asked which documents related to additional living expenses while staying elsewhere.
examples.zh: 我问哪些文件与借住他处期间的「额外生活开支」有关。

collocations: a list of additional living expenses

words.enDefinition: a small wound cover with self-sticking edges

examples.en: I spotted a wrapped adhesive bandage in the kit by the reception desk.
examples.zh: 我看见接待台旁的急救包里有一片没拆封的「创可贴」。

examples.en: A student volunteer asked whether there was an adhesive bandage in the drawer.
examples.zh: 一名学生志愿者问抽屉里还有没有「创可贴」。

words.enDefinition: A report describing an adjuster's findings about an insurance loss

examples.en: I checked whether the adjuster's report described both of the rooms.
examples.zh: 我核对了「理赔查勘报告」是否描述了两个房间。

examples.en: The insurer said one photo was attached to the adjuster's report.
examples.zh: 保险公司说，有一张照片附在「理赔查勘报告」之后。

words.enDefinition: A place experiencing a weather hazard or a service interruption

examples.en: The provider added our street to the affected area on its map.
examples.zh: 服务商在地图上把我们这条街加入了「受影响区域」。

examples.en: The notice gave separate information for each affected area near campus.
examples.zh: 通知分别列出了学校附近各个「受影响区域」的情况。

words.enDefinition: A description of an alarm starting to sound or signal.

examples.en: The classroom falls quiet whenever the alarm goes off during the monthly equipment test.
examples.zh: 每月设备测试中一「响起警报」，教室里就立刻安静下来。

examples.en: I was signing in at reception when the alarm went off for the scheduled test.
examples.zh: 我正在接待处签到，这时例行测试的「警报响了」。

collocations: the alarm went off during class

words.enDefinition: A device that sounds a loud warning when an alarm is active.

examples.en: The alarm horn was audible in the courtyard during the evening test at the library.
examples.zh: 傍晚图书馆做测试时，庭院里能听见「报警喇叭」。

examples.en: The facilities team put the alarm horn and the warning lights on separate inspection lists.
examples.zh: 设施管理团队将「报警喇叭」和警示灯分别列在两张检查清单上。

words.enDefinition: A planned check of whether an alarm system functions.

examples.en: The day of the alarm test was listed on the noticeboard beside our mailboxes.
examples.zh: 「警报测试」的日期写在我们信箱旁的告示板上。

examples.en: My supervisor moved our meeting because an alarm test was scheduled for the same time.
examples.zh: 由于同时安排了「警报测试」，导师改了我们的会议时间。

words.enDefinition: A sign warning that using a particular door or device will cause an alarm.

examples.en: The door had a small label reading “Alarm will sound” just below the handle.
examples.zh: 那扇门把手正下方贴有一张小标签，上面写着「将触发警报」。

examples.en: I noticed “Alarm will sound” printed under the exit symbol on the workshop door.
examples.zh: 我发现工作室门上的出口图标下方印着「将触发警报」。

collocations: a label reading alarm will sound
an alarm will sound when opened

words.enDefinition: awake, aware and able to speak with someone

examples.en: He was alert and talking when the receptionist came over a moment later.
examples.zh: 过了一会儿，接待员走过来时，他「清醒着，还在说话」。

examples.en: I told the organiser she was alert and talking when I left the room.
examples.zh: 我告诉组织者，我离开房间时，她「清醒着，能说话」。

words.enDefinition: A prominent strip on a website or screen that displays a warning.

examples.en: An alert banner appeared above the library hours on the university website this morning.
examples.zh: 今天早上，大学网站上图书馆开放时间的上方出现了「警报横幅」。

examples.en: The alert banner was still visible when I opened the page on my phone.
examples.zh: 我用手机打开页面时，仍然能看到「警报横幅」。

words.enDefinition: The process of getting a warning message to the intended devices or people.

examples.en: The test helped staff notice a delay in alert delivery to some campus email accounts.
examples.zh: 这次测试让工作人员发现，向部分校园邮箱「投递警报」有延迟。

examples.en: The survey about alert delivery asked which device showed the notice first that morning.
examples.zh: 「警报投递」调查询问了那天早上哪台设备最先显示通知。

words.enDefinition: Settings that describe how someone wants to receive alerts, when choices are available.

examples.en: I checked my alert preferences after realizing the university still had my previous phone number.
examples.zh: 发现学校还存着我的旧号码后，我检查了自己的「警报接收偏好」。

examples.en: The orientation slideshow showed where to find alert preferences on the campus safety website.
examples.zh: 新生说明会的幻灯片展示了在校园安全网站的哪里可以找到「警报接收偏好」。

words.enDefinition: A person included in the group that receives a warning from a notification system.

examples.en: The alert recipients included staff from the library as well as students living on campus.
examples.zh: 「警报接收人」包括图书馆工作人员和住校学生。

examples.en: Each alert recipient got the same test message, regardless of their department or year group.
examples.zh: 无论院系或年级，每名「警报接收人」都收到了相同的测试消息。

words.enDefinition: A distinctive sound used to draw attention to an alert.

examples.en: The alert tone was distinct enough that I noticed it through the noise outside.
examples.zh: 「警报提示音」很特别，即使外面很吵我也听见了。

examples.en: We heard the alert tone just before a recorded announcement explained the system test.
examples.zh: 录音广播说明这次系统测试之前，我们听到了「警报提示音」。

words.enDefinition: An official signal that an emergency or its restrictions have ended.

examples.en: The library stayed closed until staff received the all clear from campus safety that afternoon.
examples.zh: 那天下午，图书馆一直关闭，直到工作人员收到校园安全部门的「警报解除通知」。

examples.en: Our group saw the all clear on the campus website before the text message arrived.
examples.zh: 短信还没到，我们小组就在校园网站上看到了「警报解除通知」。

words.enDefinition: Another place to stay when the original accommodation is unavailable

examples.en: The residence team offered alternative accommodation while the flat was being repaired.
examples.zh: 公寓维修期间，住宿团队提供了「替代住宿」。

examples.en: I checked how the notice described our alternative accommodation for that weekend.
examples.zh: 我核对了通知是怎样介绍我们那个周末的「替代住宿」的。

words.enDefinition: Another exit that can be used if the usual exit is unavailable.

examples.en: The floor plan showed an alternative exit next to the lockers near the rear entrance.
examples.zh: 楼层图显示，后门附近的储物柜旁有一个「备用出口」。

examples.en: The guide circled an alternative exit on the map during our tour of the theater.
examples.zh: 参观剧院时，向导在地图上圈出了一个「备用出口」。

collocations: an alternative exit from the hall

words.enDefinition: A substitute water source provided during an interruption

examples.en: The council bulletin described an alternative water supply for the district.
examples.zh: 市议会在公报中介绍了该地区的「临时替代供水」。

examples.en: I checked which location the notice listed for the alternative water supply.
examples.zh: 我查了通知上列出的「临时替代供水」地点。

collocations: details of an alternative water supply
a notice about an alternative water supply

words.enDefinition: A UK weather alert indicating increased risk of serious impacts

examples.en: The college mentioned an amber weather warning when postponing our field visit.
examples.zh: 学院推迟实地考察时，提到了「琥珀色天气警告」。

examples.en: The UK forecast put the amber weather warning beside a map of expected impacts.
examples.zh: 英国预报把「琥珀色天气警告」放在预计影响地图旁边。

collocations: an amber weather warning is in force
an amber weather warning for strong winds

words.enDefinition: a hospital entrance set aside for arriving ambulances

examples.en: Our bus stopped across the road from the ambulance entrance at the hospital.
examples.zh: 我们乘坐的公交车停在医院「救护车专用入口」对面。

examples.en: The security guard pointed us toward a public door beyond the ambulance entrance.
examples.zh: 安保人员为我们指出了「救护车专用入口」那头的一扇公众入口。

words.enDefinition: an organization that sends ambulances and provides emergency medical transport

examples.en: The ambulance service asked the caretaker to identify the closest accessible entrance.
examples.zh: 「救护车服务机构」请管理员指出最近的无障碍入口。

examples.en: The student newspaper interviewed the local ambulance service about its work on campus.
examples.zh: 学生报采访了当地的「救护车服务机构」，了解他们在校园的工作。

words.enDefinition: A report changed after the original account was recorded

examples.en: I checked what had changed in the amended incident report I received.
examples.zh: 我查看了收到的「修订后的事故报告」里改了什么。

examples.en: The office kept the amended incident report alongside the earlier written version.
examples.zh: 办公室把「修订后的事故报告」和较早的版本放在一起保存。

words.enDefinition: The sum of money someone requests in an insurance claim

examples.en: I checked the amount claimed against the repair estimate I submitted.
examples.zh: 我把「申请赔付金额」与我提交的维修费用估算核对了一下。

examples.en: The amount claimed appeared separately from the insurer's own estimate.
examples.zh: 「申请赔付金额」与保险公司自己的估算分开列出。

words.enDefinition: to pick up a call made in response to an earlier call

examples.en: I stepped away from the entrance to answer a callback from the campus office.
examples.zh: 我走到离入口远一点的地方，「接听校园办公室回拨的电话」。

examples.en: She kept her phone nearby so she could answer a callback from the control room.
examples.zh: 她把手机放在身边，以便「接听控制室回拨的电话」。

collocations: be ready to answer a callback
step outside to answer a callback

words.enDefinition: A repair business an insurer has accepted for a claim

examples.en: The Australian insurer named an approved repairer in the message.
examples.zh: 澳大利亚保险公司在消息里列出了一家「认可的维修商」。

examples.en: I asked who the approved repairer would contact about our flat.
examples.zh: 我问「认可的维修商」会联系谁谈我们公寓的情况。

words.enDefinition: an estimate of when a possession or document went missing

examples.en: I checked the café receipt before estimating the approximate time of loss for my bag.
examples.zh: 我先看了咖啡馆的收据，才估算包的「大致遗失时间」。

examples.en: The attendant entered my approximate time of loss as early on Friday evening.
examples.zh: 工作人员输入的「大致遗失时间」是周五傍晚。

collocations: give an approximate time of loss
record the approximate time of loss
ask for the approximate time of loss

words.enDefinition: a question asking whether another part of the body is injured

examples.en: “Are you hurt anywhere else?” the first aider asked after hearing about my arm.
examples.zh: 听我说完胳膊的情况后，急救员问「还有别的地方受伤吗？」

examples.en: My teammate asked, “Are you hurt anywhere else?” when I pointed to my knee.
examples.zh: 我指了指膝盖，队友问「还有别的地方受伤吗？」

collocations: “Are you hurt anywhere else besides your arm?”
“Before we talk to staff, are you hurt anywhere else?”

words.enDefinition: A designated protected space where someone can wait for evacuation assistance.

examples.en: The floor map marked an area of refuge near the stairwell on each upper level.
examples.zh: 楼层图标出了楼上每层楼梯间附近的「避难等候区」。

examples.en: Our tour guide paused outside the area of refuge to explain what the sign meant.
examples.zh: 向导在「避难等候区」外停下来讲解标志的含义。

collocations: signs for the area of refuge

words.enDefinition: to seek permission before making physical contact

examples.en: I asked the volunteer to ask before touching me or my wheelchair.
examples.zh: 我请志愿者在「碰我或我的轮椅前先问一声」。

examples.en: The accessibility guide asked staff to ask before touching a visitor's mobility equipment.
examples.zh: 无障碍指南要求工作人员「碰访客的助行设备前先问一声」。

words.enDefinition: A designated location where people gather after leaving a building in an emergency.

examples.en: The assembly point for this wing was marked on the map beside the studio door.
examples.zh: 工作室门旁的地图标出了这片楼区的「疏散集合点」。

examples.en: The guide pointed out the assembly point as we walked past the open sports field.
examples.zh: 路过露天运动场时，向导指给我们看「疏散集合点」。

collocations: a sign for the assembly point

words.enDefinition: a phrase saying that people who will provide help are travelling to the scene

examples.en: She said assistance is on the way before asking me about the building entrance.
examples.zh: 她先说「救援人员已经在路上」，然后问我楼的入口在哪里。

examples.en: The update said assistance is on the way from the nearest available campus team.
examples.zh: 最新消息说，最近的一支可用校园「救援队已经在路上」。

collocations: confirm assistance is on the way
you can tell them assistance is on the way
assistance is already on the way

words.enDefinition: An evacuation in which a person receives help to leave safely.

examples.en: The drill report recorded how long the assisted evacuation took in the older residence hall.
examples.zh: 演练报告记录了旧宿舍楼内「有人协助的疏散」用了多长时间。

examples.en: The floor warden checked that staff were available for an assisted evacuation that evening.
examples.zh: 楼层安全负责人确认，当晚有工作人员可以配合「有人协助的疏散」。

collocations: an assisted evacuation during a drill

words.enDefinition: at the end of something that is furthest away

examples.en: The door is at the far end of the corridor, past the toilets.
examples.zh: 那扇门在「走廊的另一端尽头」，要走过洗手间。

examples.en: I saw a staff member waiting at the far end of the covered walkway.
examples.zh: 我看见一名工作人员在「有顶走道的另一端尽头」等着。

collocations: at the far end of the corridor
at the far end of the hall
at the far end of the platform

words.enDefinition: where two or more roads or paths meet

examples.en: We waited at the junction of Park Road and the university service road.
examples.zh: 我们等候的地点是「公园路和大学后勤通道的交会处」。

examples.en: A member of staff stood at the junction of the footpath and the driveway.
examples.zh: 一名工作人员站在「步道和车道的交会处」。

collocations: at the junction of two roads
at the junction of two paths
at the junction of the road and the driveway

words.enDefinition: A warning delivered as a sound that people can hear.

examples.en: The inspection form had a separate line for the audible warning and the flashing lights.
examples.zh: 检查表对「声音警报」和闪灯分别列了一项。

examples.en: The audible warning carried into the seminar room even though the door was already closed.
examples.zh: 虽然研讨室的门已经关上，「声音警报」仍然传了进去。

collocations: an audible warning in the corridor

words.enDefinition: a person given permission to pick something up for its owner

examples.en: My roommate was listed as the authorized collector when the office scheduled the pickup.
examples.zh: 办事处安排领取时间时，将我的室友列为「获准代领人」。

examples.en: The authorized collector signed for the bag and received a copy of the receipt.
examples.zh: 「获准代领人」签收了包，并拿到一份凭条副本。

words.enDefinition: a portable device that analyses heart rhythm and can deliver a shock

examples.en: The sports hall has an automated external defibrillator in a clearly marked cabinet.
examples.zh: 体育馆有一台「自动体外除颤器」，放在有清楚标识的柜子里。

examples.en: Our campus tour guide showed us where the automated external defibrillator was kept.
examples.zh: 校园参观时，向导给我们指了「自动体外除颤器」放在哪里。

collocations: a publicly accessible automated external defibrillator

words.enDefinition: A status indicating the adjuster's report has not been received

examples.en: The insurer said the file was awaiting the adjuster's report that week.
examples.zh: 保险公司说，那一周案卷处于「等待理赔查勘报告」的状态。

examples.en: I checked why the page said awaiting the adjuster's report for that item.
examples.zh: 我核对了网页为什么把那件物品标为「等待理赔查勘报告」。

collocations: a file awaiting the adjuster's report
a claim awaiting the adjuster's report
an update saying awaiting the adjuster's report

words.enDefinition: the rear part of the head above the neck

examples.en: My classmate said the back of the head hit the wall first.
examples.zh: 我同学说，那个人先是「后脑勺」撞到了墙。

examples.en: The student pointed to the back of the head when describing the impact.
examples.zh: 描述撞击时，那名学生指了指自己的「后脑勺」。

collocations: the back of the head struck the floor
a bump to the back of the head
point to the back of the head

words.enDefinition: An alternative electricity supply used during a loss of regular power

examples.en: The library said its lights were running on backup power.
examples.zh: 图书馆说，照明正在用「备用电源」供电。

examples.en: The building notice explained which facilities had backup power that morning.
examples.zh: 大楼的通知说明了当天早上哪些设施有「备用电源」。

words.enDefinition: Assistance with essential living needs such as food or housing

examples.en: The university described basic needs support in a leaflet for affected residents.
examples.zh: 大学在发给受影响居民的说明单里介绍了「基本生活需求援助」。

examples.en: I checked who was handling basic needs support during the repairs.
examples.zh: 我核对了维修期间谁在负责「基本生活需求援助」。

words.enDefinition: to have one's call connected to another person or department

examples.en: I asked to be put through to the duty officer at the residence hall.
examples.zh: 我请对方把电话「转接到」宿舍楼的值班人员那里。

examples.en: I expected to be put through to the campus desk after the announcement.
examples.zh: 我以为听完语音提示后会「被转接到」校园值班台。

collocations: be put through to an operator

words.enDefinition: at a position lower than the surface of the ground

examples.en: The storage area is below ground, directly under the university's large lecture theatre.
examples.zh: 储藏区「在地面以下」，位于学校大阶梯教室正下方。

examples.en: Our phone signal got weaker once we went below ground in the station.
examples.zh: 我们在车站走到「地面以下」后，手机信号变弱了。

words.enDefinition: Too costly to repair relative to the item's value

examples.en: The assessor described the damaged furniture as beyond economical repair in writing.
examples.zh: 评估人员在书面记录中把受损家具描述为「维修成本已不划算」。

examples.en: I saw beyond economical repair beside the desk on the summary.
examples.zh: 我在概要中的书桌一栏旁看到「维修成本已不划算」。

words.enDefinition: the act or occurrence of taking someone else's bicycle without permission

examples.en: The student emailed campus security about a bike theft near the back entrance.
examples.zh: 那名学生给校园安保部门发邮件，反映后门附近的「自行车失窃」事件。

examples.en: The safety office counted each reported bike theft in its monthly summary for residents.
examples.zh: 安保部门在给住户的月报中统计了每起被报告的「自行车失窃」。

words.enDefinition: A thin, hard-to-see layer of ice on paved surfaces

examples.en: The local road notice mentioned black ice on the bridge.
examples.zh: 本地道路通知提到桥面上有「路面透明薄冰」。

examples.en: Our campus map marked a path affected by black ice.
examples.zh: 校园地图标出了一条受「路面透明薄冰」影响的小路。

words.enDefinition: to soak through a covering such as a dressing or clothing

examples.en: I saw the wound bleed through his sleeve and told a member of staff.
examples.zh: 我看见血「渗透到衣袖外面」，就告诉了工作人员。

examples.en: I told the first aider I had seen the cut bleed through the bandage.
examples.zh: 我告诉急救员，我看见伤口的血「渗透到绷带外面」了。

words.enDefinition: A US alert for expected or ongoing blizzard conditions

examples.en: The blizzard warning gave details about poor visibility on nearby roads.
examples.zh: 「暴风雪警告」说明了附近道路能见度较差的情况。

examples.en: The university cited a blizzard warning in its class cancellation notice.
examples.zh: 学校在停课通知中提到了一条「暴风雪警告」。

collocations: an area under a blizzard warning

words.enDefinition: to prevent a subscriber identity card from connecting to a mobile network

examples.en: The provider confirmed it could block a SIM card without cancelling my phone number.
examples.zh: 运营商确认，可以在不注销我手机号码的情况下「停用SIM卡」。

examples.en: The adviser explained why it might take a moment to block a SIM card.
examples.zh: 顾问说明了为何「停用SIM卡」可能需要一点时间。

collocations: ask a carrier to block a SIM card
request to block a SIM card

words.enDefinition: An exit that cannot be used freely because something is in the way.

examples.en: The residence staff moved the boxes after a student reported a blocked exit upstairs.
examples.zh: 一名学生报告楼上有个「被堵塞的出口」后，宿舍工作人员搬走了箱子。

examples.en: There was a photo of a blocked exit on the facilities team's safety checklist.
examples.zh: 设施管理团队的安全检查清单上有一张「被堵塞的出口」的照片。

collocations: a complaint about a blocked exit

words.enDefinition: an outdoor emergency telephone marked by a visible blue light

examples.en: A blue-light emergency phone stood near the bus stop beside the science building.
examples.zh: 科学楼旁的公交站附近设有一部「蓝灯紧急求助电话」。

examples.en: The campus map shows a blue-light emergency phone at each end of the walkway.
examples.zh: 校园地图显示，步道两端各有一部「蓝灯紧急求助电话」。

words.enDefinition: An official notice that drinking water requires boiling before use

examples.en: The utility posted a boil water advisory on its official website.
examples.zh: 供水机构在其官网发布了「饮用水煮沸通告」。

examples.en: I checked which district the boil water advisory referred to in the notice.
examples.zh: 我核对了通知中的「饮用水煮沸通告」指的是哪个区。

collocations: an area under a boil water advisory

words.enDefinition: A temporary stopping of access to a bridge

examples.en: The bus operator displayed the bridge closure beside its route map.
examples.zh: 公交运营方在路线图旁显示了「大桥封闭」信息。

examples.en: The council marked the bridge closure on both sides of the river.
examples.zh: 市议会在河两岸标出了「大桥封闭」的位置。

collocations: a notice about a bridge closure

words.enDefinition: A period in which a building is closed to some or all of its usual users.

examples.en: The building closure affected two lectures and the language exchange meeting in the afternoon.
examples.zh: 「楼宇关闭」影响了下午的两节讲座和一场语言交流活动。

examples.en: The university posted a note about the building closure beside the regular opening hours.
examples.zh: 大学把「楼宇关闭」的通知贴在常规开放时间旁。

collocations: a notice about a building closure

words.enDefinition: a list or sign showing where rooms or organizations are located inside a building

examples.en: The building directory showed a second entrance on the side facing the library.
examples.zh: 「楼内导览牌」显示，朝向图书馆的那一侧还有一个入口。

examples.en: I checked the building directory before telling the operator which floor we were on.
examples.zh: 我先看了「楼内导览牌」，才告诉接线员我们在哪一层。

words.enDefinition: People who are inside a building at a given time.

examples.en: The notice informed building occupants that the scheduled alarm test had been moved to Friday.
examples.zh: 告示通知「楼内人员」，原定的警报测试已改到星期五。

examples.en: The exercise form asked how many building occupants had reached the assembly point by noon.
examples.zh: 演习表询问，截至中午有多少「楼内人员」到达了集合点。

words.enDefinition: A systematic check of the spaces in a building during a drill or evacuation.

examples.en: The drill observer noted when the building sweep was complete on the evaluation form.
examples.zh: 演习观察员在评估表上记录了「楼内逐区检查」的完成时间。

examples.en: The staff briefing explained which teams were responsible for the building sweep during the exercise.
examples.zh: 工作人员简报解释了演习时哪些小组负责「楼内逐区检查」。

collocations: a building sweep during a drill
record the time of a building sweep

words.enDefinition: a raised area on the skin after an impact

examples.en: A small bump was visible above his eyebrow when he looked up.
examples.zh: 他抬头时，可以看到眉毛上面「撞起了一个小包」。

examples.en: She said the bump on her forehead appeared right after the fall.
examples.zh: 她说额头上的「包」是摔倒后立刻鼓起来的。

collocations: a small bump above the eyebrow
notice a bump after a fall

words.enDefinition: a visible mark left on the skin by a burn

examples.en: The student showed the lab supervisor a small burn mark on his forearm.
examples.zh: 那名学生给实验室主管看了前臂上的一小块「灼伤痕迹」。

examples.en: I noticed a burn mark when she rolled up the sleeve of her jacket.
examples.zh: 她卷起上衣袖子时，我看见了一处「灼伤痕迹」。

collocations: a burn mark on the wrist

words.enDefinition: someone who is present but not directly involved in an event

examples.en: A bystander outside the gym offered the caller a quieter place to speak.
examples.zh: 体育馆外的一名「现场旁观者」让来电者到一个较安静的地方说话。

examples.en: The officer took down the name of a bystander on the opposite pavement.
examples.zh: 警员记下了对面人行道上一名「现场旁观者」的姓名。

words.enDefinition: to ask for an ambulance by telephone

examples.en: The coach asked another student to call an ambulance from the sports hall.
examples.zh: 教练请另一名学生在体育馆「打电话叫救护车」。

examples.en: I could hear my flatmate call an ambulance from the next room.
examples.zh: 我听见室友在隔壁「打电话叫救护车」。

collocations: ask someone to call an ambulance
use a phone to call an ambulance

words.enDefinition: to ask additional personnel to come and help with an incident

examples.en: The supervisor told the officer to call for backup during the stadium training exercise.
examples.zh: 体育场训练演习期间，主管让警员「呼叫增援」。

examples.en: The campus officer used the radio to call for backup near the bus terminal.
examples.zh: 校园警员在公交总站附近通过无线电「呼叫增援」。

collocations: ask someone to call for backup

words.enDefinition: to telephone someone who can help with an urgent problem

examples.en: My phone had no signal, so I asked the receptionist to call for help.
examples.zh: 我的手机没有信号，就请前台工作人员「打电话求救」。

examples.en: The bus driver stopped by the entrance so a passenger could call for help.
examples.zh: 公交司机把车停在入口旁，好让一名乘客「打电话求救」。

collocations: use a phone to call for help
ask someone to call for help

words.enDefinition: a phrase meaning a telephone call connects to the intended recipient

examples.en: When the call goes through, you'll hear the front desk recording before anyone answers.
examples.zh: 「电话接通」后，会先听到前台的录音，再有人接听。

examples.en: He stays by the window until the call goes through to the duty officer.
examples.zh: 他一直待在窗边，直到电话「接通」值班人员。

collocations: wait until the call goes through
the call goes through to reception

words.enDefinition: a list recording calls made or received and their details

examples.en: The supervisor checked the call log for the time of the first report.
examples.zh: 主管在「通话记录」里查询第一次收到报告的时间。

examples.en: My phone's call log showed two missed calls from the residence office that evening.
examples.zh: 手机的「通话记录」显示，那天傍晚宿管办公室打来两次电话，我都没接到。

words.enDefinition: to ask someone to contact your roommate by phone

examples.en: Could you call my roommate and tell her I'm with the event staff?
examples.zh: 你能「打给我室友」，告诉她我和活动工作人员在一起吗？

examples.en: I asked the receptionist to call my roommate because my phone was upstairs.
examples.zh: 我手机落在楼上了，就请接待员「打给我室友」。

collocations: ask someone to call my roommate

words.enDefinition: a line of incoming calls waiting for available staff

examples.en: The front desk's call queue grew as families tried to reach the campus office.
examples.zh: 家属纷纷尝试联系校园办公室，前台的「来电等候队列」越来越长。

examples.en: A recorded message told callers their position in the call queue before answering.
examples.zh: 电话接通前，录音会告知来电者在「来电等候队列」中的位置。

words.enDefinition: an audio record of a conversation made over the phone

examples.en: The supervisor checked the call recording to confirm when the address was given.
examples.zh: 主管听了「通话录音」，确认对方是什么时候报出地址的。

examples.en: The call recording captured the operator reading the room number back to the caller.
examples.zh: 「通话录音」录下了接线员向来电者复述房间号的声音。

words.enDefinition: to telephone the fire service and ask it to attend

examples.en: Her neighbour stepped outside to call the fire brigade after seeing smoke upstairs.
examples.zh: 邻居看到楼上冒烟后走到外面「打电话叫消防队」。

examples.en: The cleaner asked the caretaker to call the fire brigade from the front desk.
examples.zh: 保洁员请管理员用前台的电话「打电话叫消防队」。

collocations: ask someone to call the fire brigade
use a mobile to call the fire brigade

words.enDefinition: to contact the police by telephone and request assistance

examples.en: The shop assistant offered to call the police while I waited by the till.
examples.zh: 我在收银台旁等着，店员主动提出「打电话报警」。

examples.en: The witness used the station phone to call the police after the crash.
examples.zh: 目击者在事故发生后用车站的电话「打电话报警」。

collocations: ask someone to call the police

words.enDefinition: a person who places a phone call

examples.en: The caller stayed near the bus shelter where reception was better that night.
examples.zh: 那晚公交候车亭附近信号更好，「来电者」就留在那里。

examples.en: A second caller gave the same street name but a different house number.
examples.zh: 第二位「来电者」报出的街名相同，但门牌号不同。

words.enDefinition: the place from which a person is making a call

examples.en: The map showed the caller location on the opposite side of the river.
examples.zh: 地图显示「来电者所在位置」在河对岸。

examples.en: The screen listed the caller location separately from the reported incident address downtown.
examples.zh: 屏幕分别列出了「来电者所在位置」和市中心的事发地址。

words.enDefinition: the university service that receives reports and coordinates campus safety responders

examples.en: I called campus dispatch to ask which office was handling the earlier report.
examples.zh: 我联系了「校园安保调度」，询问之前的报告由哪个办公室处理。

examples.en: The officer checked in with campus dispatch after meeting the caretaker outside the library.
examples.zh: 警员在图书馆外与管理员会合后，向「校园安保调度」报了情况。

words.enDefinition: The work of preparing for and coordinating an institution's response to emergencies on its campus.

examples.en: The notice named campus emergency management as the office responsible for the upcoming drill.
examples.zh: 告示注明，「校园应急管理」办公室负责即将举行的演习。

examples.en: A campus emergency management staff member helped our group understand the wording on the alert.
examples.zh: 一名「校园应急管理」工作人员帮我们小组理解了警报上的措辞。

words.enDefinition: An official notice with information about safety issues affecting a campus community.

examples.en: The campus safety bulletin explained where students would see announcements about the upcoming fire drill.
examples.zh: 「校园安全简报」说明了学生可以在哪里看到即将举行的消防演习通知。

examples.en: Each campus safety bulletin was dated so students could tell which one was current.
examples.zh: 每份「校园安全简报」都注明了日期，学生可以分辨哪份是最新的。

collocations: a campus safety bulletin about drills

words.enDefinition: a staff member who responds to campus safety concerns

examples.en: A campus safety officer met us outside the gym after the incident.
examples.zh: 事发后，一名「校园安全员」在体育馆外和我们会合。

examples.en: I told the campus safety officer that I had only heard the fall.
examples.zh: 我告诉「校园安全员」，我只听见了摔倒时的响声。

collocations: report something to a campus safety officer
the campus safety officer on duty

words.enDefinition: An outdoor device that produces a loud warning sound across part of a campus.

examples.en: We heard the campus siren from the bus stop during the scheduled test today.
examples.zh: 在今天的例行测试中，我们在公交站听见了「校园警报器」。

examples.en: The notice explained which hours the campus siren might be audible near residence halls.
examples.zh: 通知说明了宿舍楼附近在哪些时段可能听见「校园警报器」。

words.enDefinition: A warning intended for the entire campus community, across departments or buildings.

examples.en: The campus-wide alert appeared on screens in the gym and both of the student centers.
examples.zh: 「全校警报」显示在体育馆和两个学生中心的屏幕上。

examples.en: The campus-wide alert reached my roommate even though she was studying off campus that morning.
examples.zh: 虽然室友那天上午在校外学习，她也收到了「全校警报」。

words.enDefinition: a question asking permission to sit in a particular place

examples.en: “Can I sit here?” I asked when the staff member came over.
examples.zh: 工作人员走过来时，我问「我能坐这儿吗？」

examples.en: She pointed to the chair by the door and asked, “Can I sit here?”
examples.zh: 她指着门边的椅子问「我能坐这儿吗？」

collocations: “Can I sit here for a minute?”
“Can I sit here while I wait?”

words.enDefinition: a request to express one's own account or preferences directly

examples.en: “Can I speak for myself?” she asked before her friend answered again.
examples.zh: 朋友又要替她回答时，她问「我可以自己说吗？」

examples.en: I wanted to explain what I needed, so I asked, “Can I speak for myself?”
examples.zh: 我想亲口说自己需要什么，于是问「我可以自己说吗？」

collocations: “Can I speak for myself this time?”
“Can I speak for myself for a moment?”

words.enDefinition: unable to lift the eyelids of one eye

examples.en: I can't open one eye since I got something in it outside.
examples.zh: 我在外面眼里进了东西，现在「一只眼睛睁不开」。

examples.en: My roommate said, “I can't open one eye,” when I asked what was wrong.
examples.zh: 我问室友怎么了，对方说「我一只眼睛睁不开」。

collocations: say you can't open one eye

words.zhGloss: 能去安静一点的地方说吗
words.enDefinition: a request to move a conversation somewhere with less noise
acceptedZhAnswers: 能去安静一点的地方说吗

examples.en: “Can we talk somewhere quieter?” I asked as the crowd grew louder.
examples.zh: 人群越来越吵，我问「能去安静一点的地方说吗？」

examples.en: She looked towards the side room and asked, “Can we talk somewhere quieter?”
examples.zh: 她朝旁边那间屋看了一眼，问「能去安静一点的地方说吗？」

collocations: “Can we talk somewhere quieter for a minute?”
“Can we talk somewhere quieter than this?”

words.enDefinition: a question checking whether someone can hear you speak

examples.en: “Can you hear me?” the instructor asked when the student looked up.
examples.zh: 学生抬头时，老师问「你听得见我吗？」

examples.en: A volunteer crouched nearby and quietly asked, “Can you hear me?”
examples.zh: 一名志愿者在旁边蹲下，轻声问「你听得见我吗？」

words.expression: can you tell me what happened
words.lemma: can you tell me what happened
words.enDefinition: a polite request for the other person to describe what occurred
acceptedEnVariants: can you tell me what happened

examples.en: “Can you tell me what happened?” the officer asked the student by the door.
examples.zh: 安全员问门边的学生「能说说发生了什么吗？」

examples.en: The coach sat beside me and asked, “Can you tell me what happened?”
examples.zh: 教练坐到我旁边，问「能说说发生了什么吗？」

collocations: ask “Can you tell me what happened?”
“Can you tell me what happened first?”
“Can you tell me what happened next?”

words.enDefinition: to make a card stop working for entry to secured areas

examples.en: The residence office offered to cancel an access card after reviewing my report.
examples.zh: 宿管办公室审阅报告后，提出可以「注销门禁卡」。

examples.en: The desk asked which building I meant before agreeing to cancel an access card.
examples.zh: 服务台先问我说的是哪栋楼，才同意「注销门禁卡」。

collocations: ask staff to cancel an access card
report a loss and cancel an access card

words.enDefinition: A device that warns people when it detects a dangerous amount of carbon monoxide.

examples.en: The residence checklist listed a carbon monoxide alarm in the corridor near the boiler room.
examples.zh: 宿舍检查清单列出了锅炉房附近走廊里的「一氧化碳报警器」。

examples.en: The housing office confirmed a carbon monoxide alarm had been checked during the previous inspection.
examples.zh: 宿舍管理处确认，上次检查时已经查验过「一氧化碳报警器」。

collocations: a carbon monoxide alarm in the hallway

words.enDefinition: permanently making an existing card unusable for future transactions

examples.en: The bank recorded the date of card cancellation in its message to me.
examples.zh: 银行在发给我的消息中记录了「银行卡注销」日期。

examples.en: I checked whether my new card was due to arrive after the card cancellation.
examples.zh: 我查看了新卡是否会在「银行卡注销」后送到。

words.enDefinition: a message confirming a card issuer has recorded a reported loss

examples.en: I saved the card loss confirmation with the reference number from the bank.
examples.zh: 我把「银行卡挂失确认」和银行给的编号一起保存。

examples.en: The card loss confirmation showed the date I first contacted the bank about it.
examples.zh: 「银行卡挂失确认」上写着我最初联系银行报告这件事的日期。

words.enDefinition: the part of a road used by vehicles, sometimes for one direction only

examples.en: The wrecked bicycle lay on the edge of the carriageway beside the bus stop.
examples.zh: 损坏的自行车倒在公交站旁「公路行车路面」的边缘。

examples.en: The police closed one carriageway while officers spoke to the drivers involved.
examples.zh: 警方暂时封闭了一侧「行车路面」，警员向涉事司机了解情况。

words.enDefinition: Money paid back by a transport company after a disruption

examples.en: The insurer listed the carrier reimbursement separately from its own payment.
examples.zh: 保险公司把「承运方退还的费用」和自己的赔付分开列出。

examples.en: I checked which expenses the carrier reimbursement covered on my statement.
examples.zh: 我核对了账单，确认「承运方退还的费用」对应哪些开支。

words.enDefinition: A claim resolution through payment rather than arranging work or replacement

examples.en: The insurer explained what the proposed cash settlement would cover.
examples.zh: 保险公司解释了拟议的「现金赔付结算」涵盖什么。

examples.en: I checked which amount the letter called the cash settlement.
examples.zh: 我核对了信件把哪个金额称为「现金赔付结算」。

words.enDefinition: to have one foot snagged on an object while moving

examples.en: It's easy to catch a foot on that cable under the table.
examples.zh: 桌子底下那根线很容易「绊住脚」。

examples.en: I saw him catch a foot on the leg of a folding chair.
examples.zh: 我看见他「被一把折叠椅的椅腿绊住了脚」。

collocations: catch a foot on a cable
catch a foot on a step
catch a foot on the corner of a mat

words.enDefinition: to have a finger trapped as something closes or moves

examples.en: Did you catch your finger in the folding chair when it closed?
examples.zh: 折叠椅合上时，你「把手指夹在里面了」吗？

examples.en: It's easy to catch your finger in that drawer when it shuts quickly.
examples.zh: 那个抽屉合得快时，很容易「把手指夹在里面」。

collocations: catch your finger in a door
catch your finger in a drawer
catch your finger in a hinge

words.enDefinition: The event or circumstance that brought about a reported loss

examples.en: The adjuster listed the cause of loss separately from the affected property.
examples.zh: 查勘员把「损失原因」与受影响的财物分开列出。

examples.en: I checked how the cause of loss was described in the final report.
examples.zh: 我核对了最终报告是怎样描述「损失原因」的。

words.enDefinition: an official document confirming that someone reported a loss

examples.en: The consulate in Vientiane asked for a certificate of loss for the missing passport.
examples.zh: 万象的领事办事处请我提供那本遗失护照的「遗失报备证明」。

examples.en: My adviser asked whether the certificate of loss was already in my document folder.
examples.zh: 顾问问我，「遗失报备证明」是否已放进文件夹。

collocations: copy of a certificate of loss

words.enDefinition: to replace existing locks so that their previous keys no longer work

examples.en: We asked the landlord whether she planned to change the locks after the reported loss.
examples.zh: 报失后，我们问房东是否打算「更换门锁」。

examples.en: The building manager arranged to change the locks while most residents were in class.
examples.zh: 多数住户上课时，楼管安排了人员「更换门锁」。

collocations: ask permission to change the locks

words.enDefinition: to use a radio to report one's status or whereabouts to a team

examples.en: The volunteer was asked to check in by radio after reaching the field entrance.
examples.zh: 志愿者到达运动场入口后，需要「用无线电报到」。

examples.en: The organiser heard each team check in by radio during the practice session.
examples.zh: 演练期间，组织者听见每支队伍「用无线电报到」。

collocations: check in by radio from the gate
ask someone to check in by radio

words.enDefinition: to look in the pocket attached to a seat for something

examples.en: The attendant offered to check the seat pocket after I described my missing glasses.
examples.zh: 我描述丢失的眼镜后，乘务员主动提出「查看座椅背袋」。

examples.en: I went back to check the seat pocket before leaving the cinema that afternoon.
examples.zh: 那天下午离开电影院前，我折回去「查看座椅背袋」。

collocations: remember to check the seat pocket
ask someone to check the seat pocket
go back to check the seat pocket

words.enDefinition: the facts and events surrounding the disappearance of an item

examples.en: I explained the circumstances of loss in a short note attached to the form.
examples.zh: 我在表格所附的一张简短说明里写了「遗失经过」。

examples.en: The adviser asked about the circumstances of loss before reviewing my travel arrangements.
examples.zh: 顾问先问了「遗失经过」，再查看我的出行安排。

collocations: details of the circumstances of loss

words.enDefinition: The collection of records kept about a particular insurance claim

examples.en: The insurer added the repair estimate to my claim file.
examples.zh: 保险公司把维修费用估算加入了我的「理赔档案」。

examples.en: I checked which report was already in the claim file.
examples.zh: 我核对了「理赔档案」里已经收录了哪份报告。

collocations: add a document to the claim file

words.enDefinition: A status indicating that an insurer is examining a claim

examples.en: The insurer's page showed claim under assessment beside the property entry.
examples.zh: 保险公司的页面在财物条目旁显示「理赔申请正在评估」。

examples.en: I saw the label claim under assessment after uploading the building report.
examples.zh: 上传大楼报告后，我看到了「理赔申请正在评估」这个标记。

collocations: a claim under assessment with an insurer
an update saying claim under assessment

words.enDefinition: A status showing that an earlier insurance claim was withdrawn

examples.en: The portal displayed claim withdrawn beside the older property entry.
examples.zh: 平台在较早的财物条目旁显示「理赔申请已撤回」。

examples.en: I checked which reference appeared next to claim withdrawn on the screen.
examples.zh: 我核对了屏幕上「理赔申请已撤回」旁显示的编号。

words.enDefinition: a status showing the original owner has come forward for an item

examples.en: The system showed claimed by the owner beside the umbrella I had handed in.
examples.zh: 系统在我上交的那把伞旁显示「已被物主认领」。

examples.en: The porter marked the headphones claimed by the owner after checking the name.
examples.zh: 门房核对姓名后，把耳机标为「已被物主认领」。

collocations: marked as claimed by the owner

words.enDefinition: A person who investigates a loss and assesses an insurance claim

examples.en: The claims adjuster asked which items had been in the room.
examples.zh: 「保险理赔查勘员」问原先有哪些物品放在房间里。

examples.en: I checked whether the claims adjuster had received the building report.
examples.zh: 我核对了「保险理赔查勘员」有没有收到大楼报告。

collocations: a report from a claims adjuster

words.enDefinition: A staff member who administers an insurance claim and its records

examples.en: My claims handler explained where the repair photos were listed.
examples.zh: 我的「理赔经办人员」说明了维修照片列在什么位置。

examples.en: I asked the claims handler who was reviewing the report.
examples.zh: 我问「理赔经办人员」是谁在审核报告。

collocations: an update from a claims handler

words.enDefinition: A change to the place where a class is held.

examples.en: I saw the class relocation on the department noticeboard before leaving for the afternoon lecture.
examples.zh: 我动身去听下午的课之前，在院系告示板上看到了「上课地点变更」信息。

examples.en: The class relocation put our Friday seminar in the smaller room beside the library.
examples.zh: 这次「上课地点变更」把星期五的研讨课安排到了图书馆旁的小房间。

collocations: a notice about a class relocation

words.enDefinition: An announcement that previously suspended classes will restart.

examples.en: The department wrote that classes will resume on Tuesday in the usual lecture rooms.
examples.zh: 院系书面通知称，星期二「课程将在原来的阶梯教室恢复」。

examples.en: I checked my timetable after the university announced that classes will resume as scheduled.
examples.zh: 大学宣布「课程将按原时间表恢复」后，我查看了自己的课表。

words.enDefinition: to make more room by moving people or things aside

examples.en: The instructor asked the group to clear some space near the side door.
examples.zh: 老师请大家在侧门旁「腾出些空间」。

examples.en: We moved our bags to clear some space beside the room's entrance.
examples.zh: 我们把包挪开，在房间入口旁「腾出些空间」。

collocations: clear some space by the door
clear some space on the floor
ask people to clear some space

words.enDefinition: A notice stating that a facility or area is closed, sometimes giving the reason or duration.

examples.en: A closure notice was taped to the glass door before the morning study group arrived.
examples.zh: 早上的学习小组到达前，玻璃门上已贴出「关闭告示」。

examples.en: The closure notice gave a reopening date and listed another study space across campus.
examples.zh: 「关闭告示」给出了重新开放的日期，并列出了校园另一边的一个学习场所。

collocations: a closure notice on the door

words.enDefinition: A US alert about expected coastal flooding below warning severity

examples.en: The coastal flood advisory showed where water might reach low roads.
examples.zh: 「沿海洪水注意提示」说明了海水可能漫到哪些低洼道路。

examples.en: The city mentioned the coastal flood advisory in a waterfront update.
examples.zh: 市政府在滨水区动态里提到了「沿海洪水注意提示」。

collocations: a coastal flood advisory for the shore
an area under a coastal flood advisory

words.enDefinition: Water covering normally dry land along a coast

examples.en: The council map marked areas at risk of coastal inundation.
examples.zh: 市议会的地图标出了可能发生「沿海淹水」的地区。

examples.en: The notice linked the port closure to expected coastal inundation.
examples.zh: 通知说，港口关闭与预计出现的「沿海淹水」有关。

words.enDefinition: to pick up belongings that have been found or retrieved

examples.en: The email invited me to collect recovered property at the station after noon.
examples.zh: 邮件通知我中午过后可以到车站「领取找回的财物」。

examples.en: She brought her student card when she went to collect recovered property from reception.
examples.zh: 她去前台「领取找回的财物」时，带上了学生证。

collocations: bring identification to collect recovered property

words.enDefinition: Material that is capable of catching fire and burning.

examples.en: The safety inspection report identified the cardboard beside the doorway as a combustible material.
examples.zh: 消防安全检查报告将门口旁的纸板列为「可燃材料」。

examples.en: Our studio inventory listed several kinds of combustible material kept in the storage room.
examples.zh: 工作室的物品清单列出了储物间中存放的几种「可燃材料」。

words.enDefinition: a display of symbols, pictures or words for expressing messages

examples.en: She pointed to a word on her communication board rather than saying it aloud.
examples.zh: 她没有把那个词说出来，而是指向了「沟通板」上的相应词语。

examples.en: The volunteer asked whether the communication board was within the student's reach.
examples.zh: 志愿者问，那位学生能不能够到自己的「沟通板」。

collocations: point to a symbol on a communication board

words.enDefinition: the base amount a UK insurer requires the customer to pay toward a covered claim

examples.en: The UK insurer listed the compulsory excess in a separate line from the voluntary excess.
examples.zh: 英国保险公司将「固定自付免赔额」和自愿选择的免赔额分开列出。

examples.en: Our claim statement showed the compulsory excess before the amount payable by the insurer.
examples.zh: 我们的理赔结算单先列「固定自付免赔额」，再列保险公司应付的金额。

collocations: a compulsory excess on the policy

words.enDefinition: to check that an address is correct

examples.en: Could you confirm the address so I can find the right entrance on my map?
examples.zh: 你能「核实一下地址」吗？这样我就能在地图上找到正确的入口。

examples.en: The dispatcher called again to confirm the address before updating the crew's route.
examples.zh: 调度员再次来电「核实地址」，然后更新了救援队的行进路线。

collocations: ask someone to confirm the address

words.enDefinition: to bring an interpreter into a call so people can understand each other

examples.en: The operator offered to connect an interpreter after we explained which language we spoke.
examples.zh: 我们说明自己说哪种语言后，接线员提出可以「为通话接入口译员」。

examples.en: The front desk asked whether it could connect an interpreter while I waited on hold.
examples.zh: 我在线等候时，前台问能不能「为通话接入口译员」。

collocations: connect an interpreter to the call
wait for staff to connect an interpreter

words.enDefinition: A loss resulting indirectly from an incident or direct damage

examples.en: The adviser explained why the policy mentioned consequential loss separately.
examples.zh: 顾问解释了为什么保单单独提到「间接损失」。

examples.en: I checked which example the guide called a consequential loss.
examples.zh: 我核对了指南把哪个示例称为「间接损失」。

words.enDefinition: help available from a country's consular officials to its nationals abroad

examples.en: The student sought consular assistance after discovering her passport was missing during the exchange.
examples.zh: 那名学生在交流期间发现护照不见了，便寻求了「领事协助」。

examples.en: The office arranged consular assistance for several travellers who had lost their documents.
examples.zh: 办事处为几名遗失证件的旅客安排了「领事协助」。

words.enDefinition: a telephone line for urgent communication with a consular service

examples.en: The orientation leaflet lists a consular emergency line for students travelling outside the country.
examples.zh: 迎新宣传单上列出了供出国学生使用的「领事紧急联系电话」。

examples.en: I saved the consular emergency line alongside the regular office number in my contacts.
examples.zh: 我在通讯录里同时保存了「领事紧急联系电话」和办事处的普通电话。

words.enDefinition: A request under insurance for lost or damaged personal belongings

examples.en: I checked which items were listed on the contents claim.
examples.zh: 我核对了「室内财物理赔申请」上列了哪些物品。

examples.en: The insurer discussed my contents claim separately from the building repair.
examples.zh: 保险公司把我的「室内财物理赔申请」和楼房维修分开谈。

collocations: a contents claim for damaged belongings

words.enDefinition: the objects that are or were inside a particular bag

examples.en: The clerk asked me to describe the contents of the bag without opening it.
examples.zh: 办事员请我不用打开包，就说出「包里的东西」。

examples.en: I realised the contents of the bag included both of my flat keys.
examples.zh: 我才想起来，「包里的东西」里有我公寓的两把钥匙。

collocations: list the contents of the bag
check the contents of the bag
describe the contents of the bag

words.enDefinition: Needs for help that remain after an initial response

examples.en: The coordinator asked about continuing support needs during our meeting that week.
examples.zh: 协调员在那周的会面中询问了「仍需援助的事项」。

examples.en: The form had a separate place for continuing support needs after relocation.
examples.zh: 表格专门留了一栏，填写搬迁后「仍需援助的事项」。

collocations: a record of continuing support needs

words.enDefinition: a room where staff monitor incidents and coordinate a response

examples.en: The duty officer gave the control room an update after leaving the sports hall.
examples.zh: 值班警员离开体育馆后，向「调度控制室」通报了最新情况。

examples.en: Screens in the control room showed the locations of crews already on duty.
examples.zh: 「调度控制室」的屏幕显示着各值班小组的位置。

words.enDefinition: An arrangement allowing people back into a building under supervision or in assigned stages.

examples.en: The email described controlled re-entry for students who had left personal belongings inside the library.
examples.zh: 邮件说明了对有物品遗留在图书馆的学生实行的「有序重新入内」安排。

examples.en: During the exercise, staff practiced how to organize controlled re-entry for a large group.
examples.zh: 演习期间，工作人员练习了如何组织大批人员「有序重新入内」。

collocations: allow controlled re-entry after a drill

words.enDefinition: A public facility made available for relief from severe heat

examples.en: The city included a cooling centre on its summer information map.
examples.zh: 市政府在夏季信息地图上标出了一处「避暑纳凉中心」。

examples.en: I checked when the cooling centre would be open that weekend.
examples.zh: 我查看了「避暑纳凉中心」那个周末的开放时间。

collocations: the hours of a cooling centre

words.expression: could you say that again slowly
words.lemma: could you say that again slowly
words.enDefinition: a request for someone to repeat their words at a slower pace
acceptedEnVariants: could you say that again slowly

examples.en: “Could you say that again slowly?” I asked as the room grew louder.
examples.zh: 屋里越来越吵，我问「能慢一点再说一遍吗？」

examples.en: The student said, “Could you say that again slowly?” and turned toward the speaker.
examples.zh: 那名学生转向说话的人，问「能慢一点再说一遍吗？」

collocations: ask “Could you say that again slowly?”
“Could you say that again slowly, please?”
“Could you say that again slowly so I can write it down?”

words.zhGloss: 可以把刚才说的写下来吗
words.enDefinition: a request to record spoken information in writing
acceptedZhAnswers: 可以把刚才说的写下来吗

examples.en: Could you write that down so I can read it at my own pace?
examples.zh: 「可以把刚才说的写下来吗？」我想按自己的速度看。

examples.en: “Could you write that down?” I asked when the announcement drowned out her voice.
examples.zh: 广播盖过了她的声音，我问「可以把刚才说的写下来吗？」

collocations: “Could you write that down for me?”
“Could you write that down on this page?”

words.enDefinition: An insurer's decision about whether the reported loss falls under coverage

examples.en: The coverage decision explained which items were included in the review.
examples.zh: 「保险承保范围认定」说明了哪些物品纳入了审核。

examples.en: I read the coverage decision before discussing the repair estimate with reception.
examples.zh: 我先读了「保险承保范围认定」，再和前台谈维修费用估算。

words.enDefinition: An update indicating an insurer is checking whether coverage applies

examples.en: The file displayed coverage under review below the list of affected items.
examples.zh: 案卷在受影响物品清单下面显示「保障范围正在审核」。

examples.en: The message said coverage under review and gave the handler's contact details.
examples.zh: 消息写着「保障范围正在审核」，附有经办人的联系方式。

collocations: a notice stating coverage under review
a file marked coverage under review
a status of coverage under review

words.enDefinition: A loss eligible for insurance coverage under applicable policy terms

examples.en: The letter listed the broken desk as a covered loss.
examples.zh: 信件把损坏的书桌列为「承保损失」。

examples.en: I asked which part of the report described the covered loss.
examples.zh: 我问报告哪部分描述了这项「承保损失」。

collocations: a payment for a covered loss
review whether it is a covered loss

words.enDefinition: A cause of damage insured under a particular policy

examples.en: The document named fire as a covered peril in its example.
examples.zh: 那份文件在示例中把火灾列为一种「承保的致损事件」。

examples.en: I checked which cause the insurer listed as a covered peril.
examples.zh: 我核对了保险公司把哪种损坏原因列为「承保的致损事件」。

words.enDefinition: A status indicating a repair team has been sent to a site

examples.en: The outage map showed "Crew dispatched" for our part of town.
examples.zh: 停运地图把我们所在城区标为「已派出维修人员」。

examples.en: I saw "Crew dispatched" below the entry for the affected street.
examples.zh: 我在受影响街道的条目下面看到了「已派出维修人员」。

collocations: a utility map marked crew dispatched
an outage update saying crew dispatched

words.enDefinition: A status indicating a team has arrived at the work location

examples.en: The utility update showed "Crew on site" next to the location.
examples.zh: 公用服务机构在地点旁显示「维修人员已到现场」。

examples.en: I checked when the update first said "Crew on site" that afternoon.
examples.zh: 我查了当天下午的动态最早什么时候显示「维修人员已到现场」。

collocations: a status reading crew on site
a notice saying crew on site
an outage report marked crew on site

words.enDefinition: a UK police reference assigned to a report recorded as a crime

examples.en: The officer gave me a crime reference number after recording the theft of my bag.
examples.zh: 记录我的包被偷一事后，警员给了我一个「英国警方案件编号」。

examples.en: I copied the crime reference number into the box on the insurer's form.
examples.zh: 我把「英国警方案件编号」抄到保险公司表格的对应框里。

words.enDefinition: a street that crosses the main street used to identify a location

examples.en: The call handler asked for a cross street to narrow down the location.
examples.zh: 接线员问了离现场较近的一条「相交的街道」，以缩小定位范围。

examples.en: The driver named the cross street printed on a sign opposite the bus stop.
examples.zh: 司机报出了公交站对面路牌上那条「相交的街道」的名字。

words.enDefinition: to accidentally injure your skin against a sharp object

examples.en: Did you cut yourself on a piece of broken glass near the door?
examples.zh: 你是「被门边的一块碎玻璃割伤」的吗？

examples.en: You could cut yourself on that chipped mug if you grab the rim there.
examples.zh: 要是捏住那个破杯子的杯口，你可能会「被它割伤」。

collocations: cut yourself on a sharp edge

words.enDefinition: An examination of property to see where and how it was affected

examples.en: The property office arranged a damage inspection after the leak was reported.
examples.zh: 接到漏水报告后，物业办公室安排了「受损检查」。

examples.en: The form listed the date of the damage inspection under the address.
examples.zh: 表格在地址下方列了「受损检查」的日期。

collocations: a report from a damage inspection

words.enDefinition: A detailed list identifying property or items that were harmed

examples.en: The damage inventory listed the desk beside the other affected items.
examples.zh: 「受损物品清单」在其他受影响物品旁列出了书桌。

examples.en: I checked which room each item belonged to on the damage inventory.
examples.zh: 我查看了「受损物品清单」，核对每项物品原来在哪间房。

collocations: a copy of the damage inventory

words.enDefinition: Things owned by someone that were harmed in an incident

examples.en: We wrote down the damaged belongings before speaking to the property office.
examples.zh: 与物业办公室沟通之前，我们记下了「受损的个人物品」。

examples.en: I checked whether my scarf was included among the damaged belongings.
examples.zh: 我核对了围巾有没有列入「受损的个人物品」。

words.enDefinition: the calendar date when someone gave a found item to staff

examples.en: The date handed in was one day later than the date I lost it.
examples.zh: 「上交日期」比我弄丢它的日期晚一天。

examples.en: The porter noted the date handed in beside the umbrella's description in the log.
examples.zh: 门房在登记表的雨伞描述旁记下了「上交日期」。

words.enDefinition: The day on which the event being recorded took place

examples.en: The form showed the date of incident separately from the reporting date.
examples.zh: 表格把「事故发生日期」与报告日期分开列了出来。

examples.en: I checked the date of incident against the earlier message from reception.
examples.zh: 我把「事故发生日期」和前台早先发来的消息核对了一下。

words.enDefinition: the calendar date on which an item or document went missing

examples.en: I entered the date of loss using the date printed on my train ticket.
examples.zh: 我按火车票上印的日期填写了「遗失日期」。

examples.en: The application asked for the date of loss in a separate field near the top.
examples.zh: 申请表在顶部附近设有单独一栏，要求填写「遗失日期」。

words.enDefinition: The clearing away of material blocking a route or site

examples.en: The grounds team posted a notice about debris removal near campus.
examples.zh: 场地管理团队张贴了学校附近「杂物清理」的通知。

examples.en: The road reopened after debris removal was completed that afternoon.
examples.zh: 当天下午「杂物清理」完成后，道路重新开放。

words.enDefinition: a formal declaration that a particular document or item is missing

examples.en: I read the declaration of loss carefully before signing it at the desk.
examples.zh: 我仔细读了「正式遗失声明」，然后才在服务台签字。

examples.en: The clerk added the declaration of loss to the file containing my passport correspondence.
examples.zh: 办事员把「正式遗失声明」放入保存我护照往来函件的档案里。

words.enDefinition: an opening in the skin extending into deeper tissue

examples.en: The pottery teacher noticed a deep cut when I showed her my finger.
examples.zh: 我把手指给陶艺老师看时，她发现了一道「较深的割伤」。

examples.en: My roommate said the mark looked like a deep cut under the bright light.
examples.zh: 室友说，在亮灯下，那道伤痕看起来像「较深的割伤」。

collocations: a deep cut on the hand
a deep cut from broken glass

words.enDefinition: a marked case that houses an emergency defibrillator

examples.en: I saw the defibrillator cabinet beside the lift on my way to class.
examples.zh: 我去上课时看见电梯旁有个「除颤器存放柜」。

examples.en: A volunteer reported that the label on the defibrillator cabinet was hard to read.
examples.zh: 一名志愿者反映，「除颤器存放柜」上的标签不好辨认。

words.enDefinition: a marker showing where a defibrillator is located

examples.en: The defibrillator sign was high enough to see even from the back row.
examples.zh: 「除颤器标识」挂得很高，坐在最后一排也能看见。

examples.en: I saw a defibrillator sign above the noticeboard near the corridor entrance.
examples.zh: 我看见走廊入口旁的公告板上方有个「除颤器标识」。

words.enDefinition: An announcement or arrangement to open later than originally scheduled

examples.en: The district announced a delayed opening for its public library.
examples.zh: 该地区宣布公共图书馆将「推迟开放」。

examples.en: The delayed opening appeared in a message about overnight ice.
examples.zh: 关于夜间结冰的消息里提到了「推迟开放」。

words.enDefinition: A US alert that thick fog is reducing visibility

examples.en: The dense fog advisory appeared beside the bridge's revised opening times.
examples.zh: 「浓雾注意提示」出现在大桥调整后的开放时间旁。

examples.en: The forecast linked to a dense fog advisory covering the valley.
examples.zh: 预报附上了谷地「浓雾注意提示」的链接。

collocations: a dense fog advisory for the coast
an area under a dense fog advisory

words.enDefinition: A reduction in a valuation reflecting age, wear, or use

examples.en: The statement showed a depreciation deduction beside the amount for the sofa.
examples.zh: 说明在沙发金额旁列了一项「折旧扣减」。

examples.en: I asked why the depreciation deduction appeared on a separate line.
examples.zh: 我问为什么「折旧扣减」单独列出了一行。

words.enDefinition: to explain which items or information are inside something

examples.en: The clerk asked me to describe the contents before he brought the bag out.
examples.zh: 办事员把包拿出来前，请我「描述里面的东西」。

examples.en: I could describe the contents of the pouch but not the colour of its zip.
examples.zh: 我能「描述里面的东西」，但说不出小袋拉链的颜色。

collocations: describe the contents of a bag
ask a caller to describe the contents

words.enDefinition: to say how someone fell and what you observed

examples.en: The staff member asked me to describe the fall from where I stood.
examples.zh: 工作人员让我按我站的位置看到的情况「描述摔倒经过」。

examples.en: I couldn't describe the fall because I had only heard the sound.
examples.zh: 我只听到了响声，所以说不出「摔倒的经过」。

collocations: describe the fall in your own words
ask a witness to describe the fall
describe the fall as you remember it

words.enDefinition: to explain where you are in enough detail for someone to find you

examples.en: Can you describe your location using a building or sign that you can see?
examples.zh: 你能用看得见的楼或标志「说明你所在的位置」吗？

examples.en: The operator asked, "Could you describe your location without using the room number?"
examples.zh: 接线员问：“你能不用房间号「说明你所在的位置」吗？”

collocations: describe your location over the phone

words.enDefinition: A written account of the type and appearance of physical damage

examples.en: The report included a description of damage beside each affected item.
examples.zh: 报告在每件受影响的物品旁边都写了「损坏情况描述」。

examples.en: I checked the description of damage against the assessor's notes for our room.
examples.zh: 我把「损坏情况描述」和评估人员对我们房间的记录核对了一下。

words.enDefinition: A place set aside where people can stay safely during an incident or exercise.

examples.en: A sign outside the student center identified the courtyard as the designated safe area for the drill.
examples.zh: 学生活动中心外的标牌注明，庭院是这次演习的「指定安全区域」。

examples.en: The volunteer guide delivered water to a designated safe area after the classroom building closed.
examples.zh: 教学楼关闭后，志愿引导员把水送到了「指定安全区域」。

collocations: wait in a designated safe area
a map of the designated safe area

words.enDefinition: A public place identified for people to use during dangerous cold

examples.en: The council map listed one designated warming centre near the university.
examples.zh: 市议会的地图在大学附近列出了一处「指定取暖中心」。

examples.en: The notice gave the hours of the designated warming centre for that week.
examples.zh: 通知列明了「指定取暖中心」那一周的开放时间。

collocations: a map of a designated warming centre
a notice naming a designated warming centre

words.enDefinition: A warning displayed on the screen of a computer.

examples.en: A desktop alert appeared while we were using the computers in the language lab.
examples.zh: 我们在语音实验室用电脑时，屏幕上弹出一条「电脑桌面警报」。

examples.en: The desktop alert included the same closure information as the text on my phone.
examples.zh: 「电脑桌面警报」和我手机上的短信提供了相同的闭馆信息。

words.enDefinition: Tap water that has a visibly different colour than usual

examples.en: The water company mentioned discoloured tap water in its neighborhood notice.
examples.zh: 供水公司在社区通知中提到了「颜色异常的自来水」。

examples.en: I checked which streets reported discoloured tap water after the repair.
examples.zh: 我查了维修后哪些街道报告有「颜色异常的自来水」。

collocations: an update about discoloured tap water
a notice referring to discoloured tap water

words.enDefinition: to send an available team or vehicle to an incident

examples.en: The control room agreed to dispatch a unit to the residence hall entrance.
examples.zh: 指挥室同意「派出应急单位」前往宿舍楼入口。

examples.en: The call handler gathered enough information to dispatch a unit to the correct building.
examples.zh: 接线员收集了足够的信息，好「派出应急单位」前往正确的楼栋。

collocations: dispatch a unit to the scene
dispatch a unit to an address

words.zhGloss: 供调度的来电确切位置
words.enDefinition: a validated US street address with any extra details needed to locate the caller
acceptedZhAnswers: 供调度的来电确切位置

examples.en: The training example included a room number as part of the dispatchable location.
examples.zh: 培训示例里的「供调度的来电确切位置」包含房间号。

examples.en: The US campus phone system sends a dispatchable location with calls from the library.
examples.zh: 从图书馆打电话时，这所美国大学的校园电话系统会随通话发送「供调度的来电确切位置」。

words.enDefinition: a worker who sends suitable crews or vehicles to incidents

examples.en: The dispatcher updated the crew when the caller corrected the street name.
examples.zh: 来电者更正街名后，「调度员」把新信息告知了救援人员。

examples.en: A police dispatcher directed the nearest available unit to the station entrance.
examples.zh: 一名警方「调度员」派最近的一组可用警员前往车站入口。

words.enDefinition: A person unable to stay in their usual residence after disruption

examples.en: The office arranged a meeting for each displaced resident that week.
examples.zh: 办公室为每位「被迫暂离住处的居民」安排了那周的会面。

examples.en: The coordinator asked which services a displaced resident might need initially.
examples.zh: 协调员问「被迫暂离住处的居民」起初可能需要哪些服务。

words.enDefinition: a single-use protective covering worn over the front of clothing

examples.en: The volunteer checking supplies found a disposable apron at the bottom of the box.
examples.zh: 清点用品的志愿者在箱底找到了一条「一次性围裙」。

examples.en: Each disposable apron came in its own wrapper with a printed inventory code.
examples.zh: 每条「一次性围裙」都有独立包装，印着库存编号。

words.enDefinition: single-use hand coverings that provide a protective barrier

examples.en: The new first aid supplies included a carton of disposable gloves for volunteers.
examples.zh: 新到的急救用品里有一盒供志愿者用的「一次性手套」。

examples.en: I counted the unopened packs of disposable gloves listed on the inventory sheet.
examples.zh: 我按库存表数了还没拆封的「一次性手套」有几包。

words.enDefinition: a noticeable mark that helps distinguish an item from similar ones

examples.en: I mentioned a distinctive mark beside the zip when I described my bag.
examples.zh: 我描述自己的包时，提到了拉链旁一处「显眼的辨认标记」。

examples.en: The red paint spot was the most distinctive mark on the missing helmet.
examples.zh: 那顶丢失的头盔上，红色油漆斑是最「显眼的辨认标记」。

words.enDefinition: An official notice that supplied water is unsuitable for drinking

examples.en: The utility included a do not drink advisory in its morning bulletin.
examples.zh: 供水机构在早间公报中发布了「自来水禁饮通告」。

examples.en: I checked the affected streets listed in the do not drink advisory.
examples.zh: 我查看了「自来水禁饮通告」列出的受影响街道。

collocations: issue a do not drink advisory
an area under a do not drink advisory
lift a do not drink advisory

words.enDefinition: an official notice telling people not to use the affected tap water

examples.en: The utility page showed a do not use advisory for the affected zone.
examples.zh: 供水机构的网页为受影响区域发布了「禁止使用自来水通告」。

examples.en: The do not use advisory appeared separately from the earlier water update.
examples.zh: 「禁止使用自来水通告」与早先的供水动态分开显示。

collocations: issue a do not use advisory
areas under a do not use advisory
lift a do not use advisory

words.enDefinition: A notice directing people not to use a lift under the conditions stated on the sign.

examples.en: The poster said “Do not use the lift” below a symbol of a flame.
examples.zh: 海报上火焰图标下方写着「请勿使用电梯」。

examples.en: We translated “Do not use the lift” from a sample building notice during orientation.
examples.zh: 新生说明会上，我们翻译了楼宇示例告示中的「请勿使用电梯」。

collocations: a sign reading do not use the lift
a do not use the lift notice
do not use the lift during a fire

words.enDefinition: a question asking whether someone recalls the events

examples.en: “Do you remember what happened?” the teacher asked when she came over.
examples.zh: 老师走过来时问「你记得发生了什么吗？」

examples.en: I had only heard a noise, so I asked, “Do you remember what happened?”
examples.zh: 我只听到一声响，于是问「你记得发生了什么吗？」

collocations: “Do you remember what happened before you fell?”

words.enDefinition: To create a record of why or when someone was absent

examples.en: The adviser showed me where to document an absence on the form.
examples.zh: 顾问指给我看，表格哪个位置可以「记录缺席情况」。

examples.en: I asked which person could document an absence after the residence closure.
examples.zh: 我问宿舍关闭后，谁可以「记录缺席情况」。

collocations: a form to document an absence
ask how to document an absence

words.enDefinition: the process of making an official document cease to be valid

examples.en: The office recorded the date of document invalidation beside the original file number.
examples.zh: 办事处在原案卷编号旁记录了「证件作废」的日期。

examples.en: The letter confirmed document invalidation before a replacement was issued the following week.
examples.zh: 信中确认了「证件作废」，补发件于下一周签发。

words.enDefinition: a record notifying an organization that an official document is missing

examples.en: I included the city and date in my document loss report for the office.
examples.zh: 我在交给办事处的「证件遗失报告」里写明了城市和日期。

examples.en: The adviser checked the document loss report against the copies in my student file.
examples.zh: 顾问把「证件遗失报告」与学生档案里的副本进行了核对。

collocations: copy of a document loss report

words.enDefinition: An overhead electricity line that has fallen from its position

examples.en: The provider reported a downed power line near the closed road.
examples.zh: 供电方报告说，封闭道路附近有一根「掉落的电线」。

examples.en: The bus update listed a detour because of a downed power line.
examples.zh: 公交运营方在动态中说明，因「掉落的电线」要改道。

collocations: a report of a downed power line
a road closed due to a downed power line
a notice about a downed power line

words.enDefinition: A tree that has fallen, often during severe weather

examples.en: The road notice named a downed tree near the junction.
examples.zh: 道路通知提到路口附近有一棵「倒下的树」。

examples.en: The college listed a downed tree in its report on access.
examples.zh: 学院的通行情况报告中列出了一棵「倒下的树」。

collocations: a road blocked by a downed tree

words.enDefinition: A spoken announcement telling people that a practice exercise is about to begin or is in progress.

examples.en: The drill announcement was barely audible from the back of the student dining hall.
examples.zh: 从学生餐厅后部几乎听不见「演习广播」。

examples.en: We heard the drill announcement during a pause in our group discussion that afternoon.
examples.zh: 那天下午，我们在小组讨论的间隙听见了「演习广播」。

words.enDefinition: A discussion after a practice exercise to review what happened and what might be improved.

examples.en: During the drill debrief, students said the announcement was clearer in the hallway than outside.
examples.zh: 在「演习复盘」中，学生说走廊里的广播比室外的清楚。

examples.en: The building manager invited reception staff to the drill debrief after the morning exercise.
examples.zh: 上午演习结束后，楼宇管理员请接待处工作人员参加「演习复盘」。

words.enDefinition: A label indicating that a practice exercise is currently underway.

examples.en: A sign reading “Drill in progress” stood outside the reception doors during our tour.
examples.zh: 我们参观时，接待处门外立着一块写有「演习进行中」的牌子。

examples.en: The welcome desk put out “Drill in progress” signs before the first group arrived.
examples.zh: 第一组抵达前，迎宾服务台摆出了写有「演习进行中」的牌子。

collocations: a notice marked drill in progress

words.enDefinition: A notice telling people that a practice exercise is planned or underway.

examples.en: A drill notice appeared next to the printer at the start of the week.
examples.zh: 周初，打印机旁贴出一份「演习通知」。

examples.en: The drill notice listed both the start time and the buildings involved in the exercise.
examples.zh: 「演习通知」列出了演习开始时间和涉及的楼宇。

collocations: a drill notice on the noticeboard

words.enDefinition: A person assigned to watch and record what happens during a practice exercise.

examples.en: The drill observer wrote down which signs the new students noticed in the main lobby.
examples.zh: 「演习观察员」记下了新生在主大厅里留意到哪些告示。

examples.en: Each drill observer handed in a short form before the staff meeting the next day.
examples.zh: 次日的员工会议开始前，每位「演习观察员」都交了一张简短的表格。

words.zhGloss: 重复报同一事件的来电
words.enDefinition: a separate call reporting an incident that has already been reported
acceptedZhAnswers: 重复报同一事件的来电

examples.en: The dispatcher linked the duplicate call to the report already on her screen.
examples.zh: 调度员把这通「重复报同一事件的来电」关联到了屏幕上已有的报告。

examples.en: I knew mine might be a duplicate call because another student was already talking.
examples.zh: 另一名学生已经在通话，我知道自己的电话可能是「重复报同一事件的来电」。

collocations: link a duplicate call to an incident

words.enDefinition: the staff member currently responsible for responding to calls or incidents

examples.en: The duty officer at the residence desk asked who had seen the incident.
examples.zh: 宿舍前台的「值班负责人」问，谁看到了事情经过。

examples.en: The event steward left my name with the duty officer at the gate.
examples.zh: 活动引导员把我的姓名留给了门口的「值班负责人」。

collocations: hand over to the duty officer

words.enDefinition: a stretchable strip of fabric used as a wrap

examples.en: The elastic bandage was on the shelf with the other unopened wraps.
examples.zh: 那卷「弹力绷带」和其他未拆封的绷带放在同一个架子上。

examples.en: I wrote the width of the elastic bandage beside its name on the inventory.
examples.zh: 我在库存表上的「弹力绷带」旁记了它的宽度。

words.enDefinition: an adhesive contact that connects a device electrically to skin

examples.en: The drawing on the packet showed the outline of an electrode pad.
examples.zh: 包装袋上的图画出了「电极贴片」的轮廓。

examples.en: The instructor held up a sealed electrode pad during our equipment tour.
examples.zh: 介绍设备时，讲解员举起了一片还没拆封的「电极贴片」。

words.enDefinition: Costs that meet the stated requirements for payment or reimbursement

examples.en: I asked where the insurer had listed the eligible expenses.
examples.zh: 我问保险公司把「可纳入理赔的费用」列在什么地方。

examples.en: The statement gave two examples of eligible expenses for that trip.
examples.zh: 说明给出了该次行程两类「可纳入理赔的费用」示例。

words.enDefinition: a designated place where emergency personnel can enter or reach a site

examples.en: The residence map marked an emergency access point beside the old bike racks.
examples.zh: 宿舍地图在旧自行车架旁标了一个「救援人员出入点」。

examples.en: The crew met campus staff at the emergency access point behind the sports hall.
examples.zh: 救援队在体育馆后面的「救援人员出入点」与校园工作人员会合。

collocations: keep an emergency access point clear

words.enDefinition: A document laying out responsibilities and procedures to follow during an emergency.

examples.en: The building manager shared the emergency action plan with departments that had recently moved in.
examples.zh: 楼宇管理员把「应急行动计划」发给了刚搬进来的各个部门。

examples.en: A copy of the emergency action plan was available at reception for staff and visitors.
examples.zh: 接待处备有一份「应急行动计划」，供工作人员和访客查阅。

words.enDefinition: An urgent message warning people about an emergency.

examples.en: The emergency alert reached several students while they were waiting outside the lecture hall.
examples.zh: 几名学生在阶梯教室外等候时收到了「紧急警报」。

examples.en: My roommate noticed the emergency alert on her phone before I checked my email.
examples.zh: 我还没查看邮件，室友就已经看到了手机上的「紧急警报」。

words.enDefinition: a lightweight cover designed to reduce body heat loss

examples.en: The foil emergency blanket was still folded inside its small silver packet.
examples.zh: 那张铝膜「应急保温毯」还折叠着装在小小的银色袋子里。

examples.en: The equipment checklist included an emergency blanket for the outdoor team event.
examples.zh: 户外团队活动的装备清单上列了一张「应急保温毯」。

words.enDefinition: A warning or update announced to a wide audience through a broadcast channel.

examples.en: The emergency broadcast interrupted the music playing over the speakers in the student union.
examples.zh: 「紧急广播」打断了学生中心扬声器正在播放的音乐。

examples.en: I could hear the emergency broadcast from the courtyard even with the lobby doors closed.
examples.zh: 即使大厅的门关着，我在庭院里也能听见「紧急广播」。

collocations: an emergency broadcast over the speakers

words.enDefinition: a call requesting urgent help from an emergency service

examples.en: The library closed its front doors shortly after staff made an emergency call.
examples.zh: 工作人员打了「紧急求助电话」后不久，图书馆关上了正门。

examples.en: My phone showed the time of the emergency call in its recent calls list.
examples.zh: 我的手机在近期通话列表里显示了拨打「紧急求助电话」的时间。

words.enDefinition: a button that connects a person to assistance during an emergency

examples.en: The emergency call button was clearly marked beside the lift controls in my residence.
examples.zh: 我的宿舍里，电梯控制面板旁清楚标示着「紧急呼叫按钮」。

examples.en: We recognised the symbol for the emergency call button from our access guide.
examples.zh: 我们认出了「紧急呼叫按钮」的标志，无障碍通行指南上见过。

words.enDefinition: a centre that answers urgent requests and routes them to responders

examples.en: The emergency call centre transferred the caller to the appropriate local service.
