examples.zh: 「紧急电话接听中心」把来电者转接到了当地相关部门。

examples.en: A new shift at the emergency call centre began just before midnight.
examples.zh: 临近午夜，「紧急电话接听中心」的下一班工作人员开始值班。

words.enDefinition: a trained worker who takes calls requesting emergency help

examples.en: The emergency call handler asked her to say the building name again slowly.
examples.zh: 「紧急电话接线员」请她慢一点再说一遍楼名。

examples.en: An emergency call handler checked whether the caller was still near the station.
examples.zh: 一名「紧急电话接线员」确认来电者是否还在车站附近。

collocations: speak to an emergency call handler

words.enDefinition: the systems and messages used to communicate during or about urgent incidents

examples.en: My class visited the university centre responsible for emergency communications on the main campus.
examples.zh: 我们班参观了主校区负责「应急通信」的大学中心。

examples.en: The accessibility committee discussed emergency communications with students who use different calling services.
examples.zh: 无障碍委员会与使用不同通话服务的学生讨论了「应急通信」。

words.enDefinition: a card listing whom to contact if the person carrying it needs assistance

examples.en: My emergency contact card lists both my residence office and my sister's phone number.
examples.zh: 我的「紧急联络信息卡」上有宿管办公室和我姐姐的电话号码。

examples.en: I replaced my emergency contact card after changing rooms and getting a new number.
examples.zh: 我换了房间和电话号码后，换了一张「紧急联络信息卡」。

collocations: fill in an emergency contact card

words.enDefinition: the phone number of a designated person to be contacted in an emergency

examples.en: The residence form still showed my old emergency contact number from last year.
examples.zh: 宿舍登记表上仍写着去年留下的旧「紧急联系人电话」。

examples.en: I checked that my emergency contact number included the international dialling code for home.
examples.zh: 我确认了自己的「紧急联系人电话」里有老家的国际区号。

words.enDefinition: the coordination and assignment of responders to urgent incidents

examples.en: I shadowed a member of the emergency dispatch team for my communications course.
examples.zh: 为了完成传播课的作业，我跟岗观察了一名「应急调度」团队成员。

examples.en: The city's emergency dispatch system recorded when each crew was assigned to the incident.
examples.zh: 市里的「应急调度」系统记录了每支救援队接到此次任务的时间。

words.enDefinition: An organized activity used to practice or evaluate how people respond to an emergency.

examples.en: Several departments took part in the emergency exercise before the new residence opened to students.
examples.zh: 新宿舍向学生开放前，几个部门参加了「应急演练」。

examples.en: Our tutor used an emergency exercise to show how the faculty communicates during disruptions.
examples.zh: 导师用一次「应急演练」展示了院系在运营中断期间如何传递信息。

collocations: take part in an emergency exercise

words.enDefinition: A designated exit for leaving a place in an emergency.

examples.en: The tour guide pointed out the emergency exit at the back of the rehearsal room.
examples.zh: 参观向导指给我们看排练室后方的「紧急出口」。

examples.en: Our floor map showed an emergency exit at each end of the long corridor.
examples.zh: 楼层图上显示，长走廊两端各有一个「紧急出口」。

words.enDefinition: A label indicating that an exit is reserved for emergency use.

examples.en: The door nearest our seats was marked “Emergency exit only” in large white letters.
examples.zh: 离座位最近的门上用醒目的白字写着「仅供紧急疏散使用」。

examples.en: The lobby diagram used a separate symbol for each door marked “Emergency exit only” upstairs.
examples.zh: 大厅平面图用了单独的符号标识楼上写有「仅供紧急疏散使用」的每扇门。

collocations: mark a door emergency exit only
a door labeled emergency exit only

words.enDefinition: The organization of a place to stay during an emergency

examples.en: The university confirmed my emergency housing placement in a short message.
examples.zh: 学校发来一条简短消息，确认会给我「安排紧急住宿」。

examples.en: I asked which person had arranged the emergency housing placement for our group.
examples.zh: 我问是谁为我们这一行人「安排紧急住宿」。

collocations: details of an emergency housing placement

words.enDefinition: A web page that provides official updates and notices about an emergency.

examples.en: The emergency information page showed which buildings had reopened after the facilities team finished checking them.
examples.zh: 「紧急情况信息页」列出了设施管理团队检查完毕后已重新开放的楼宇。

examples.en: I bookmarked the emergency information page because it listed notices for all three campuses.
examples.zh: 我收藏了「紧急情况信息页」，因为它列出了三个校区的通知。

collocations: link to the emergency information page

words.enDefinition: a two-way communication device for speaking to staff in an emergency

examples.en: The porter answered through the emergency intercom next to the parking lift doors.
examples.zh: 门房通过停车场电梯门旁的「紧急对讲装置」应答。

examples.en: The label on the emergency intercom identified the team that answers calls overnight.
examples.zh: 「紧急对讲装置」上的标签写明了夜间负责接听的团队。

words.enDefinition: Lighting that provides illumination when the normal lighting fails.

examples.en: Facilities staff tested the emergency lighting while the hall was empty on Friday morning.
examples.zh: 星期五早上大厅空着时，设施管理人员测试了「应急照明」。

examples.en: The emergency lighting in the stairwell made the steps visible during the maintenance check.
examples.zh: 维护检查期间，楼梯间的「应急照明」照亮了台阶。

words.enDefinition: An official written announcement giving essential information about an emergency.

examples.en: An emergency notice on the library door listed the closed areas and a time for the next update.
examples.zh: 图书馆门上的「紧急通告」列出了关闭区域和下次更新的时间。

examples.en: The emergency notice on the website included a short statement from the facilities team.
examples.zh: 网站上的「紧急通告」包含设施管理团队的一份简短说明。

collocations: an emergency notice on the door

words.enDefinition: a phone number used to contact services that respond to emergencies

examples.en: The local emergency number is printed inside the front cover of our orientation booklet.
examples.zh: 当地的「紧急求助号码」印在我们的迎新手册封面内侧。

examples.en: I saved the campus security desk separately from the national emergency number on my phone.
examples.zh: 我在手机里分别存了校园安保值班电话和全国通用的「紧急求助号码」。

words.enDefinition: Planning and training done in advance to be ready for emergencies.

examples.en: The university added a short session on emergency preparedness to orientation week this year.
examples.zh: 今年，大学在迎新周增加了一节简短的「应急准备」课程。

examples.en: Our residence meeting covered emergency preparedness and explained where safety notices were usually posted.
examples.zh: 宿舍会议讲到了「应急准备」，还说明了安全通告通常贴在哪里。

words.enDefinition: public services that respond to incidents needing urgent help

examples.en: The residence staff notified emergency services after discovering smoke in the laundry room.
examples.zh: 宿舍工作人员发现洗衣房冒烟后，通知了「应急救援部门」。

examples.en: An open gate gave emergency services direct access to the courtyard at night.
examples.zh: 夜里大门开着，「应急救援部门」可以直接进入院子。

words.enDefinition: A stairwell identified as part of a building's emergency exit route.

examples.en: The emergency stairwell was shown in green on the plan beside the auditorium doors.
examples.zh: 礼堂门旁的平面图用绿色标出了「应急楼梯间」。

examples.en: Our building tour ended in the lobby next to the sign for the emergency stairwell.
examples.zh: 楼宇参观在大厅结束，旁边就是「应急楼梯间」的指示牌。

collocations: a door to the emergency stairwell

words.enDefinition: a service that accepts requests for emergency help by text message

examples.en: The accessibility guide explains where the emergency text service is available to visitors.
examples.zh: 无障碍指南说明了访客可以在哪里使用「紧急短信求助服务」。

examples.en: The support worker checked whether the emergency text service covered our part of town.
examples.zh: 助理查了一下「紧急短信求助服务」是否覆盖我们所在的城区。

words.enDefinition: a route or clearance that allows emergency vehicles to reach a location

examples.en: The orientation team moved their van away from the emergency vehicle access beside campus.
examples.zh: 迎新团队把面包车从校园旁的「应急车辆通道」挪开。

examples.en: The building plan marked emergency vehicle access between the loading bay and the gate.
examples.zh: 平面图在装卸区和大门之间标出了「应急车辆通道」。

words.enDefinition: travelling toward a place and having not yet arrived

examples.en: The campus security officer was en route when I noticed the gate was locked.
examples.zh: 我发现大门锁着时，校园安保人员还「在路上」。

examples.en: The crew received the new room number while en route to the hall.
examples.zh: 救援队「在赶往宿舍楼的路上」收到了更新后的房间号。

words.enDefinition: the first letters of a person's names cut into an item

examples.en: The engraved initials matched my brother's name, but the rest of the keyring looked different.
examples.zh: 「刻上的姓名首字母」和我哥哥的名字对得上，不过钥匙圈其他地方看起来不一样。

examples.en: A photograph of the engraved initials helped me describe the watch to staff.
examples.zh: 我拿着「刻上的姓名首字母」的照片，把手表的特征讲给工作人员听。

words.enDefinition: a status indicating an organization has stopped processing a request for information

examples.en: The page showed enquiry closed after I confirmed I had collected the item.
examples.zh: 我确认取到物品后，页面显示「查询已结束」。

examples.en: I received an enquiry closed message after the station replied that nothing matched my description.
examples.zh: 车站回复没有符合描述的物品后，我收到了一条「查询已结束」的消息。

words.enDefinition: The predicted time when a disrupted service may return

examples.en: The estimated restoration time changed between the morning and evening notices.
examples.zh: 早间和晚间通知中的「预计恢复时间」不同。

examples.en: I asked whether the estimated restoration time applied to our street.
examples.zh: 我问「预计恢复时间」是否适用于我们的街道。

words.enDefinition: To leave a place because conditions are unsafe or may become unsafe.

examples.en: The announcement explained why we had to evacuate halfway through the afternoon study session.
examples.zh: 广播解释了为什么我们下午自习到一半就得「疏散」。

examples.en: Our group practiced how to evacuate during a scheduled exercise at the student center.
examples.zh: 我们小组在学生活动中心的例行演练中练习了如何「疏散」。

words.enDefinition: A signal indicating that people are expected to leave a building or area.

examples.en: We heard the evacuation alarm during the afternoon rehearsal for the campus safety exercise.
examples.zh: 下午校园安全演习预演时，我们听到了「疏散警报」。

examples.en: The video played a sample of the evacuation alarm used in the student residences.
examples.zh: 视频播放了学生宿舍所用「疏散警报」的样音。

words.enDefinition: Help provided to someone who needs support to leave a building in an emergency.

examples.en: A student asked about evacuation assistance before booking a room for the evening workshop.
examples.zh: 一名学生为晚间研讨活动订房间前，询问了「疏散协助」的安排。

examples.en: The accessibility guide explained what evacuation assistance was available during events in the auditorium.
examples.zh: 无障碍指南说明了在礼堂举办活动时可获得哪些「疏散协助」。

words.enDefinition: A specialized chair designed to help trained people move someone who cannot use stairs independently.

examples.en: The building guide showed the location of an evacuation chair on the second floor.
examples.zh: 楼宇指南标明了二楼一把「疏散椅」的位置。

examples.en: An evacuation chair was shown in the diagram next to the building's accessibility features.
examples.zh: 楼宇无障碍设施旁的示意图里画有一把「疏散椅」。

words.enDefinition: A lift specifically designed and designated for use as part of a building evacuation plan.

examples.en: The building plan marked the evacuation lift separately from the regular lifts in the lobby.
examples.zh: 楼宇平面图把「疏散电梯」与大厅里的普通电梯分别标出。

examples.en: Our campus tour guide explained why the new building had a separate evacuation lift.
examples.zh: 校园参观的向导解释了新楼为什么配有单独的「疏散电梯」。

collocations: an evacuation lift in the floor plan

words.enDefinition: A diagram showing routes, exits, or other locations relevant to leaving a building in an emergency.

examples.en: The evacuation map near the lift showed the exits on our floor in green.
examples.zh: 电梯旁的「疏散示意图」用绿色标明了我们这层楼的出口。

examples.en: The school replaced the evacuation map after the old reception area was turned into classrooms.
examples.zh: 原来的接待区改成教室后，学校换了新的「疏散示意图」。

collocations: an evacuation map for the floor

words.enDefinition: An official instruction requiring the people in a specified place to leave.

examples.en: The notice included an evacuation order for the main library and the attached offices.
examples.zh: 通知中包含针对主图书馆及相连办公室的「疏散令」。

examples.en: The university lifted the evacuation order and posted a separate update about the reading rooms.
examples.zh: 大学撤销了「疏散令」，并单独发布了一条关于阅览室的通报。

collocations: an evacuation order for one building

words.enDefinition: The established steps for leaving a place safely during an emergency.

examples.en: The residence handbook explained the evacuation procedure before listing the building's quiet hours and guest rules.
examples.zh: 宿舍手册先介绍「疏散程序」，再列出楼内的安静时段和访客规则。

examples.en: Our tutor reviewed the evacuation procedure when the seminar moved to a different building.
examples.zh: 研讨课换到另一栋楼后，导师带我们复习了「疏散程序」。

words.enDefinition: A planned path for leaving a building or area during an emergency.

examples.en: The map on the wall showed the evacuation route from our floor to the courtyard.
examples.zh: 墙上的地图标出了从我们所在楼层通往庭院的「疏散路线」。

examples.en: We noticed the evacuation route changed after the hall reopened with a new entrance.
examples.zh: 大厅启用新入口重新开放后，我们发现「疏散路线」变了。

words.enDefinition: The amount of time people take to leave a place during an evacuation or drill.

examples.en: The observer recorded the evacuation time on a clipboard after our group reached the courtyard.
examples.zh: 我们小组到达庭院后，观察员在写字板上记录了「疏散用时」。

examples.en: The report compared the evacuation time for each floor during the two practice sessions.
examples.zh: 报告对比了两次练习中每层楼的「疏散用时」。

words.enDefinition: A designated person who helps coordinate an evacuation for a building or area.

examples.en: The evacuation warden wore a labeled vest throughout the drill at the student union.
examples.zh: 学生活动中心演习期间，「疏散负责人」全程穿着带标识的背心。

examples.en: Our new staff guide listed the evacuation warden for every floor of the building.
examples.zh: 我们的新员工指南列出了楼内每一层的「疏散负责人」。

words.enDefinition: An area identified as a separate section in an evacuation plan or notice.

examples.en: The diagram marked each evacuation zone in a different color for the upcoming exercise.
examples.zh: 为即将举行的演习，示意图用不同颜色标出了每个「疏散分区」。

examples.en: Staff confirmed that the south corridor belonged to a different evacuation zone from the lobby.
examples.zh: 工作人员确认，南走廊与大厅属于不同的「疏散分区」。

collocations: an evacuation zone on the map

words.enDefinition: a medical responder assigned to an organized event

examples.en: An event medic was already talking to the runner when I reached the tent.
examples.zh: 我赶到帐篷时，一名「活动现场医护人员」已经在和那位跑步者说话了。

examples.en: One event medic wore a bright vest with the festival logo on it.
examples.zh: 一名「活动现场医护人员」穿着印有节日标志的亮色背心。

words.enDefinition: the precise place where a person or thing is situated

examples.en: Mina described the exact location of the locked gate using a nearby sign.
examples.zh: 米娜借助附近的标志说明了锁着的那扇门的「确切位置」。

examples.en: The operator confirmed our exact location before sending a message to the crew.
examples.zh: 接线员先确认了我们的「确切位置」，随后给救援队发了消息。

words.enDefinition: The time a place is expected to open again after a closure.

examples.en: We checked the expected reopening time before deciding whether to wait for the library.
examples.zh: 决定是否等图书馆开放前，我们查看了「预计重新开放时间」。

examples.en: The expected reopening time was shown at the bottom of the notice beside the entrance.
examples.zh: 「预计重新开放时间」写在入口旁告示的底部。

words.enDefinition: A brief record grouping costs connected with a particular event

examples.en: I used my expense summary to explain the additional costs.
examples.zh: 我用自己的「开支汇总」来说明这些额外开支。

examples.en: The adviser kept the expense summary alongside the detailed receipts.
examples.zh: 顾问把「开支汇总」与详细收据放在一起保存。

words.enDefinition: How much property was damaged and how seriously it was affected

examples.en: The inspection report described the extent of damage on two separate pages.
examples.zh: 检查报告用了两页来描述「受损范围与程度」。

examples.en: The adviser asked whether the extent of damage was clear from the photos.
examples.zh: 顾问问，从照片上能不能看清「受损范围与程度」。

words.enDefinition: An official alert for dangerously cold temperatures or wind chill

examples.en: The extreme cold warning appeared beside the revised bus service hours.
examples.zh: 「极寒警告」出现在调整后的公交运营时间旁边。

examples.en: The college referred to an extreme cold warning in its morning message.
examples.zh: 学院在早间消息中提到了一条「极寒警告」。

collocations: an area under an extreme cold warning

words.enDefinition: An official alert for dangerous heat expected or already occurring

examples.en: The extreme heat warning was listed above the switch to indoor events.
examples.zh: 举行室内活动的调整说明上方列出了「极端高温警告」。

examples.en: The city included the extreme heat warning in its announcement about park hours.
examples.zh: 市政府在公告公园开放时间时提到了「极端高温警告」。

collocations: an area under an extreme heat warning

words.enDefinition: a shaped dressing designed to cover an eye

examples.en: The eye pad was in a separate sleeve at the top of the kit.
examples.zh: 「眼部敷垫」单独装在急救包上方的一个套袋里。

examples.en: I asked whether the sealed eye pad belonged with the other dressings.
examples.zh: 我问这片没拆封的「眼部敷垫」是否应该和其他敷料放在一起。

words.enDefinition: a fixed facility for rinsing material from the eyes

examples.en: The lab tour included the eyewash station near the double doors by the entrance.
examples.zh: 实验室参观时介绍了入口对开门旁的「紧急洗眼装置」。

examples.en: The technician checked that the eyewash station was marked on the new floor plan.
examples.zh: 技术员核对了新平面图上是否标出了「紧急洗眼装置」。

collocations: a sign for the eyewash station

words.enDefinition: a person who saw an event happen

examples.en: The dispatcher asked whether the caller was an eyewitness to the incident outside.
examples.zh: 调度员问来电者是不是外面那件事的「亲眼目击者」。

examples.en: The first eyewitness described what she saw from the front of the bus.
examples.zh: 第一位「亲眼目击者」描述了她在车头看到的情况。

words.enDefinition: to drop unexpectedly from a place above ground level

examples.en: The tutor asked whether she had seen anyone fall from a height outside.
examples.zh: 导师问她有没有看见外面有人「从高处坠落」。

examples.en: You couldn't see anyone fall from a height from where we were standing.
examples.zh: 从我们站的位置看不到有人「从高处坠落」。

collocations: fall from a height at work
fall from a height onto concrete
see someone fall from a height

words.enDefinition: Branches that have fallen from trees and may obstruct routes

examples.en: The park notice mentioned fallen branches on the northern path.
examples.zh: 公园通知说北边小路上有「掉落的树枝」。

examples.en: The campus crew listed fallen branches in its grounds report.
examples.zh: 校园维护人员在场地报告中列出了「掉落的树枝」。

words.enDefinition: An alarm that signals danger when there is no active danger in the situation.

examples.en: The campus update called it a false alarm after staff checked the lecture halls.
examples.zh: 工作人员检查阶梯教室后，校园通报称这是一次「误报」。

examples.en: It took a few minutes for the residence team to confirm the false alarm.
examples.zh: 宿舍管理团队花了几分钟才确认是「误报」。

collocations: a report of a false alarm

words.enDefinition: A status indicating the cause of a fault is being examined

examples.en: The provider showed "Fault under investigation" rather than listing a cause.
examples.zh: 供电方显示「故障正在调查中」，原因一栏暂时为空。

examples.en: The message "Fault under investigation" was posted early that morning.
examples.zh: 「故障正在调查中」的消息是那天一早发的。

collocations: a notice saying fault under investigation
a case marked fault under investigation
an update reading fault under investigation

words.enDefinition: A temporary stop in a ferry's regular service

examples.en: The port announced a ferry suspension after the wind warning.
examples.zh: 港口在强风警告后宣布「渡轮暂停运营」。

examples.en: The ferry suspension was posted above the usual weekend timetable.
examples.zh: 「渡轮暂停运营」的公告贴在常规周末时刻表上面。

collocations: a notice about a ferry suspension

words.enDefinition: An agreement or decision resolving the remaining amounts in a claim

examples.en: The final settlement was listed separately from the earlier payment.
examples.zh: 「最终理赔结算」与先前的付款分开列出。

examples.en: I read the letter explaining the final settlement for my claim.
examples.zh: 我阅读了说明我的案件「最终理赔结算」的信件。

collocations: a letter giving the final settlement

words.enDefinition: A posted notice describing a building's procedures in the event of a fire.

examples.en: I saw the fire action notice while waiting for my room keys at reception.
examples.zh: 在接待台等着领房间钥匙时，我看到了「火灾应对告示」。

examples.en: The fire action notice in our seminar room identified the assembly point in bold type.
examples.zh: 我们研讨室里的「火灾应对告示」用粗体标出了集合点。

collocations: a fire action notice near the stairs

words.enDefinition: A signal that warns occupants of a possible fire in a building.

examples.en: The fire alarm sounded during open studio hours, and the instructor paused our session.
examples.zh: 开放工作室期间响起了「火灾警报」，老师暂停了我们的活动。

examples.en: A notice at reception explained that the fire alarm would be tested on Wednesday.
examples.zh: 接待处的告示说明，星期三会测试「火灾警报」。

words.enDefinition: a device, often with a push panel in the UK, used to trigger a building fire alarm

examples.en: The UK campus map marked the fire alarm call point beside the stairwell door.
examples.zh: 英国这所大学的校园地图在楼梯间门旁标出了「手动火灾报警点」。

examples.en: I recognised the red fire alarm call point from a photograph in our orientation guide.
examples.zh: 我从迎新指南的一张照片里认出了红色的「手动火灾报警点」。

collocations: mark the fire alarm call point
a fire alarm call point on the wall
identify a fire alarm call point

words.enDefinition: A panel that displays the status of a building's fire alarm system.

examples.en: The caretaker showed our orientation group the fire alarm panel beside the reception desk.
examples.zh: 管理员给我们新生小组看了接待台旁的「火灾报警控制面板」。

examples.en: Facilities staff checked the fire alarm panel while the student center was still closed.
examples.zh: 学生活动中心还没开放时，设施管理人员检查了「火灾报警控制面板」。

collocations: an indicator on the fire alarm panel

words.enDefinition: A wall-mounted device with a handle for manually signaling a fire alarm.

examples.en: The orientation guide included a picture of a fire alarm pull station in the lobby.
examples.zh: 新生指南里有一张大厅内「手拉式火灾报警装置」的照片。

examples.en: On our tour, the guide identified a fire alarm pull station near the stairwell.
examples.zh: 参观时，向导指明了楼梯间附近的「手拉式火灾报警装置」。

collocations: label a fire alarm pull station
a fire alarm pull station by the exit
inspect a fire alarm pull station

words.enDefinition: A piece of fire-resistant material intended to cover a small fire.

examples.en: The studio inventory included a fire blanket near the sink and one by the door.
examples.zh: 工作室的物品清单上，水槽旁和门边各有一条「灭火毯」。

examples.en: The residence handbook had a photograph of the fire blanket in the shared kitchen.
examples.zh: 宿舍手册里有一张公共厨房内「灭火毯」的照片。

collocations: a fire blanket in the lab

words.enDefinition: Physical harm to property caused directly by fire

examples.en: The building report described fire damage in a storage area downstairs.
examples.zh: 大楼报告描述了楼下储物区的「火灾损坏」。

examples.en: I asked which page contained the description of the fire damage.
examples.zh: 我问哪一页写了「火灾损坏」的情况。

words.enDefinition: A door designed to limit the spread of fire and smoke between spaces.

examples.en: A sticker identified the heavy door near the downstairs stairwell as a fire door.
examples.zh: 楼下楼梯间附近那扇厚重的门上贴着标签，注明是「防火门」。

examples.en: We saw a fire door on the campus safety tour of the new theater.
examples.zh: 我们参加新剧院的校园安全参观时，看到了一扇「防火门」。

words.enDefinition: A sign indicating that a fire door is meant to stay closed.

examples.en: The notice on the workshop door said “Fire door keep shut” above the handle.
examples.zh: 工作间的门把手上方贴着「防火门请保持关闭」的告示。

examples.en: The student handbook showed a photograph with the words “Fire door keep shut” clearly visible.
examples.zh: 学生手册里的照片上清楚地写着「防火门请保持关闭」。

collocations: a fire door keep shut sign
a label reading fire door keep shut

words.enDefinition: A practice exercise for responding to a fire alarm, often including evacuation.

examples.en: We had a fire drill on the first morning of the summer language course.
examples.zh: 暑期语言课程的第一天上午，我们参加了「消防演习」。

examples.en: The residence staff discussed the fire drill at our meeting in the common room.
examples.zh: 宿舍工作人员在公共休息室的会议上谈到了「消防演习」。

collocations: take part in a fire drill

words.enDefinition: A portable device designed to put out a small fire.

examples.en: A campus map marked the fire extinguisher beside the main entrance to the ceramics studio.
examples.zh: 校园地图标出了陶艺工作室正门旁的「灭火器」。

examples.en: The facilities team checked the tag on each fire extinguisher in the residence hall.
examples.zh: 设施管理团队检查了宿舍楼里每个「灭火器」上的标签。

words.enDefinition: A wall cabinet that houses a fire extinguisher.

examples.en: The fire extinguisher cabinet stood out clearly against the pale wall near the snack machines.
examples.zh: 零食售货机附近，浅色墙上的「灭火器箱」特别显眼。

examples.en: The housing team replaced the cracked glass on the fire extinguisher cabinet in our hallway.
examples.zh: 宿舍管理团队换掉了我们走廊里「灭火器箱」上开裂的玻璃。

words.enDefinition: A condition or object that increases the risk of a fire or makes it more dangerous.

examples.en: The inspection report identified the damaged cable under the table as a potential fire hazard.
examples.zh: 检查报告将桌下那根破损电线认定为一处潜在的「火灾隐患」。

examples.en: Our residence orientation included photos to show what staff meant by a fire hazard.
examples.zh: 宿舍说明会用了几张照片来说明工作人员所说的「火灾隐患」指什么。

words.enDefinition: A marked lane kept open for fire service vehicles to reach a building.

examples.en: The fire lane was marked in red outside the entrance to our residence hall.
examples.zh: 我们宿舍楼入口外的「消防通道」用红色标出。

examples.en: A sign identified the narrow driveway beside the service entrance as a fire lane.
examples.zh: 一块标牌注明，后勤入口旁的狭窄车道是「消防通道」。

words.enDefinition: Equipment intended to detect, warn about, or help control a fire.

examples.en: The campus fire safety equipment shown in the booklet included alarms and a fire blanket.
examples.zh: 手册上展示的校园「消防设备」包括报警器和灭火毯。

examples.en: A facilities employee updated the inspection list for the fire safety equipment in our building.
examples.zh: 一名设施管理人员更新了我们楼内「消防设备」的检查清单。

words.enDefinition: A review of a location and its equipment for fire safety conditions.

examples.en: The fire safety inspection started after the last group finished using the rehearsal rooms.
examples.zh: 最后一组用完排练室后，开始了「消防安全检查」。

examples.en: A fire safety inspection report listed the dates for repairs to several damaged signs.
examples.zh: 「消防安全检查」报告列出了几块损坏告示牌的维修日期。

words.enDefinition: the organization responsible for responding to fires and related emergencies

examples.en: The fire service visited our residence hall during the campus safety fair.
examples.zh: 在校园安全宣传活动期间，「消防部门」来到了我们的宿舍楼。

examples.en: The fire service sent an officer to speak with the building manager afterward.
examples.zh: 事后，「消防部门」派了一位消防人员和楼宇管理员沟通。

words.enDefinition: A network of devices that releases water when appropriate fire conditions are detected.

examples.en: The fire sprinkler system at the library was listed in the facilities inspection summary.
examples.zh: 图书馆的「自动喷水灭火系统」列在设施检查摘要中。

examples.en: The tour explained why the new dormitory included a fire sprinkler system on every floor.
examples.zh: 参观时，向导解释了新宿舍每层都设有「自动喷水灭火系统」的原因。

collocations: a building with a fire sprinkler system

words.enDefinition: A US alert that critical conditions for wildfire may develop

examples.en: The fire weather watch covered the area near our field station.
examples.zh: 「火险天气监视通报」涵盖了我们野外工作站附近的区域。

examples.en: I checked whether the park was listed under the fire weather watch.
examples.zh: 我查了这座公园是否列在「火险天气监视通报」范围内。

collocations: a fire weather watch for the area
a county under a fire weather watch

words.enDefinition: arrangements for trained help to be available during an event

examples.en: Our club president asked about first aid cover for the open day.
examples.zh: 社团负责人询问了开放日的「现场急救保障」安排。

examples.en: The organiser confirmed that there would be first aid cover throughout the tournament.
examples.zh: 组织者确认比赛全程都会有「现场急救保障」。

collocations: first aid cover for an event

words.enDefinition: a container holding supplies for immediate basic assistance

examples.en: The receptionist pointed out a first aid kit behind the library information desk.
examples.zh: 图书馆咨询台的工作人员指了指柜台后面的「急救包」。

examples.en: Our tutor asked whether the first aid kit traveled with us on field trips.
examples.zh: 导师问我们外出考察时会不会随身带上「急救包」。

words.enDefinition: a room set aside for basic assistance on site

examples.en: The sports centre's first aid room was beside the accessible changing rooms.
examples.zh: 体育中心的「急救室」就在无障碍更衣室旁边。

examples.en: The sign for the first aid room was partly hidden by the open door.
examples.zh: 「急救室」的标牌被敞开的门挡住了一部分。

collocations: directions to the first aid room
a sign for the first aid room

words.enDefinition: a sign identifying where basic assistance or equipment is available

examples.en: A green first aid sign was visible at the end of the corridor.
examples.zh: 走廊尽头可以看到一个绿色的「急救标志」。

examples.en: I spotted the first aid sign above a door behind the reception desk.
examples.zh: 我看见接待台后面的一扇门上方有「急救标志」。

words.enDefinition: a designated place offering basic help at a venue

examples.en: The map showed a first aid station next to the festival's volunteer tent.
examples.zh: 地图上标明节日志愿者帐篷旁有一个「现场急救点」。

examples.en: I asked the event steward where to find the first aid station.
examples.zh: 我问活动现场的引导员到哪里能找到「现场急救点」。

words.enDefinition: materials kept on hand for basic immediate help

examples.en: The evening custodian showed me where the first aid supplies were stored.
examples.zh: 晚班管理员告诉我「急救用品」存放在哪里。

examples.en: Our department keeps extra first aid supplies in a locked cupboard downstairs.
examples.zh: 我们系在楼下上锁的柜子里备了额外的「急救用品」。

collocations: a checklist of first aid supplies
a cupboard for first aid supplies

words.enDefinition: a person trained and designated to give basic first aid at a venue or workplace

examples.en: The receptionist radioed a first aider after a visitor fell in the foyer.
examples.zh: 一位访客在门厅摔倒后，接待员用对讲机联系了「受训急救员」。

examples.en: A first aider spoke with the student near the end of the match.
examples.zh: 比赛快结束时，一名「受训急救员」和那位学生交谈了几句。

words.enDefinition: An initial report informing an insurer that a loss occurred

examples.en: The insurer listed the first notice of loss separately from my later statement.
examples.zh: 保险公司把「首次报损通知」与我后来的陈述分开列出。

examples.en: I checked the first notice of loss for the date of our call.
examples.zh: 我核对了「首次报损通知」上记录的通话日期。

collocations: record the first notice of loss
receive a first notice of loss
details in a first notice of loss

words.enDefinition: a trained person who is among the first to provide emergency help

examples.en: A first responder met us outside the gym and spoke to the coach.
examples.zh: 一名「现场应急人员」在体育馆外与我们会合，并和教练谈了谈。

examples.en: The first witness gave a brief account to the first responder on arrival.
examples.zh: 「现场应急人员」到达后，第一位目击者简要说明了情况。

collocations: provide information to a first responder

words.enDefinition: A description from someone who directly experienced or observed an event

examples.en: The report included a firsthand account from a student who saw the damage.
examples.zh: 报告里有一位看到受损情况的学生提供的「亲历者的陈述」。

examples.en: The coordinator asked which part of my statement was a firsthand account.
examples.zh: 协调员问我的陈述中哪部分是「亲历者的陈述」。

collocations: a firsthand account of the event

words.enDefinition: to label an item or document in a record as missing or stolen

examples.en: The adviser explained which record the system would flag as lost or stolen after review.
examples.zh: 顾问解释了审核后系统会把哪条记录「标记为遗失或被盗」。

examples.en: The form asked which of my two cards to flag as lost or stolen.
examples.zh: 表格问我两张卡中要把哪张「标记为遗失或被盗」。

collocations: flag a card as lost or stolen
flag a document as lost or stolen
flag an item as lost or stolen

words.enDefinition: A US alert for rapid flooding expected or already occurring

examples.en: The flash flood warning mentioned rapid flooding along a low stretch of road.
examples.zh: 「突发洪水警告」提到一处低洼路段迅速被水淹没。

examples.en: The county put a flash flood warning above its road closure updates.
examples.zh: 县里把「突发洪水警告」放在道路封闭信息上方。

collocations: an area under a flash flood warning

words.enDefinition: A US alert indicating conditions may cause flooding in an area

examples.en: The flood watch included the district where my study group met.
examples.zh: 「洪水监视通报」涵盖了学习小组碰面的那个区。

examples.en: The adviser checked the flood watch before changing the field trip date.
examples.zh: 顾问先看了「洪水监视通报」，再调整实地考察的日期。

collocations: a flood watch for low areas
a county under a flood watch

words.enDefinition: A road partly or fully covered by flood water

examples.en: The bus company named a flooded road in its service update.
examples.zh: 公交公司在更新中点明了一条「被洪水淹没的道路」。

examples.en: I saw a flooded road marked beside the main junction.
examples.zh: 我看到主路口旁标了一条「被洪水淹没的道路」。

collocations: a route affected by a flooded road
a map showing a flooded road

words.enDefinition: a number used to identify one level of a building

examples.en: The dispatcher repeated the floor number to make sure she had heard it correctly.
examples.zh: 调度员复述了「楼层号」，确认自己没有听错。

examples.en: The building directory lists the floor number next to each department's name upstairs.
examples.zh: 楼内导览牌把「楼层号」标在对应的部门名称旁边。

words.enDefinition: A person assigned to coordinate emergency procedures for a particular floor.

examples.en: The floor warden joined our class briefly to explain what the drill would sound like.
examples.zh: 「楼层安全负责人」来我们班简单说了演习时会听到什么声音。

examples.en: The list outside the stairwell identified the floor warden assigned to the computer labs.
examples.zh: 楼梯间外的名单注明了负责机房的「楼层安全负责人」。

collocations: floor warden for the second floor

words.enDefinition: A later report giving updates about an event already recorded

examples.en: The property office sent a follow-up report after checking the room again.
examples.zh: 物业办公室再次查看房间后，发来一份「后续情况报告」。

examples.en: I compared the follow-up report with the original message from reception.
examples.zh: 我把「后续情况报告」与前台最初发来的消息作了比较。

collocations: a follow-up report about the incident

words.enDefinition: Help provided after an initial meeting or response to an incident

examples.en: The office described follow-up support in a letter after our meeting.
examples.zh: 会面结束后，办公室在信中介绍了「后续支持」。

examples.en: I asked who would provide follow-up support during the next week.
examples.zh: 我问接下来一周由谁提供「后续支持」。

words.enDefinition: The extent to which forecasters are sure about a prediction

examples.en: The forecast confidence differed between the morning and afternoon updates.
examples.zh: 早间和下午更新所示的「预报置信度」不同。

examples.en: The bulletin showed forecast confidence separately from the expected impact.
examples.zh: 公报把「预报置信度」与预计影响分开显示。

words.enDefinition: items someone has found after their owners lost them

examples.en: The residence desk keeps found property in a locked cupboard behind the counter.
examples.zh: 宿舍服务台把「拾获物品」保存在柜台后上锁的柜子里。

examples.en: The website lists recent found property without showing details that identify the owners.
examples.zh: 网站列出了最近的「拾获物品」，没有显示能辨认物主的信息。

words.enDefinition: to make a telephone line available for other calls

examples.en: The receptionist moved a routine call to another phone to free up the line.
examples.zh: 前台接待员把一通普通电话转到另一部电话上，好「腾出电话线路」。

examples.en: I used my mobile to free up the line at the busy front desk.
examples.zh: 我改用手机，好给忙碌的前台「腾出电话线路」。

collocations: free up the line for incoming calls
move a routine call to free up the line

words.enDefinition: Rain that freezes after coming into contact with cold surfaces

examples.en: The forecast listed freezing rain before the temperature dropped that evening.
examples.zh: 当晚气温下降之前，预报已列出可能出现「冻雨」。

examples.en: The maintenance report described ice left by freezing rain on the walkways.
examples.zh: 维护报告描述了人行道上因「冻雨」留下的冰。

words.enDefinition: A period during which supplied gas is unavailable to users

examples.en: The provider issued a notice about a gas service interruption downtown.
examples.zh: 供气方发布了市区「供气中断」的通知。

examples.en: I checked whether our building was affected by the gas service interruption.
examples.zh: 我查了我们大楼是否受到「供气中断」的影响。

collocations: a notice about a gas service interruption
updates during a gas service interruption

words.enDefinition: a small square of woven fabric used as a dressing

examples.en: The sealed gauze pad was tucked into the side pocket of the kit.
examples.zh: 没拆封的「纱布垫」塞在急救包的侧袋里。

examples.en: I could read the words gauze pad through the clear lid of the box.
examples.zh: 透过透明盒盖，我能看见包装上写的「纱布垫」。

words.enDefinition: to have a tiny sharp piece, often wood, pierce the skin

examples.en: Did you get a splinter while moving the old benches after practice?
examples.zh: 训练后搬旧长凳的时候，你「被木刺扎到了」吗？

examples.en: You can get a splinter from the unfinished wood on that workshop table.
examples.zh: 那张工坊工作台的木料没打磨，容易让人「被木刺扎到」。

collocations: get a splinter in your palm
get a splinter from a bench
get a splinter in your thumb

words.enDefinition: to lose a telephone connection before the conversation is finished

examples.en: If we get cut off, the front desk has my building and room number.
examples.zh: 要是我们「通话中断」，前台留有我的楼号和房号。

examples.en: I didn't want to get cut off again while moving between the two buildings.
examples.zh: 我不想在穿过两栋楼之间时再一次「通话中断」。

words.enDefinition: to fetch a staff member from a reception desk

examples.en: Could you get someone from reception to come downstairs for a moment?
examples.zh: 你能「去前台找个人下楼来」一下吗？

examples.en: My classmate went to get someone from reception while I explained the situation.
examples.zh: 我在说明情况时，同学「去前台找人过来」。

collocations: go and get someone from reception
ask someone to get someone from reception
get someone from reception to come upstairs

words.enDefinition: to have dust, grit or another object enter an eye

examples.en: Did you get something in your eye when the wind picked up?
examples.zh: 刚才刮起风的时候，你「眼里进了东西」吗？

examples.en: It's easy to get something in your eye when the practice field gets dusty.
examples.zh: 训练场上尘土飞起来时，很容易「眼里进东西」。

collocations: get something in your eye outdoors
get something in your eye while cycling
think you might get something in your eye

words.enDefinition: to go and bring a teacher to where help is needed

examples.en: Could you get the teacher while I tell the receptionist what happened?
examples.zh: 你能「去找老师过来」吗？我来跟接待员说发生了什么。

examples.en: I went to get the teacher from the classroom across the hall.
examples.zh: 我去了对面教室，「把老师叫过来」。

collocations: ask someone to get the teacher
get the teacher from the next room

words.enDefinition: to rise after sitting or falling without another person's help

examples.en: Were you able to get up on your own after slipping outside the hall?
examples.zh: 你在礼堂外面滑倒后，能「自己站起来」吗？

examples.en: The coach asked if you could get up on your own after the fall.
examples.zh: 教练问，你摔倒后能不能「自己站起来」。

collocations: able to get up on your own
try to get up on your own
couldn't get up on your own

words.enDefinition: to tell someone the latest information about an ongoing situation

examples.en: I went back to give an update to the tutor who was still waiting.
examples.zh: 我回到还在等消息的导师那里，「说明最新情况」。

examples.en: The receptionist asked me to give an update when the first aider arrived.
examples.zh: 接待员让我在急救员到场后「说一下最新情况」。

collocations: give an update on the situation
give an update to the coordinator

words.expression: give me a moment to answer
words.lemma: give me a moment to answer
words.enDefinition: to allow the speaker a little time before they reply
acceptedEnVariants: give me a moment to answer

examples.en: Could you give me a moment to answer before asking the next question?
examples.zh: 问下一个问题之前，能「让我想一下再回答」吗？

examples.en: I asked her to give me a moment to answer while I found my phone.
examples.zh: 我在找手机，请她「给我一点时间再回答」。

collocations: please give me a moment to answer
can you give me a moment to answer
ask someone to give me a moment to answer

words.enDefinition: to step away so someone has more room or privacy

examples.en: The coach asked the gathering players to give them some space to speak privately.
examples.zh: 教练请围过来的队员「给他们留点空间」，好让他们单独谈谈。

examples.en: I stepped back to give them some space while they answered the officer.
examples.zh: 他们回答安全员的问题时，我往后退了退，「给他们留点空间」。

collocations: ask people to give them some space
step back to give them some space

words.enDefinition: to leave your location to find someone who can assist

examples.en: I offered to go for help because I knew where the staff room was.
examples.zh: 我知道员工休息室在哪，就主动说「去找人帮忙」。

examples.en: My friend told me she was going to go for help upstairs.
examples.zh: 朋友告诉我，她要到楼上「去找人帮忙」。

collocations: ask someone to go for help

words.enDefinition: to become loose and no longer hold your body upright

examples.en: I saw him go limp just as he reached the end of the bench.
examples.zh: 我看见他到长凳尽头时「全身突然发软」。

examples.en: The instructor asked what he was doing before I saw him go limp.
examples.zh: 教练问，我看见他「全身突然发软」之前，他在做什么。

words.enDefinition: a shallow area of skin scraped by a rough surface

examples.en: I showed the coach the graze on my elbow after the match.
examples.zh: 比赛结束后，我把胳膊肘上的「皮肤擦伤」给教练看了。

examples.en: The student said the mark above her sock was just an old graze.
examples.zh: 那名学生说，袜子上沿那道印子只是以前的「皮肤擦伤」。

words.enDefinition: the level at or roughly even with the ground outside a building

examples.en: The accessible entrance is at ground level beside the ramp near the road.
examples.zh: 无障碍入口在路边坡道旁的「地面层」。

examples.en: The staff member waited at ground level while her colleague checked the basement.
examples.zh: 工作人员在「地面层」等，同事去查看地下室。

words.enDefinition: to give a found possession to the staff responsible for returning it

examples.en: The student stopped at reception to hand in a lost item before class.
examples.zh: 上课前，那名学生顺路到前台「上交捡到的失物」。

examples.en: You can hand in a lost item at either counter in the station lobby.
examples.zh: 车站大厅的两个柜台都可以「上交捡到的失物」。

collocations: hand in a lost item at reception
hand in a lost item to staff
help someone hand in a lost item

words.enDefinition: to pass responsibility for a person or situation to someone else

examples.en: I waited to hand over to the campus staff who had just arrived.
examples.zh: 我等着跟刚到场的「校园工作人员交接」。

examples.en: The event volunteer was ready to hand over to the duty officer.
examples.zh: 活动志愿者做好了和「值班安全员交接」的准备。

collocations: prepare to hand over to staff
hand over to the person on duty
wait to hand over to a colleague

words.enDefinition: a paved strip beside a motorway used mainly for emergencies

examples.en: The coach stayed on the hard shoulder until the breakdown assistance team arrived.
examples.zh: 大巴停在「硬路肩」上，直到道路救援队赶来。

examples.en: I could see flashing lights on the hard shoulder beyond the next bend.
examples.zh: 我能看到下一个弯道过去一点的「硬路肩」上有灯在闪。

words.enDefinition: A US forecast summary describing possible weather hazards ahead

examples.en: The hazardous weather outlook covered the days of our planned student trip.
examples.zh: 「危险天气展望」涵盖了我们计划出游的那几天。

examples.en: The event page linked to a hazardous weather outlook for the region.
examples.zh: 活动页面附上了本地区「危险天气展望」的链接。

collocations: hazards in the hazardous weather outlook

words.enDefinition: physical harm to the head caused by an impact or accident

examples.en: I told the supervisor I was unsure whether there was a head injury.
examples.zh: 我告诉主管，我不确定他是否「头部伤情」。

examples.en: I wasn't close enough to tell whether he had a head injury.
examples.zh: 我离得不够近，看不清他「头部有没有受伤」。

collocations: a head injury after a fall

words.enDefinition: a small device that helps a person hear sounds

examples.en: The student said his hearing aid had fallen out near the bench.
examples.zh: 那位学生说，他的「助听器」掉在长凳附近了。

examples.en: I found a hearing aid case beside the bag she had left behind.
examples.zh: 我在她留下的包旁边发现了一个「助听器」盒。

words.enDefinition: a degree of hearing loss that can affect communication

examples.en: The student with a hearing impairment chose written messages at the busy reception desk.
examples.zh: 前台很忙，那名有「听力障碍」的学生选择通过文字交流。

examples.en: The operator asked what communication method worked best for the caller's hearing impairment.
examples.zh: 接线员询问哪种沟通方式最适合这位有「听力障碍」的来电者。

words.enDefinition: A US alert for potentially hazardous heat below warning severity

examples.en: The campus cited a heat advisory when changing the event venue.
examples.zh: 学校更改活动地点时提到了一条「高温注意提示」。

examples.en: I saw the heat advisory above the regular afternoon forecast.
examples.zh: 我在常规下午预报上方看到了「高温注意提示」。

collocations: a heat advisory for the area
a county under a heat advisory

words.enDefinition: A device that detects a high temperature or a rapid rise in temperature as a sign of fire.

examples.en: The building inventory listed a heat detector inside the kitchenette on the basement floor.
examples.zh: 楼宇设备清单上，地下层的小厨房内有一个「感温探测器」。

examples.en: The lab manager identified the heat detector on the ceiling when our group toured the facility.
examples.zh: 我们小组参观设施时，实验室管理员指认了天花板上的「感温探测器」。

collocations: a heat detector in the kitchen

words.enDefinition: An official alert about rain expected to fall heavily

examples.en: The forecast page showed a heavy rainfall warning over the region.
examples.zh: 预报页面在本地区显示了一条「强降雨警告」。

examples.en: The campus schedule mentioned a heavy rainfall warning in its update.
examples.zh: 校园日程更新中提到了一条「强降雨警告」。

collocations: remain under a heavy rainfall warning

words.enDefinition: stored with someone responsible for keeping the item safe until collection

examples.en: The wallet was held in safekeeping behind the desk until I came back.
examples.zh: 钱包一直在服务台后面「暂时妥善保管」，直到我回来。

examples.en: The email confirmed the phone would be held in safekeeping until Friday evening.
examples.zh: 邮件确认，手机会「暂时妥善保管」到周五傍晚。

collocations: keep an item held in safekeeping

words.enDefinition: a phrase introducing what the speaker actually witnessed

examples.en: “Here's what I saw,” I said when the officer asked me to start.
examples.zh: 安全员请我开始说，我开口道「我看到的是这样的」。

examples.en: My classmate said, “Here's what I saw,” and pointed toward the folding chairs.
examples.zh: 同学指了指那几把折叠椅，说「我看到的是这样的」。

collocations: “Here's what I saw from the doorway”
“Here's what I saw before I left”

words.enDefinition: Physical harm not apparent during a basic look at property

examples.en: The later report referred to hidden damage behind the panel.
examples.zh: 后来的报告提到了面板背后的「隐蔽损坏」。

examples.en: The adviser explained why the form mentioned possible hidden damage separately.
examples.zh: 顾问解释了表格为什么单独提到可能存在的「隐蔽损坏」。

words.enDefinition: An official alert that particularly strong winds are expected or occurring

examples.en: The US notice gave the start time of the high wind warning.
examples.zh: 美国通知写明了「强风警告」的开始时间。

examples.en: The library's closure note mentioned a high wind warning in the district.
examples.zh: 图书馆的闭馆通知提到这一地区有「强风警告」。

collocations: areas under a high wind warning

words.enDefinition: a ramp or turn that lets traffic leave a major road

examples.en: The passenger told the operator which highway exit the bus had just passed.
examples.zh: 乘客告诉接线员，大巴刚刚经过了哪个「公路出口」。

examples.en: The tow truck waited near the highway exit at the edge of town.
examples.zh: 拖车在城镇边缘的「公路出口」附近等着。

words.enDefinition: to make contact with the ground after falling

examples.en: I heard his shoulder hit the ground before I saw him lying there.
examples.zh: 我先听到他的肩膀「撞到地面」的声音，接着才看到他躺在那里。

examples.en: She saw his left elbow hit the ground as he fell sideways.
examples.zh: 她看见他往旁边倒下时，左肘「撞到了地面」。

words.enDefinition: to strike your head against something, often during a fall

examples.en: Did you hit your head on the doorframe or just your shoulder?
examples.zh: 你是「撞到了头」，还是只有肩膀撞上了门框？

examples.en: If you did hit your head, was it on the table or the floor?
examples.zh: 如果你确实「撞到了头」，是撞在桌子上还是地上？

collocations: hit your head on the floor
hit your head on a doorframe
hit your head during a fall

words.enDefinition: A record of belongings kept in a house or flat

examples.en: My flatmate had a home inventory that included our furniture.
examples.zh: 室友有份「家中财物清单」，上面列了我们的家具。

examples.en: The assessor asked when we last updated the home inventory.
examples.zh: 评估人员问我们上次更新「家中财物清单」是什么时候。

words.enDefinition: A US alert indicating hurricane conditions are expected in an area

examples.en: The hurricane warning appeared above the ferry operator's closure message.
examples.zh: 「飓风警告」显示在渡轮运营方的停运消息上方。

examples.en: The county bulletin referred to the hurricane warning in its opening paragraph.
examples.zh: 县里的公报在开头一段提到了「飓风警告」。

collocations: an area under a hurricane warning

words.enDefinition: A US alert indicating hurricane conditions are possible in an area

examples.en: The forecast added our coastal county to the hurricane watch.
examples.zh: 预报把我们所在的沿海县加入了「飓风监视通报」范围。

examples.en: The local ferry notice mentioned a hurricane watch for the coastline.
examples.zh: 本地渡轮通知提到沿岸有一条「飓风监视通报」。

collocations: a county under a hurricane watch

words.enDefinition: A collection of items needed for personal washing and care

examples.en: The residence office offered a hygiene kit to each affected resident.
examples.zh: 住宿办公室为每位受影响的居民提供了一个「个人清洁用品包」。

examples.en: I asked which supplies were included in the hygiene kit that evening.
examples.zh: 我问当晚提供的「个人清洁用品包」里有哪些东西。

words.enDefinition: a phrase saying that the other person's voice cannot be heard

examples.en: I can't hear you over the engine, so let me step outside first.
examples.zh: 引擎太响，「我听不见你说话」，我先到外面去。

examples.en: I can't hear you clearly where I am, but my friend can take the phone.
examples.zh: 我在这里「听不清你说话」，但我朋友可以接电话。

collocations: I can't hear you over the noise
I'm afraid I can't hear you

words.expression: I can't see without my glasses
words.lemma: i can't see without my glasses
words.enDefinition: a statement explaining that you need your glasses to see
acceptedEnVariants: I can't see without my glasses

examples.en: I can't see without my glasses, and I think they're under the chair.
examples.zh: 「不戴眼镜我看不清」，我想眼镜在椅子底下。

examples.en: “I can't see without my glasses,” he explained when she held up the form.
examples.zh: 她举起表格时，他解释道「不戴眼镜我看不清」。

collocations: say “I can't see without my glasses”
“I can't see without my glasses on”
“I can't see without my glasses, so could you read it aloud?”

words.expression: I'd like them to stay with me
words.lemma: i'd like them to stay with me
words.zhGloss: 我想让他们留下来陪我
words.enDefinition: a request for another person to remain present for support
acceptedZhAnswers: 我想让他们留下来陪我
acceptedEnVariants: I'd like them to stay with me

examples.en: “I'd like them to stay with me,” she said, pointing to her roommate.
examples.zh: 她指了指室友，说「我想让她留下来陪我」。

examples.en: The student told the staff member, “I'd like them to stay with me.”
examples.zh: 那位学生对工作人员说「我想让他们留下来陪我」。

collocations: say “I'd like them to stay with me”
“I'd like them to stay with me while we talk”
“I'd like them to stay with me a little longer”

words.enDefinition: a statement clarifying that the speaker did not witness the event

examples.en: I didn't see what happened, but I heard the chair fall behind me.
examples.zh: 「我没看见事情经过」，只听见身后有把椅子倒了。

examples.en: “I didn't see what happened,” I told the officer who came to the workshop.
examples.zh: 我告诉赶到工坊的安全员「我没看见事情经过」。

collocations: “I didn't see what happened before the fall”
“I didn't see what happened, but I heard it”

words.enDefinition: A US alert for expected disruptive ice accumulation from freezing rain

examples.en: The ice storm warning mentioned ice building up on roads and branches.
examples.zh: 「冰暴警告」提到了道路和树枝上结冰的情况。

examples.en: I read the ice storm warning before checking the shuttle timetable.
examples.zh: 我先看了「冰暴警告」，然后查看班车时刻表。

collocations: an area under an ice storm warning

words.enDefinition: a pickup notice saying the collector needs to show identification

examples.en: The email said “ID required for collection” below the address of the bus depot.
examples.zh: 邮件在公交总站的地址下方写了「领取时须出示证件」。

examples.en: I saw “ID required for collection” on the counter sign when I arrived.
examples.zh: 我到达时，看到柜台的标牌上写着「领取时须出示证件」。

collocations: the sign reads “ID required for collection”
a reminder that ID is required for collection

words.enDefinition: to find out who a particular item belongs to

examples.en: A name inside the jacket helped the staff identify the owner that afternoon.
examples.zh: 那天下午，工作人员凭夹克内侧的姓名「确认了物品主人」。

examples.en: The porter used the information on the luggage tag to identify the owner.
examples.zh: 门房利用行李牌上的信息「确认物品主人」。

collocations: use a receipt to identify the owner

words.enDefinition: to tell someone your name or role so they know who you are

examples.en: The operator said, "Please identify yourself before I transfer you to the duty officer."
examples.zh: 接线员说：“请先「说明你的身份」，我再把你转接给值班警员。”

examples.en: You can identify yourself as the residence adviser when the dispatcher answers the call.
examples.zh: 调度员接通时，你可以「说明你是」这栋宿舍的辅导员。

words.enDefinition: a detail that helps someone recognize a particular thing or person

examples.en: The broken clasp was the only identifying feature I could remember about my bracelet.
examples.zh: 我能记起的手链唯一「辨识特征」，就是有个坏掉的扣子。

examples.en: A patch on the sleeve provided an identifying feature for the otherwise plain coat.
examples.zh: 那件外套本来平平无奇，袖子上的一块补丁成了「辨识特征」。

words.enDefinition: in UK fraud reporting, using stolen personal details to deceive someone for gain

examples.en: The bank investigated possible identity fraud after receiving an application I did not recognise.
examples.zh: 银行收到一份我不知情的申请后，调查了可能的「冒用身份欺诈」。

examples.en: I saved the notice saying the identity fraud enquiry was still open on Friday.
examples.zh: 我保留了那份通知，上面说截至周五「冒用身份欺诈」调查尚未结束。

words.enDefinition: in UK fraud reporting, obtaining someone's personal details without their permission

examples.en: The adviser explained why identity theft was a concern after my documents went missing.
examples.zh: 顾问解释了证件遗失后，为什么要留意「身份资料被盗」。

examples.en: I saved the report about possible identity theft after discovering my ID was missing.
examples.zh: 我发现证件不见了，便存下了「身份资料可能被盗」的报告。

words.enDefinition: a threat that could cause harm right away

examples.en: The call handler asked whether anyone on the platform was in immediate danger.
examples.zh: 接线员询问站台上有没有人正面临「眼前的危险」。

examples.en: The updated message said nobody was in immediate danger at the residence hall.
examples.zh: 更新后的消息说，宿舍楼内无人面临「眼前的危险」。

words.enDefinition: A rating of the disruption or harm expected from a hazard

examples.en: The bulletin showed the impact level beside the expected start time.
examples.zh: 公报在预计开始时间旁标出了「影响程度」。

examples.en: I asked what the impact level meant for local bus services.
examples.zh: 我问这个「影响程度」对本地公交服务意味着什么。

collocations: an impact level in a warning

words.enDefinition: Words introducing the expected end time of an active alert

examples.en: The page said the warning was in effect until that evening.
examples.zh: 页面写明，该警告「持续生效至」当天晚上。

examples.en: I saw "In effect until tomorrow" beneath the map and checked the date.
examples.zh: 我在地图下看到「持续生效至明天」，就核对了日期。

collocations: a warning in effect until noon

words.enDefinition: the place where an incident happened or is happening

examples.en: The caller identified the incident location as a bus stop outside the library.
examples.zh: 来电者说「事件发生地点」是图书馆外的一个公交站。

examples.en: The dispatcher marked the incident location on a map beside the caller's address.
examples.zh: 调度员在地图上把「事件发生地点」标在来电者地址的旁边。

words.enDefinition: A chronological record of incidents kept by an organization

examples.en: The residence office added a short entry to its incident log.
examples.zh: 住宿办公室在「事故登记日志」里简短地记了一笔。

examples.en: The adviser checked which date appeared in our incident log.
examples.zh: 顾问核对了我们「事故登记日志」上写的是哪一天。

collocations: an entry in an incident log

words.enDefinition: a reference number assigned to an incident in an official system

examples.en: The campus dispatcher gave me an incident number when I requested a follow-up.
examples.zh: 我要求了解后续情况时，校园调度员给了我一个「事件编号」。

examples.en: I wrote the incident number in my notes next to the time of the call.
examples.zh: 我把「事件编号」记在笔记里，写在通话时间旁边。

words.enDefinition: A written account of an event and its circumstances

examples.en: The hall manager wrote an incident report about the damaged common room.
examples.zh: 宿舍管理员就公共休息室受损写了一份「事故报告」。

examples.en: I read the incident report before sending it to the accommodation office.
examples.zh: 我先阅读了「事故报告」，然后才发给住宿办公室。

collocations: a copy of an incident report

words.enDefinition: A status label indicating that an incident has been addressed.

examples.en: The notification changed to “Incident resolved” shortly before classes resumed in the arts building.
examples.zh: 艺术楼恢复上课前不久，通知状态变成了「事件已处理完毕」。

examples.en: I saw “Incident resolved” beside the library notice when I refreshed the page later.
examples.zh: 后来我刷新页面时，在图书馆通告旁看到了「事件已处理完毕」。

collocations: an incident was resolved at noon

words.enDefinition: the current stage or condition of an incident being handled

examples.en: The campus desk updated the incident status after hearing from the first crew.
examples.zh: 校园值班台收到第一支救援队的消息后，更新了「事件处理状态」。

examples.en: I quoted the reference number when asking about the incident status on Friday.
examples.zh: 我周五查询「事件处理状态」时，报了查询编号。

words.enDefinition: A brief description of a reported event and its main facts

examples.en: The housing manager attached a short incident summary to the email.
examples.zh: 住宿管理员在邮件里附了一份简短的「事故概要」。

examples.en: I compared the incident summary with the earlier maintenance note.
examples.zh: 我把「事故概要」与早先的维护记录作了比较。

words.enDefinition: A message giving new information about an ongoing incident and its effects.

examples.en: The incident update added a list of rooms that were still unavailable that afternoon.
examples.zh: 「事件进展通报」补充了一份当天下午仍无法使用的房间清单。

examples.en: The next incident update explained when students could return to the ground floor study area.
examples.zh: 下一条「事件进展通报」说明了学生何时可以返回地面层自习区。

collocations: an incident update from campus management

words.enDefinition: a call that is being received on a phone

examples.en: I picked up an incoming call while my friend waited beside the campus gate.
examples.zh: 朋友在校园大门旁等着时，我接了一个「呼入电话」。

examples.en: The desk phone rang again for an incoming call from the control room.
examples.zh: 值班电话又响了，这次是控制室的「呼入电话」。

words.enDefinition: An assessment made by someone separate from the parties directly involved

examples.en: The insurer listed an independent assessment separately from the early report.
examples.zh: 保险公司把「独立评估」与早期报告分开列出了。

examples.en: I asked which engineer had completed the independent assessment for our room.
examples.zh: 我问哪位工程师完成了我们房间的「独立评估」。

collocations: the findings of an independent assessment

words.enDefinition: a record describing an injury and the circumstances around it

examples.en: The club's injury report asked which part of the body had been hurt.
examples.zh: 社团的「受伤情况报告」要求填写受伤的身体部位。

examples.en: I added the time to the injury report after checking the rehearsal schedule.
examples.zh: 我看了排练安排表后，把时间补到了「受伤情况报告」里。

words.enDefinition: a sealed pouch that becomes cold without prior refrigeration

examples.en: The coach read the label on the instant cold pack from the kit.
examples.zh: 教练看了急救包里「速冷袋」上的标签。

examples.en: The inventory showed one instant cold pack in each of the portable bags.
examples.zh: 库存表上写着每个便携急救包里都放有一个「速冷袋」。

collocations: a box of instant cold packs

words.enDefinition: An event falling within the terms of an insurance policy

examples.en: The guide explained what an insured event meant in that section.
examples.zh: 指南解释了那一节中的「承保事件」指什么。

examples.en: I checked which incident the insurer had listed as the insured event.
examples.zh: 我查看了保险公司把哪起事故列为「承保事件」。

words.enDefinition: Work organized by the insurer to repair damage accepted under a claim

examples.en: The letter described insurer-arranged repairs planned for the damaged hallway.
examples.zh: 信中介绍了为受损走廊计划的「保险公司安排的维修」。

examples.en: I asked which company was handling the insurer-arranged repairs that week.
examples.zh: 我问那一周由哪家公司负责「保险公司安排的维修」。

words.enDefinition: A payment made before the final amount has been settled

examples.en: The insurer's account summary listed an interim payment on the second page.
examples.zh: 书面说明在第二页列出了一笔「理赔预付款」。

examples.en: I checked how the insurer labeled the interim payment on its statement.
examples.zh: 我核对了保险公司在说明中如何标注「理赔预付款」。

words.enDefinition: A service interruption that recurs between periods of availability

examples.en: The notice described an intermittent outage rather than a continuous interruption.
examples.zh: 通知介绍的是「时断时续的停运」，中间有时还能使用服务。

examples.en: Our street appeared in the update about the intermittent outage.
examples.zh: 我们这条街出现在「时断时续的停运」动态中。

collocations: a notice about an intermittent outage
customers affected by an intermittent outage

words.enDefinition: A supply of water that stops and returns repeatedly

examples.en: The provider listed intermittent water supply in its update for our street.
examples.zh: 供水方在我们这条街的动态中注明「供水时断时续」。

examples.en: The building notice mentioned intermittent water supply during the afternoon repairs.
examples.zh: 大楼通知提到，下午维修期间「供水时断时续」。

collocations: a notice about intermittent water supply

words.enDefinition: A difference between items listed and those found or reported

examples.en: I noticed an inventory discrepancy while comparing the two property reports.
examples.zh: 我在对照两份财物报告时发现一处「物品清单不一致之处」。

examples.en: The assessor asked which item caused the inventory discrepancy in our records.
examples.zh: 评估人员问，我们的记录中哪件物品导致了这处「物品清单不一致之处」。

words.enDefinition: a question asking whether any person has been injured

examples.en: Is anyone hurt at the entrance where the two vehicles came to a stop?
examples.zh: 两辆车停下的那个入口附近，「有人受伤吗」？

examples.en: Is anyone hurt, or has everybody already walked back to the reception area?
examples.zh: 「有人受伤吗」？还是大家已经都走回接待区了？

collocations: is anyone hurt in the car
is anyone hurt at the scene

words.enDefinition: To send out an official warning to the people affected.

examples.en: The university issued an alert about the building closure just before the afternoon classes started.
examples.zh: 下午的课刚要开始，大学就针对楼宇关闭一事「发布了警报」。

examples.en: The campus can issue an alert through the same system it uses for routine tests.
examples.zh: 学校可以用平时做例行测试的同一个系统「发布警报」。

collocations: issue an alert about a closure

words.enDefinition: A label introducing the time when an official notice was released.

examples.en: The alert was marked “Issued at nine” near the top of the email message.
examples.zh: 警报邮件顶部附近标有「发布于九点」。

examples.en: The small line marked “Issued at” helped me identify the most recent notice on the page.
examples.zh: 「发布于」这一行小字帮助我分辨出页面上最新的通知。

collocations: an alert marked issued at noon
a notice with an issued at line

words.enDefinition: a record confirming a held item has been collected

examples.en: The desk emailed an item collection confirmation after my sister picked up the bag.
examples.zh: 姐姐取走包后，服务台发来一封「物品领取确认」邮件。

examples.en: I kept the item collection confirmation with the photographs from my original enquiry.
examples.zh: 我把「物品领取确认」与最初查询时用的照片一起保存。

words.enDefinition: the physical state of an item when it is handed back

examples.en: The form asked me to describe the item condition on return before I signed.
examples.zh: 表格要求我签字前描述「物品领回时的状况」。

examples.en: The desk recorded the item condition on return after I checked the broken clasp.
examples.zh: 我检查了坏掉的扣子后，服务台记录了「物品领回时的状况」。

collocations: description of item condition on return

words.enDefinition: Information describing an item, such as its model or condition

examples.en: I checked the item details before sending the list to the insurer.
examples.zh: 我核对了「物品详细信息」，才把清单发给保险公司。

examples.en: The form had one section for item details and another for photos.
examples.zh: 表格一栏填「物品详细信息」，另一栏放照片。

words.enDefinition: to injure a finger by forcing its tip back suddenly

examples.en: Did you jam your finger when you tried to catch that pass?
examples.zh: 你试着接那个传球时「戳伤手指」了吗？

examples.en: I told the new player it was easy to jam your finger catching that ball.
examples.zh: 我告诉新队员，接那个球很容易「戳伤手指」。

collocations: jam your finger catching a ball
jam your finger against the wall

words.enDefinition: a short distance beyond a particular point or place

examples.en: Our group is waiting just past the clock tower beside a low brick wall.
examples.zh: 我们这组在「刚过钟楼一点」的矮砖墙旁等。

examples.en: The entrance you want is just past the campus bookshop on the right.
examples.zh: 你找的入口在「过了校园书店一点」的右手边。

words.enDefinition: to leave a passage free of obstructions so people can get through

examples.en: The staff asked us to keep the corridor clear outside the sports hall.
examples.zh: 工作人员请我们「保持体育馆外的走廊畅通」。

examples.en: The notice said to keep the corridor clear during the evening event.
examples.zh: 通知要求晚间活动期间「保持走廊畅通」。

collocations: keep the corridor clear of bags
ask everyone to keep the corridor clear
keep the corridor clear for staff

words.enDefinition: a small label attached to a set of keys to identify them

examples.en: I described the key tag as blue with a room number written on it.
examples.zh: 我说「钥匙标牌」是蓝色的，上面写着一个房间号。

examples.en: A resident recognised the key tag in the photograph of my missing keys.
examples.zh: 一名住户认出了我遗失钥匙的照片里的「钥匙标牌」。

words.enDefinition: the joints of the fingers, especially where they meet the hand

examples.en: I saw marks across his knuckles after he caught his hand in the door.
examples.zh: 他的手被门夹到后，我看到他的「手指关节」上有几道印子。

examples.en: She showed the first aider which knuckles had knocked against the table.
examples.zh: 她给急救员看了是哪几个「手指关节」撞到了桌子。

words.enDefinition: marked with a label bearing your name to identify the item

examples.en: The attendant asked whether the instrument case was labelled with your name or only initials.
examples.zh: 工作人员问乐器盒上是「贴有你的姓名标签」，还是只有姓名首字母。

examples.en: Make sure the laptop sleeve labelled with your name is the one the clerk found.
examples.zh: 确认一下，办事员找到的是「贴有你的姓名标签」的那个电脑内胆包。

words.enDefinition: Work performed and supplies used, often listed as repair costs

examples.en: The invoice showed separate amounts for labour and materials at the bottom.
examples.zh: 发票底部把「人工与材料」的金额分开列出。

examples.en: I asked whether the repair total included both labour and materials.
examples.zh: 我问维修总额是否同时包括「人工与材料」。

collocations: a quote covering labour and materials

words.enDefinition: to hit a surface with a body part after falling

examples.en: I saw him land on his left side at the bottom of the steps.
examples.zh: 我看见他摔到台阶底下时，「左侧身体先着地」。

examples.en: She told the coach she had tried not to land on her wrist.
examples.zh: 她告诉教练，自己摔倒时尽量没让「手腕先着地」。

words.enDefinition: a flat area at the top of or between flights of stairs

examples.en: She waited on the landing outside our floor while I found the caretaker.
examples.zh: 我去找管理员时，她在我们那层外面的「楼梯平台」上等。

examples.en: The nearest room number was painted on the door facing the landing upstairs.
examples.zh: 最近的房间号刷在楼上正对「楼梯平台」的门上。

words.enDefinition: a phrase describing something forgotten when someone got off a bus

examples.en: The umbrella was left on the bus near the seats by the back door.
examples.zh: 伞「落在公交车上」了，就在后门旁那些座椅附近。

examples.en: I asked the driver whether a blue folder had been left on the bus.
examples.zh: 我问司机有没有一个蓝色文件夹「落在公交车上」。

collocations: report an item left on the bus

words.enDefinition: a phrase saying that someone went away without taking an item

examples.en: I think I left something behind in the study room after our late seminar.
examples.zh: 上完晚上的研讨课，我好像把「什么东西落在」自习室了。

examples.en: She realised she'd left something behind when she reached for her wallet outside.
examples.zh: 她在外面伸手去拿钱包时，才发现自己「落下了东西」。

collocations: check whether you left something behind

words.enDefinition: a leg abruptly stopped being able to support a person's weight

examples.en: She said her leg gave way as she stepped down from the platform.
examples.zh: 她说，迈下站台时，她的「腿突然一软」。

examples.en: I saw him reach for the railing when his leg gave way.
examples.zh: 他的「腿突然一软」时，我看见他伸手去扶栏杆。

collocations: her leg gave way on the stairs
his leg gave way beneath him

words.enDefinition: To officially end a warning that was in effect.

examples.en: Campus safety lifted the alert after facilities staff confirmed the rooms were ready to reopen.
examples.zh: 设施管理人员确认各房间可以开放后，校园安全部门「解除了警报」。

examples.en: When they lifted the alert, a second message confirmed that the campus center was open.
examples.zh: 「解除警报」时，第二条消息确认了学生活动中心已开放。

collocations: lift an alert after an inspection
lift an alert for one building

words.enDefinition: A status showing a site can offer only some usual services

examples.en: The city office said it had limited on-site services that afternoon.
examples.zh: 市政府办事处说，当天下午「仅提供部分现场服务」。

examples.en: The library listed limited on-site services because some equipment was unavailable.
examples.zh: 由于有些设备无法使用，图书馆写明「仅提供部分现场服务」。

collocations: a notice of limited on-site services

words.enDefinition: an entrance used for bringing goods into or out of a building

examples.en: The porter waited beside the loading entrance because the front doors were locked.
examples.zh: 正门锁着，门房就在「货物装卸入口」旁等。

examples.en: The van was parked outside the loading entrance at the back of the library.
examples.zh: 那辆货车停在图书馆后面的「货物装卸入口」外。

words.enDefinition: A laptop lent for temporary use by a service

examples.en: The student centre offered a loaner laptop while mine was unavailable.
examples.zh: 我的电脑用不了的时候，学生中心提供了一台「借用的笔记本电脑」。

examples.en: I checked where to return the loaner laptop after the workshop.
examples.zh: 我查了讲座结束后应该把「借用的笔记本电脑」还到哪里。

words.enDefinition: Flooding occurring in particular places rather than across an entire area

examples.en: The council reported localized flooding on two streets near campus.
examples.zh: 市政部门报告说，学校附近有两条街出现「局部淹水」。

examples.en: The bus operator blamed localized flooding for the diversion near the sports centre.
examples.zh: 公交运营方说，体育中心附近改道是因为出现了「局部淹水」。

words.enDefinition: a marker on a digital map showing one particular point

examples.en: I saved the location pin for the footpath entrance when the group stopped.
examples.zh: 大家停下来时，我保存了步道入口的「地图位置标记」。

examples.en: The location pin showed the east entrance instead of the main campus gate.
examples.zh: 「地图位置标记」显示的是东入口，而不是校园正门。

words.enDefinition: sending one's current position to another person through a device

examples.en: Our group used location sharing to tell the residence adviser where we were waiting.
examples.zh: 我们这组用了「位置共享」，让宿舍辅导员知道我们在哪里等。

examples.en: My battery warned me just after I turned off location sharing on the way home.
examples.zh: 我回家路上刚关闭「位置共享」，手机就提示电量不足。

words.enDefinition: A document or credit used toward a place to stay

examples.en: The coordinator explained what the lodging voucher covered at that property.
examples.zh: 协调员解释了「住宿凭券」在那家住宿机构能用于什么。

examples.en: I checked which nights were named on the lodging voucher.
examples.zh: 我核对了「住宿凭券」上写的是哪几晚。

words.enDefinition: to appear noticeably lighter in the face than usual

examples.en: You look pale, and I noticed that you stopped talking halfway through the presentation.
examples.zh: 你「脸色看起来很苍白」，我还注意到你做报告做到一半就没再说话了。

examples.en: The student didn't look pale until he came back into the brighter room.
examples.zh: 那名学生回到光线更亮的房间后，才显得「脸色苍白」。

words.enDefinition: to become unaware of your surroundings and unable to respond

examples.en: I didn't see her lose consciousness because I was facing the other way.
examples.zh: 我当时朝着另一边，没看到她「失去意识」。

examples.en: The first aider asked whether anyone had seen him lose consciousness at the gym.
examples.zh: 急救员问，有没有人在体育馆看见他「失去意识」。

words.enDefinition: to stop being able to remain upright and steady

examples.en: Did you lose your balance before your foot reached the bottom step?
examples.zh: 你的脚还没踩到最下面一级台阶时，就「失去平衡」了吗？

examples.en: Was it the moving handrail that made you lose your balance on the stairs?
examples.zh: 是扶手晃动让你在楼梯上「失去平衡」的吗？

collocations: lose your balance on the stairs

words.enDefinition: to stop having a secure hold on the ground with your feet

examples.en: Did you lose your footing halfway down the stairs outside the hall?
examples.zh: 你是走到礼堂外的台阶中段时「脚下没站稳」的吗？

examples.en: It's easy to lose your footing where the loose gravel meets the pavement.
examples.zh: 松散碎石和硬路面交接的地方，很容易「脚下没站稳」。

collocations: lose your footing on loose gravel
lose your footing on the stairs

words.enDefinition: An assessment of the extent and financial value of a loss

examples.en: The loss assessment gave separate figures for the flooring and furniture.
examples.zh: 「损失评估」分别列出了地板和家具的估算金额。

examples.en: I checked which photographs the loss assessment referred to in that section.
examples.zh: 我核对了「损失评估」那一部分提到了哪些照片。

words.zhGloss: 无法使用财产期间的保障
words.enDefinition: Insurance protection for certain costs when damaged property cannot be used
acceptedZhAnswers: 无法使用财产期间的保障

examples.en: The claim sheet listed loss of use coverage beside receipts for temporary accommodation.
examples.zh: 理赔单在临时住宿收据旁列出了「无法使用财产期间的保障」。

examples.en: I asked which expenses came under loss of use coverage in the sample policy.
examples.zh: 我问保险示例里有哪些开支属于「无法使用财产期间的保障」。

collocations: a claim involving loss of use coverage
details of loss of use coverage

words.enDefinition: A drop in the pressure pushing water through supply pipes

examples.en: The provider reported a loss of water pressure across the east district.
examples.zh: 供水方报告称，东部辖区出现了「水压下降」。

examples.en: The notice described a loss of water pressure after the main pipe broke.
examples.zh: 通知描述了供水主管破裂后出现的「水压下降」。

collocations: report a loss of water pressure
an area affected by loss of water pressure
a notice about loss of water pressure

words.enDefinition: a bus travel pass that its holder cannot find

examples.en: The transit desk sent me an email about my lost bus pass after lunch.
examples.zh: 午饭后，公交服务台给我发了一封关于「遗失的公交卡」的邮件。

examples.en: I reported my lost bus pass at the station desk on Thursday afternoon.
examples.zh: 周四下午，我在车站服务台报告了「公交卡遗失」一事。

collocations: hand in a lost bus pass

words.enDefinition: a phone line for reporting a missing payment card

examples.en: The banking app shows the lost card hotline on its account help page.
examples.zh: 银行应用在账户帮助页面上标出了「银行卡挂失热线」。

examples.en: I dialled the lost card hotline using the number printed in my bank booklet.
examples.zh: 我照着银行手册上印的号码拨打了「银行卡挂失热线」。

words.enDefinition: a debit card that its holder cannot locate

examples.en: The bank's message confirmed that my lost debit card had been reported on Monday.
examples.zh: 银行的消息确认，「遗失的借记卡」已于周一报失。

examples.en: I checked that the lost debit card was the one named in the notice.
examples.zh: 我确认那张「遗失的借记卡」就是通知中提到的卡。

words.enDefinition: an Apple feature that helps secure a missing device and display a message

examples.en: My account showed that Lost Mode was active on the phone I'd left behind.
examples.zh: 我的账户显示，落下的那部手机已启用「苹果设备丢失模式」。

examples.en: The adviser explained why Lost Mode still showed as pending on the device list.
examples.zh: 顾问解释了为何设备列表上「苹果设备丢失模式」仍显示待启用。

words.enDefinition: a label for belongings that are missing or were taken without permission

examples.en: The issuer's form asked whether my travel pass was lost or stolen that evening.
examples.zh: 发卡机构的表格问，我的交通卡当晚是「遗失还是被盗」。

examples.en: The account listed several cards that had already been reported as lost or stolen.
examples.zh: 账户里列出了几张已申报「遗失或被盗」的卡。

collocations: mark a card as lost or stolen

words.enDefinition: a passport whose holder cannot find it

examples.en: I told the consular officer that my lost passport was probably on the train.
examples.zh: 我告诉领事官员，「遗失的护照」可能落在了火车上。

examples.en: The lost passport turned up in a sleeve inside my old travel bag.
examples.zh: 「遗失的护照」在我旧旅行包的夹层里找到了。

words.enDefinition: a report formally notifying an authority that a passport is missing

examples.en: I saved a copy of the lost passport report in my travel documents folder.
examples.zh: 我在旅行证件文件夹里留了一份「护照遗失报告」的副本。

examples.en: The office confirmed the lost passport report was linked to my earlier enquiry.
examples.zh: 办事处确认，「护照遗失报告」已关联到我之前的查询。

words.enDefinition: personal possessions that someone has accidentally left behind or misplaced

examples.en: The bus company keeps lost property at its main depot during the week.
examples.zh: 公交公司平时把「遗失物品」保存在总站。

examples.en: My keys were logged as lost property after the cleaner found them under a chair.
examples.zh: 保洁员在椅子下面发现了我的钥匙，随后钥匙被登记为「遗失物品」。

words.enDefinition: a fee that may be charged when someone collects a stored item

examples.en: The desk listed the lost property collection charge separately from the shipping cost.
examples.zh: 服务台把「失物领取费」和运费分开列出。

examples.en: I asked about the lost property collection charge before going to the depot.
examples.zh: 我去车场前问了一下「失物领取费」。

collocations: pay a lost property collection charge
waive a lost property collection charge
check the lost property collection charge

words.enDefinition: an electronic collection of records about lost and found objects

examples.en: The clerk searched the lost property database by date and bus route.
examples.zh: 办事员按日期和公交线路查询「失物数据库」。

examples.en: I checked the lost property database again after the driver finished her shift.
examples.zh: 公交司机下班后，我又查了一次「失物数据库」。

collocations: enter an item in the lost property database

words.enDefinition: a request to check whether someone has found a missing item

examples.en: I made a lost property enquiry about the umbrella after reaching the next stop.
examples.zh: 到了下一站后，我提交了关于那把伞的「失物查询」。

examples.en: The bus company replied to my lost property enquiry with a reference number.
examples.zh: 公交公司回复了我的「失物查询」，并给了一个编号。

collocations: reply to a lost property enquiry

words.enDefinition: a form used to report a missing item and describe it

examples.en: I listed the bus route and departure time on the lost property form.
examples.zh: 我在「失物登记表」上写明了公交线路和发车时间。

examples.en: The lost property form asked for the seat number next to the bag.
examples.zh: 「失物登记表」要求填写包旁边的座位号。

collocations: fill in a lost property form

words.enDefinition: a reference used to find a specific lost property report or record

examples.en: I gave the clerk my lost property reference to check the status of the enquiry.
examples.zh: 我把「失物查询编号」报给办事员，请对方查看查询进展。

examples.en: The lost property reference was printed at the top of the reply email.
examples.zh: 「失物查询编号」印在回复邮件的顶部。

words.enDefinition: a record used to track items reported lost or handed in

examples.en: The staff entered the umbrella in the lost property register under Tuesday's date.
examples.zh: 工作人员把伞录入「失物登记册」，登记在周二的日期下。

examples.en: We checked the lost property register for bags found on the same bus.
examples.zh: 我们查了「失物登记册」，看看同一辆公交车上有没有捡到包。

collocations: entry in the lost property register

words.enDefinition: a physical residence card that its holder can no longer find

examples.en: I asked the adviser how to describe my lost residence card on the enquiry form.
examples.zh: 我请教顾问，该怎样在查询表上说明「遗失的居留卡」。

examples.en: The office asked whether I had a photograph of the lost residence card on file.
examples.zh: 办事处问我的档案里是否留有「遗失的居留卡」照片。

collocations: copy of a lost residence card

words.enDefinition: a student identity card that the holder cannot find

examples.en: My lost student ID was found in the lecture theatre after the evening class.
examples.zh: 晚课结束后，有人在阶梯教室找到了我「遗失的学生证」。

examples.en: The desk asked where I had last used my lost student ID on campus.
examples.zh: 服务台问我上一次在校园哪里用过这张「遗失的学生证」。

words.enDefinition: a physical visa document that the holder cannot find

examples.en: The immigration adviser asked whether I had saved a copy of my lost visa.
examples.zh: 移民事务顾问问我，是否保存了「遗失签证」的副本。

examples.en: I listed the date of issue of my lost visa in the written account.
examples.zh: 我在书面说明中写明了「遗失签证」的签发日期。

collocations: record details of a lost visa

words.enDefinition: the part of the leg between the knee and ankle

examples.en: The player pointed to her lower leg when asked where she had landed.
