examples.zh: 有人问她是哪里先着地时，那名队员指了指自己的「小腿」。

examples.en: His lower leg had caught on the metal edge of the bench.
examples.zh: 他的「小腿」刚才卡在长凳的金属边上了。

collocations: the front of the lower leg
a mark on the lower leg

words.enDefinition: the principal gate through which people or vehicles enter a site

examples.en: The security guard met the responding crew at the main gate shortly after dark.
examples.zh: 天刚黑不久，安保人员就在「正门」和救援队会合。

examples.en: From the bus stop, I could see the main gate beside the flagpoles.
examples.zh: 从公交站可以看到旗杆旁的「正门」。

words.enDefinition: to record a device or item as missing in an account or system

examples.en: The device list showed which tablet I could mark as lost in the account.
examples.zh: 设备列表显示，我可以在账户中把哪台平板「标记为遗失」。

examples.en: The help page explained which items the staff could mark as lost for students.
examples.zh: 帮助页面解释了工作人员可以为学生把哪些物品「标记为遗失」。

collocations: choose an item to mark as lost
device you can mark as lost

words.enDefinition: A system that sends a message to many people through one or more channels.

examples.en: The university tested its mass notification system during the first week of the semester.
examples.zh: 大学在开学第一周测试了「群体通知系统」。

examples.en: One announcement from the mass notification system appeared on both phones and library computers.
examples.zh: 有一条「群体通知系统」发出的消息同时出现在手机和图书馆电脑上。

collocations: messages from the mass notification system

words.expression: match a found item to a report
words.lemma: match a found item to a report
words.zhGloss: 把拾获物与报失记录匹配
words.enDefinition: to identify which loss report describes a particular found item
acceptedZhAnswers: 把拾获物与报失记录匹配
acceptedEnVariants: match a found item to a report

examples.en: It is easier to match a found item to a report when the description includes a label.
examples.zh: 报失描述写明了标签，工作人员就更容易「把拾获物与报失记录匹配」。

examples.en: Staff use photographs to match a found item to a report from its owner.
examples.zh: 工作人员用照片「把拾获物与物主的报失记录匹配」起来。

collocations: match a found item to a report by its markings
use a photo to match a found item to a report
try to match a found item to a report

words.enDefinition: Help providing food or covering meals for people needing support

examples.en: The student centre listed meal assistance in its update to residents.
examples.zh: 学生中心在发给居民的动态中列出了「用餐援助」。

examples.en: I asked which office coordinated meal assistance for the affected group.
examples.zh: 我问哪个办公室协调为受影响的一行人提供「用餐援助」。

words.enDefinition: A continuous path that lets occupants leave a building and reach a safe outside area.

examples.en: The facilities diagram used the term “means of egress” for the route leading outside.
examples.zh: 设施示意图把通往室外的路线标成了「安全疏散通道」。

examples.en: The campus planner highlighted the means of egress on a copy of the building plan.
examples.zh: 校园规划人员在楼宇平面图的复印件上标出了「安全疏散通道」。

collocations: a means of egress from the building

words.enDefinition: a wristband displaying important health information for responders

examples.en: The student pointed out her medical alert bracelet when she spoke to the officer.
examples.zh: 那名学生和安全员说话时，指给对方看了自己的「医疗警示手链」。

examples.en: The roommate told staff that the medical alert bracelet had an emergency number engraved on it.
examples.zh: 室友告诉工作人员，「医疗警示手链」上刻着紧急联系号码。

collocations: information on a medical alert bracelet

words.enDefinition: a portable card listing important health information for responders

examples.en: The student said her medical alert card was in the front of her wallet.
examples.zh: 那名学生说，她的「医疗警示卡」放在钱包最前面的夹层里。

examples.en: The volunteer noticed the medical alert card had emergency details printed on both sides.
examples.zh: 志愿者注意到，「医疗警示卡」两面都印了紧急情况所需的信息。

collocations: details on a medical alert card

words.enDefinition: adhesive tape made for securing dressings or medical materials

examples.en: A roll of medical tape was inside the clear pocket on the left.
examples.zh: 左边的透明袋里放着一卷「医用胶带」。

examples.en: I read the label on the medical tape while sorting the new supplies.
examples.zh: 整理新到的用品时，我看了「医用胶带」上的标签。

words.enDefinition: to meet emergency personnel when they arrive at or near the scene

examples.en: The caretaker went outside to meet the responders by the residence hall gate.
examples.zh: 管理员到外面，在宿舍楼大门旁「和救援人员会合」。

examples.en: I asked a classmate to meet the responders at the rear of the building.
examples.zh: 我请一名同学到楼后「和救援人员会合」。

collocations: meet the responders at the gate
go out to meet the responders

words.enDefinition: a road sign indicating distance measured in miles along a route

examples.en: The passenger read the mile marker out loud as the van slowed down.
examples.zh: 面包车减速时，那名乘客大声报出了「英里里程标」上的数字。

examples.en: Our rideshare driver described the nearest mile marker and the colour of the car.
examples.zh: 网约车司机报了最近的「英里里程标」，并说了车的颜色。

words.enDefinition: to put your keys somewhere and then be unable to find them

examples.en: It's easy to misplace your keys when several people share the same hallway table.
examples.zh: 几个人共用走廊小桌时，很容易「把钥匙放错地方」。

examples.en: If you misplace your keys, a flatmate may recognise the coloured tag in the photo.
examples.zh: 如果你「把钥匙放错了地方」，室友也许认得照片里的彩色钥匙牌。

words.enDefinition: a list of the particular objects that are missing

examples.en: I sent the accommodation office a missing item list after checking the storage locker.
examples.zh: 检查完储物柜后，我向住宿办公室发送了一份「遗失物品清单」。

examples.en: The missing item list included a blue notebook as well as the laptop sleeve.
examples.zh: 「遗失物品清单」上既有笔记本电脑内胆包，也有一本蓝色笔记本。

words.enDefinition: a wallet whose owner cannot find it

examples.en: My missing wallet turned up under a loose cushion in the common room.
examples.zh: 我「不见了的钱包」在公共休息室一个活动坐垫下面找到了。

examples.en: I described my missing wallet to the attendant at the swimming pool entrance.
examples.zh: 我向游泳馆入口的工作人员描述了「不见了的钱包」。

words.enDefinition: Costs associated with limiting further loss after an incident

examples.en: The sample report listed mitigation expenses separately from the repair bill.
examples.zh: 报告样本将「减少后续损失的开支」与维修账单分开列出。

examples.en: I asked which costs the statement described as mitigation expenses.
examples.zh: 我问说明上哪些费用被描述为「减少后续损失的开支」。

words.enDefinition: A disruption of cellular services in one or more areas

examples.en: The carrier's update confirmed a mobile network outage near campus.
examples.zh: 运营商在更新中确认学校附近有「移动通信网络中断」。

examples.en: I read that the mobile network outage affected calls in several neighborhoods.
examples.zh: 我读到消息说，「移动通信网络中断」影响了几个街区的通话。

collocations: a notice about a mobile network outage
areas affected by a mobile network outage

words.enDefinition: a point where a motorway joins another road by ramps

examples.en: The traffic report gave the number of the motorway junction nearest the incident.
examples.zh: 路况播报说出了离事发地点最近的「高速公路互通口」编号。

examples.en: Our bus passed the motorway junction just before the driver stopped for assistance.
examples.zh: 司机停车求助前，我们的长途车刚经过「高速公路互通口」。

words.enDefinition: An insurance policy covering losses caused by specified listed events

examples.en: The workshop showed a sample named-perils policy for personal property.
examples.zh: 讲座展示了一份为个人财物承保的「列明风险保单」样本。

examples.en: I checked how the named-perils policy described the listed risks.
examples.zh: 我核对了「列明风险保单」是怎样描述所列风险的。

collocations: a claim under a named-perils policy

words.enDefinition: the kind of urgent situation or problem being reported

examples.en: The operator asked about the nature of the emergency before transferring my call.
examples.zh: 接线员先问了「紧急情况的性质」，然后转接了我的电话。

examples.en: The record describes the nature of the emergency in the caller's own words.
examples.zh: 记录用来电者自己的话说明了「紧急情况的性质」。

collocations: describe the nature of the emergency
confirm the nature of the emergency
ask about the nature of the emergency

words.enDefinition: the place closest to someone where two or more roads meet

examples.en: The driver reported the nearest intersection because the road had no house numbers.
examples.zh: 这条路没有门牌，司机便报了「最近的道路交叉口」。

examples.en: The campus map marked the nearest intersection just beyond the visitor parking lot.
examples.zh: 校园地图标出了「最近的道路交叉口」，就在访客停车场过去一点。

words.enDefinition: the closest distinctive place or object that helps identify where someone is

examples.en: The clock tower was the nearest landmark we could see from the field.
examples.zh: 钟楼是我们从运动场能看到的「最近的显眼地标」。

examples.en: I described the nearest landmark first because I couldn't read the street sign.
examples.zh: 我看不清路牌，就先说明了「最近的显眼地标」。

words.enDefinition: to require help to be provided straight away

examples.en: The dispatcher asked whether anyone inside the building would need immediate assistance that evening.
examples.zh: 调度员问，那天晚上楼内有没有人会「需要立即协助」。

examples.en: We need immediate assistance at the west gate, the caretaker told the operator.
examples.zh: 管理员对接线员说：“西门这边「需要立即协助」。”

collocations: tell someone you need immediate assistance
need immediate assistance at the scene

words.enDefinition: A label introducing the time when more official information is expected.

examples.en: The banner read “Next update at noon” underneath the announcement about the library closure.
examples.zh: 横幅在图书馆关闭通知下方显示「下次更新于中午」。

examples.en: Staff added “Next update at four” when they revised the notice on the building doors.
examples.zh: 工作人员修改楼门上的告示时，补上了「下次更新于四点」。

collocations: a notice saying next update at noon
a banner with next update at four
a message ending with next update at three

words.enDefinition: A notice telling recipients that they do not need to do anything in response to the message.

examples.en: The test notification ended with “No action required” in bold letters below the heading.
examples.zh: 测试通知的末尾，在标题下方用粗体写着「无需采取行动」。

examples.en: The last line said “No action required” because this was a communications system check.
examples.zh: 最后一行写的是「无需采取行动」，因为这是一次通信系统检查。

collocations: a message saying no action required

words.enDefinition: not valid or usable any more for its intended purpose

examples.en: The notice said that my old residence card was no longer valid after replacement.
examples.zh: 通知上说，居留卡补发后旧卡「已经失效」。

examples.en: I found the original pass, but the desk confirmed it was no longer valid.
examples.zh: 我找到了原来的通行证，但服务台确认它「已经失效」。

collocations: confirm that something is no longer valid

words.zhGloss: 未找到符合描述的物品
words.enDefinition: a status indicating that a search found no item fitting a description
acceptedZhAnswers: 未找到符合描述的物品

examples.en: The email said no matching item found after staff checked the depot's shelves.
examples.zh: 工作人员查过总站的架子后，邮件写着「未找到符合描述的物品」。

examples.en: I saw no matching item found when I reopened the lost property enquiry that evening.
examples.zh: 那晚我重新打开失物查询，看到「未找到符合描述的物品」。

collocations: status reads no matching item found
no matching item found so far

words.enDefinition: no outward sign of an injury

examples.en: I reported no visible injury because I couldn't see a mark from where I stood.
examples.zh: 我从自己站的位置没看到伤痕，就报告说「没有看到外伤」。

examples.en: The note said no visible injury, but it also recorded her account of the fall.
examples.zh: 记录写着「没有可见外伤」，也写下了她讲述的摔倒经过。

collocations: no visible injury to the arm

words.enDefinition: a phone number for matters that do not need immediate emergency help

examples.en: The local police non-emergency number was printed beside the campus security desk details.
examples.zh: 当地警方的「非紧急联系电话」印在校园安保值班台联系方式旁。

examples.en: The student rang the non-emergency number to ask about a report filed last week.
examples.zh: 那名学生拨打「非紧急联系电话」，询问上周提交的一份报告。

words.enDefinition: Travel costs that a provider will not pay back

examples.en: The form listed non-refundable travel expenses in a section about unused bookings.
examples.zh: 表格在未使用的预订一节列出了「不可退款的旅行开支」。

examples.en: My adviser explained which receipts related to non-refundable travel expenses for the trip.
examples.zh: 顾问解释了哪些收据与这次「不可退款的旅行开支」有关。

collocations: a list of non-refundable travel expenses

words.enDefinition: travelling or leading in the direction of north

examples.en: The caller said the broken-down coach was blocking one northbound lane near campus.
examples.zh: 来电者说，抛锚的大巴堵住了校园附近一条「向北行驶的」车道。

examples.en: Our northbound train was held at the station while staff checked the platform.
examples.zh: 工作人员检查站台时，我们乘坐的「北行」列车在车站暂时停留。

words.enDefinition: A way a safety message is delivered, such as text, email, or a loudspeaker.

examples.en: The orientation guide listed text messaging as one available notification channel for campus safety alerts.
examples.zh: 新生指南把短信列为校园警报可用的「通知渠道」之一。

examples.en: The campus tested each notification channel separately while students were using the main library.
examples.zh: 学生使用主图书馆期间，学校分别测试了每种「通知渠道」。

words.enDefinition: to let an employee at the venue know what happened

examples.en: The organiser asked me to notify a member of staff at the entrance.
examples.zh: 组织者让我「通知一位入口处的工作人员」。

examples.en: I went downstairs to notify a member of staff after my friend fell.
examples.zh: 朋友摔倒后，我下楼「通知了一位工作人员」。

collocations: notify a member of staff immediately
ask someone to notify a member of staff
notify a member of staff at reception

words.enDefinition: to inform the person designated to be told about an emergency

examples.en: The residence adviser asked whether she should notify an emergency contact for me.
examples.zh: 宿舍辅导员问我，要不要帮我「通知紧急联系人」。

examples.en: The staff member had the details needed to notify an emergency contact that evening.
examples.zh: 那天晚上，工作人员掌握了「通知紧急联系人」所需的信息。

collocations: ask to notify an emergency contact
notify an emergency contact by phone
permission to notify an emergency contact

words.enDefinition: the count of people directly affected by or taking part in an incident

examples.en: The call handler asked about the number of people involved in the crash.
examples.zh: 接线员询问了这起撞车事故的「涉及人数」。

examples.en: The witness couldn't confirm the number of people involved from across the street.
examples.zh: 目击者隔着一条街，无法确认「涉及人数」。

collocations: confirm the number of people involved
report the number of people involved
estimate the number of people involved

words.enDefinition: New information released by the institution responsible for communicating about an event.

examples.en: The official update posted at noon confirmed that the science building had reopened already.
examples.zh: 中午发布的「官方通报」确认理科楼已经重新开放。

examples.en: I checked for an official update after classmates shared different times for the reopening.
examples.zh: 同学们转发的重新开放时间各不相同，于是我去查看是否有「官方通报」。

words.enDefinition: present at the place where an incident occurred

examples.en: The dispatcher confirmed that the crew was on scene when I called again.
examples.zh: 我再次打电话时，调度员确认救援队「已到现场」。

examples.en: An officer was already on scene when the building manager arrived from home.
examples.zh: 楼宇管理员从家里赶到时，已有一位警员「到现场」。

words.enDefinition: an electronic report submitted to notify the authorities about stolen property

examples.en: I saved my online theft report as a PDF after I submitted it.
examples.zh: 我提交「网上失窃报案」后，把记录保存为 PDF。

examples.en: The officer asked a question about the time listed in my online theft report.
examples.zh: 警员就我的「网上失窃报案」中填写的时间问了一个问题。

collocations: copy of the online theft report

words.enDefinition: A policy covering causes of loss unless excluded by its terms

examples.en: The sample open-perils policy had a separate section listing exclusions.
examples.zh: 「列明除外风险的保单」样本有单独一节列明除外事项。

examples.en: I asked what the document meant by an open-perils policy.
examples.zh: 我问文件中的「列明除外风险的保单」是什么意思。

collocations: a claim under an open-perils policy

words.enDefinition: The current condition of a place or service, such as open, closed, or limited.

examples.en: I checked the operating status of the library before leaving for my afternoon study session.
examples.zh: 去参加下午的自习活动前，我查看了图书馆的「运营状态」。

examples.en: The university's front page displayed the operating status of each facility in a short table.
examples.zh: 大学首页用一张简表显示了各设施的「运营状态」。

words.enDefinition: facing the point where people enter a place

examples.en: I'm standing opposite the entrance to the library, beside the green recycling bins.
examples.zh: 我站在「图书馆入口对面」，就在绿色的回收桶旁。

examples.en: The responders parked opposite the entrance because the driveway was closed that evening.
examples.zh: 那晚车道关闭了，救援队就把车停「在入口对面」。

words.enDefinition: the first receipt issued as evidence of an item's purchase

examples.en: I found the original purchase receipt in the envelope that came with the headphones.
examples.zh: 我在耳机附带的信封里找到了「原始购买凭条」。

examples.en: The attendant compared the serial number with my original purchase receipt before releasing the laptop.
examples.zh: 工作人员交给我笔记本电脑前，将序列号与「原始购买凭条」进行了核对。

words.enDefinition: A label indicating an outdoor place is temporarily unavailable

examples.en: The event page showed "Outdoor venue closed" after the heavy rain.
examples.zh: 强降雨后，活动页面显示「室外场地关闭」。

examples.en: I saw "Outdoor venue closed" beside the field marked on the map.
examples.zh: 我在地图所标的运动场旁看到「室外场地关闭」。

collocations: a notice saying outdoor venue closed
an event page marked outdoor venue closed
show outdoor venue closed on the map

words.enDefinition: Work still needed after other repair tasks have been completed

examples.en: The residence team sent a list of outstanding repairs that evening.
examples.zh: 住宿团队那天晚上发来一份「尚未完成的维修」清单。

examples.en: I asked which outstanding repairs affected access to the rooms upstairs.
examples.zh: 我问哪些「尚未完成的维修」影响进入楼上的房间。

words.enDefinition: information that can be used to get in touch with the owner

examples.en: The owner's contact details were written inside the cover of the lost notebook.
examples.zh: 遗失笔记本的封面里面写有「物主的联络资料」。

examples.en: The porter added the owner's contact details to the form before storing the bag.
examples.zh: 门房把包存放起来前，在表格上补写了「物主的联络资料」。

words.enDefinition: the inner surface of the hand between wrist and fingers

examples.en: The small cut was on the palm of the hand, near the thumb.
examples.zh: 那道小口子在「手掌」上，靠近拇指。

examples.en: She pointed to the palm of the hand while talking to the first aider.
examples.zh: 她和急救员交谈时，指了指自己的「手掌」。

collocations: a cut on the palm of the hand
the centre of the palm of the hand
a mark on the palm of the hand

words.enDefinition: a small skin cut made by the edge of paper

examples.en: I noticed a paper cut after sorting the handouts for our afternoon seminar.
examples.zh: 我给下午的研讨课整理讲义后，发现手上有道「纸划伤」。

examples.en: The volunteer said the mark was a paper cut from opening the envelope.
examples.zh: 那名志愿者说，那道小口子是拆信封时「被纸划伤」留下的。

collocations: a paper cut on your thumb

words.enDefinition: An arrangement keeping part of a site closed and part open

examples.en: The city posted a partial closure for the park after the storm.
examples.zh: 暴风雨后，市政府公布公园「部分区域关闭」。

examples.en: I read what the partial closure meant for the sports fields.
examples.zh: 我查看了「部分区域关闭」对运动场有什么影响。

collocations: a notice about a partial closure
a partial closure of the grounds

words.enDefinition: A loss of electricity affecting only some parts of a location

examples.en: The hall manager reported a partial power outage in our building.
examples.zh: 宿舍管理员报告说我们楼内有「部分区域停电」。

examples.en: The notice explained which floors had a partial power outage that morning.
examples.zh: 通知说明了当天早上哪些楼层出现「部分区域停电」。

collocations: a building affected by a partial power outage
updates about a partial power outage

words.enDefinition: to relay what you know to another person who needs it

examples.en: I asked the receptionist to pass on the details to the staff upstairs.
examples.zh: 我请接待员帮忙把「具体情况转告」楼上的工作人员。

examples.en: Could you pass on the details when the event organiser comes back?
examples.zh: 活动组织者回来时，你能「转告具体情况」吗？

collocations: pass on the details to staff
offer to pass on the details
pass on the details by phone

words.enDefinition: the formal act of making an issued passport no longer valid

examples.en: The message confirmed the passport cancellation and gave the date it took effect.
examples.zh: 消息确认了「护照注销」，并写明生效日期。

examples.en: I looked for the passport cancellation notice among the replies from the passport office.
examples.zh: 我在护照办事处的回复里找「护照注销」通知。

words.enDefinition: an official message verifying that a passport has been cancelled

examples.en: The passport cancellation confirmation identified which travel document had been made invalid.
examples.zh: 「护照注销确认通知」写明了哪本旅行证件已作废。

examples.en: I filed the passport cancellation confirmation with the other messages from the consulate.
examples.zh: 我把「护照注销确认通知」与领事馆发来的其他消息一起存档。

words.enDefinition: a message confirming that a password has been changed or reset

examples.en: The password reset confirmation appeared in my inbox shortly before the next lecture.
examples.zh: 下一节课开始前不久，我的收件箱里收到了「密码重置确认通知」。

examples.en: I kept the password reset confirmation while the support desk looked at my case.
examples.zh: 技术服务台查看我的情况时，我保留了「密码重置确认通知」。

words.enDefinition: The strongest brief increases in wind speed measured or expected

examples.en: The map showed where peak wind gusts were expected that afternoon.
examples.zh: 地图显示了当天午后哪些地方预计会出现「最强阵风」。

examples.en: I compared the peak wind gusts in two updates from the forecaster.
examples.zh: 我比较了预报机构两次更新里的「最强阵风」。

collocations: a map of peak wind gusts

words.enDefinition: a gate for people entering or leaving on foot

examples.en: The pedestrian gate near the library stayed open while the road gate was closed.
examples.zh: 路口的车行门关着时，图书馆附近的「行人门」仍然开着。

examples.en: I met the caretaker by the pedestrian gate on the quieter side of campus.
examples.zh: 我在校园较安静一侧的「行人门」旁和管理员会合。

words.enDefinition: the things someone owns and carries or keeps with them

examples.en: The school returned my personal belongings in a box after clearing the locker.
examples.zh: 学校清理储物柜后，用一个箱子把我的「个人物品」还给了我。

examples.en: My personal belongings were still under the seat when the bus reached its terminus.
examples.zh: 公交车到终点站时，我的「个人物品」还在座位下面。

words.enDefinition: a phrase indicating that personal information could be exposed or misused

examples.en: The notice listed the types of personal data at risk after a device went missing.
examples.zh: 设备遗失后，通知列出了「面临风险的个人数据」类型。

examples.en: The review found the only personal data at risk was an old address list.
examples.zh: 审查发现，唯一「面临风险的个人数据」是一份旧地址清单。

collocations: identify the personal data at risk
review the types of personal data at risk

words.enDefinition: An evacuation plan tailored to the support needs of an individual person.

examples.en: The student met with accessibility staff to discuss a personal emergency evacuation plan before classes began.
examples.zh: 这名学生开课前与无障碍服务人员讨论了「个人应急疏散计划」。

examples.en: The advisor reviewed her personal emergency evacuation plan after the department moved to another building.
examples.zh: 院系搬到另一栋楼后，顾问重新审看了她的「个人应急疏散计划」。

collocations: prepare a personal emergency evacuation plan
review a personal emergency evacuation plan
discuss a personal emergency evacuation plan

words.enDefinition: An evacuation organized in stages for different building areas or groups.

examples.en: The staff briefing used a diagram to explain phased evacuation in the new auditorium.
examples.zh: 工作人员简报用一张示意图讲解了新礼堂的「分阶段疏散」。

examples.en: The training session covered phased evacuation and gave each observer a short evaluation form.
examples.zh: 培训课讲解了「分阶段疏散」，还给每位观察员发了一张简短的评估表。

words.enDefinition: stealing belongings from someone's clothing or bag without being noticed

examples.en: The visitor leaflet mentioned pickpocketing as a concern in crowded areas around the station.
examples.zh: 游客宣传单提到，车站周边人多的地方要留意「扒窃」。

examples.en: The officer asked whether the missing wallet might be a case of pickpocketing.
examples.zh: 警员问钱包不见了，会不会是遇到了「扒窃」。

words.enDefinition: the location where an item or document went missing

examples.en: I listed the station lobby as the place of loss on the form.
examples.zh: 我在表格上把车站大厅填为「遗失地点」。

examples.en: The office asked me to narrow down the place of loss within the shopping centre.
examples.zh: 办事处请我把「遗失地点」具体到购物中心内的某处。

words.enDefinition: to call someone accidentally when a phone is pressed in a pocket or bag

examples.en: I managed to pocket dial my flatmate twice while cycling back from the station.
examples.zh: 我从车站骑车回来时，「手机在兜里误拨」了室友的电话两次。

examples.en: An unlocked screen can cause you to pocket dial a contact without noticing.
examples.zh: 屏幕没锁，你可能会不知不觉地「让手机在兜里误拨」联系人。

words.enDefinition: help provided by the police in dealing with an incident

examples.en: The university staff requested police assistance after reviewing footage of the missing equipment.
examples.zh: 校方工作人员查看设备失踪的监控录像后，请求「警方协助」。

examples.en: The station manager thanked the officer for providing police assistance during the incident.
examples.zh: 车站经理感谢警员在事件中提供了「警方协助」。

words.enDefinition: an official police record containing details of an incident

examples.en: My landlord requested a copy of the police report for the recovered bicycle.
examples.zh: 房东请我提供有关找回自行车一事的「警方事件记录」副本。

examples.en: The officer read back part of the police report to check the timeline.
examples.zh: 警员读了一部分「警方事件记录」给我听，以核对时间线。

words.enDefinition: An insurance document listing details specific to a person's policy

examples.en: The insurer pointed out where the address appeared on my policy schedule.
examples.zh: 保险公司指给我看「保单明细表」上的地址写在哪里。

examples.en: I compared the dates on the policy schedule with the claim file.
examples.zh: 我把「保单明细表」上的日期与理赔档案作了核对。

words.enDefinition: a weak phone or radio signal causing communication problems

examples.en: The front desk has poor reception, so I took the call in the courtyard.
examples.zh: 前台「信号接收不良」，所以我到院子里接了电话。

examples.en: Because of poor reception in the basement, the operator had trouble hearing my address.
examples.zh: 地下室「信号接收不良」，接线员很难听清我报的地址。

words.enDefinition: Words indicating electricity is available again after an interruption

examples.en: The provider marked our street "Power restored" after the repair.
examples.zh: 修复后，供电方把我们这条街标为「供电已恢复」。

examples.en: I saw "Power restored" listed next to the student residence.
examples.zh: 我看到学生公寓旁写着「供电已恢复」。

collocations: a service notice reading power restored

words.enDefinition: the way someone wants to exchange information with others

examples.en: The staff member asked about my preferred communication method before giving me an update.
examples.zh: 工作人员在告诉我最新情况前，先问了我的「首选沟通方式」。

examples.en: I mentioned that typing was my preferred communication method in this noisy room.
examples.zh: 我提到，在这个嘈杂的房间里，打字是我的「首选沟通方式」。

collocations: ask about someone's preferred communication method

words.enDefinition: Travel costs that were paid before the relevant service took place

examples.en: I added the hotel booking to my list of prepaid travel expenses.
examples.zh: 我把酒店预订写进了「预付的旅行开支」清单。

examples.en: The adviser checked which prepaid travel expenses were shown on my statement.
examples.zh: 顾问核对了我的消费明细上有哪些「预付的旅行开支」。

words.enDefinition: An evacuation that begins without unnecessary delay.

examples.en: The drill report credited the clear announcements for the prompt evacuation of the rehearsal room.
examples.zh: 演习报告将排练室的「及时疏散」归功于清楚的广播。

examples.en: The staff briefing discussed how better signs had helped with prompt evacuation during the exercise.
examples.zh: 工作人员简报讨论了改善后的标牌如何帮助大家在演习中「及时疏散」。

collocations: a prompt evacuation of the space

words.enDefinition: Evidence that an incident forced someone to leave their usual accommodation

examples.en: The adviser kept the notice as proof of displacement for the case.
examples.zh: 顾问把通知留作本案「无法居住原处的证明」。

examples.en: I asked which document the office used as proof of displacement.
examples.zh: 我问办公室使用哪份文件作为「无法居住原处的证明」。

collocations: a letter serving as proof of displacement

words.enDefinition: A formal statement or document describing the loss being claimed

examples.en: The insurer showed where proof of loss was named on the checklist.
examples.zh: 保险公司指出了清单上「损失证明材料」的位置。

examples.en: I kept the proof of loss with the list of damaged items.
examples.zh: 我把「损失证明材料」与受损物品清单放在一起保存。

words.enDefinition: Physical harm caused to buildings, belongings, or other things

examples.en: The form listed property damage in the section about my dorm room.
examples.zh: 表格在宿舍房间一栏记录了「财产损坏」情况。

examples.en: The hall manager checked what property damage was described in the report.
examples.zh: 宿舍管理员核对了报告记录的是哪项「财产损坏」。

words.enDefinition: belongings that another person has turned over to a responsible office

examples.en: The desk checks property handed in each morning against the list of reported losses.
examples.zh: 服务台每天早上用报失清单核对「有人交来的财物」。

examples.en: My wallet was among the property handed in after the football match last night.
examples.zh: 我的钱包就在昨晚足球赛后「有人交来的财物」中。

words.enDefinition: A request for insurance payment or help after property loss

examples.en: I asked which report belonged with my property insurance claim for the desk.
examples.zh: 我问哪份报告应该和书桌的「财产保险理赔申请」放在一起。

examples.en: Our adviser checked the date on my property insurance claim summary.
examples.zh: 顾问核对了我的「财产保险理赔申请」概要上的日期。

collocations: documents for a property insurance claim

words.enDefinition: a status showing that missing property has yet to be retrieved

examples.en: The insurer's form still showed property not recovered for the missing laptop that week.
examples.zh: 那周，保险公司的表格上，遗失的笔记本电脑仍显示为「财物尚未找回」。

examples.en: The office recorded property not recovered before sending its final reply to the passenger.
examples.zh: 办事处在发给乘客最终回复前，把状态登记为「财物尚未找回」。

collocations: property not recovered at this time

words.enDefinition: a receipt recording that an office or organization took custody of an item

examples.en: The attendant gave me a property receipt after I handed over the recovered wallet.
examples.zh: 我交上找回的钱包后，工作人员给了我一张「财物接收凭证」。

examples.en: The property receipt described the headphones and recorded when the desk took them in.
examples.zh: 「财物接收凭证」描述了耳机的特征，并记录了服务台接收耳机的时间。

words.enDefinition: a receipt confirming that an office handed a held item back

examples.en: The attendant gave me a property release receipt after handing back my bag.
examples.zh: 工作人员把包还给我后，给了我一张「财物交还凭条」。

examples.en: The property release receipt recorded who had collected the item and when.
examples.zh: 「财物交还凭条」记录了谁在什么时候领走了物品。

words.enDefinition: a status showing that a held item has been given back to its owner

examples.en: The case was marked property returned after the owner picked up the backpack.
examples.zh: 物主取走背包后，记录被标为「财物已归还」。

examples.en: I noticed the property returned status when I checked the enquiry page that evening.
examples.zh: 那天晚上查看查询页时，我看到了「财物已归还」的状态。

words.enDefinition: the length of time an organization keeps recovered belongings available for collection

examples.en: The lost property page states the property storage period for items found on trains.
examples.zh: 失物招领网页写明了火车上拾获物品的「失物保管期限」。

examples.en: I asked whether the property storage period began on the day the wallet was found.
examples.zh: 我问「失物保管期限」是不是从找到钱包当天开始算。

words.enDefinition: a label attached to an item so it can be matched to a record

examples.en: The registrar tied a property tag to the handle of the recovered suitcase.
examples.zh: 登记员把「财物登记标签」拴到找回的行李箱提手上。

examples.en: The property tag had the same number as the entry in the storage ledger.
examples.zh: 「财物登记标签」上的编号与保管台账对应条目上的编号相同。

collocations: match a property tag to a record

words.enDefinition: A microphone and speaker system used to make announcements throughout a place.

examples.en: The announcement came over the public address system just as our workshop was ending.
examples.zh: 研讨活动将要结束时，「公共广播系统」播出了一条通知。

examples.en: Staff checked the public address system before opening the hall for student orientation that morning.
examples.zh: 那天上午，大厅开放举行新生说明会之前，工作人员检查了「公共广播系统」。

words.zhGloss: 为投保人代理的公估师
words.enDefinition: A US professional who represents policyholders in property insurance claims
acceptedZhAnswers: 为投保人代理的公估师

examples.en: The US guide explained which party a public adjuster works for.
examples.zh: 美国指南说明了「为投保人代理的公估师」代表的是哪一方。

examples.en: I asked how the guide distinguished a public adjuster from the insurer's representative.
examples.zh: 我问指南怎样区分「为投保人代理的公估师」和保险公司的代表。

collocations: a report by a public adjuster

words.enDefinition: An announcement about the availability of facilities used by the public

examples.en: The council linked to its public facilities update below the storm notice.
examples.zh: 市议会在风暴通知下附上了「公共设施开放动态」的链接。

examples.en: I checked the public facilities update for changes to sports centre hours.
examples.zh: 我查看了「公共设施开放动态」，确认体育中心的时间是否有变动。

words.enDefinition: to injure a muscle by overstretching it or exerting it suddenly

examples.en: I thought I might pull a muscle when the heavy box shifted suddenly.
examples.zh: 那个重箱子突然移位时，我以为自己可能会「拉伤肌肉」。

examples.en: My teammate said she could pull a muscle if she kept sprinting that hard.
examples.zh: 队友说，如果她继续这么拼命地冲刺，可能会「拉伤肌肉」。

collocations: pull a muscle in your back

words.enDefinition: a narrow wound made by something pointed piercing the skin

examples.en: I saw what looked like a small puncture wound after she stepped on a tack.
examples.zh: 她踩到图钉后，我看到一处像是「小小的刺伤伤口」。

examples.en: The student described a puncture wound on his hand where the wire had caught him.
examples.zh: 那名学生描述了手被金属丝挂到后留下的「刺伤伤口」。

collocations: a puncture wound in the foot

words.enDefinition: The date an item was bought by its owner

examples.en: I found the purchase date near the top of my old receipt.
examples.zh: 我在旧收据靠近顶部的地方找到了「购买日期」。

examples.en: The insurer asked which document showed the purchase date for the bicycle.
examples.zh: 保险公司问，哪份文件写有这辆自行车的「购买日期」。

words.enDefinition: A horizontal bar fitted across a door that releases the latch when pushed.

examples.en: The guide identified the push bar across the emergency exit door in the auditorium.
examples.zh: 向导指给我们看了礼堂紧急出口门上的「出口门推杆」。

examples.en: The maintenance sheet listed a loose push bar on the door near the lobby.
examples.zh: 维修单注明，大厅附近的门上有一根松动的「出口门推杆」。

collocations: a door with a push bar
a push bar on an exit door

words.enDefinition: to play a call aloud through the phone's speaker

examples.en: We can put the call on speaker so everybody hears which entrance she means.
examples.zh: 我们可以「开免提」，这样大家都听得出她指的是哪个入口。

examples.en: I asked him to put the call on speaker so the caretaker could hear too.
examples.zh: 我请他「开免提」，好让管理员也能听到。

collocations: ask to be put on speaker

words.enDefinition: a handheld device used to send and receive voice messages by radio

examples.en: The campus officer picked up her radio handset before walking toward the rear gate.
examples.zh: 校园警员拿起「无线电对讲机」，朝后门走去。

examples.en: The caretaker could hear a message coming from the radio handset at reception.
examples.zh: 管理员听到前台的「无线电对讲机」传出消息。

words.enDefinition: Amounts of rain measured over a stated period in different places

examples.en: The report showed different rainfall totals for the northern and southern districts.
examples.zh: 报告列出了北区和南区不同的「累计降雨量」。

examples.en: I checked which period the rainfall totals covered in that bulletin.
examples.zh: 我查了那份公报的「累计降雨量」涵盖哪个时段。

words.enDefinition: To go into a building again after leaving it.

examples.en: We were allowed to re-enter the building after the practice session ended and staff finished their checks.
examples.zh: 演习结束且工作人员完成检查后，我们获准「重新进入楼内」。

examples.en: I asked at the desk when we could re-enter the building to collect our bags.
examples.zh: 我在服务台询问什么时候可以「重新进入楼内」取包。

collocations: be allowed to re-enter the building

words.enDefinition: to say written words so another person can hear them

examples.en: The form was hard to read, so I asked her to read it aloud.
examples.zh: 表格看不清楚，我便请她「读出来」。

examples.en: Could you read it aloud while I look for my glasses in the bag?
examples.zh: 我在包里找眼镜，你能「把它读出来」吗？

collocations: ask someone to read it aloud

words.enDefinition: text communication in which characters appear to the other person as they are typed

examples.en: The phone's accessibility menu showed real-time text beside the other calling options.
examples.zh: 手机的无障碍菜单把「实时文字通话」列在其他通话选项旁边。

examples.en: The demonstration showed how real-time text appears letter by letter on the operator's screen.
examples.zh: 演示展示了「实时文字通话」如何逐个字符显示在接线员屏幕上。

words.enDefinition: to tell the person on the phone something that helps them feel less worried

examples.en: The operator spoke slowly to reassure the caller while checking the address on screen.
examples.zh: 接线员一边在屏幕上核对地址，一边慢慢地说话「安抚来电者」。

examples.en: The call handler tried to reassure the caller that the crew had the information.
examples.zh: 接线员试着「安抚来电者」，告诉对方救援队已收到信息。

collocations: reassure the caller that help is coming

words.enDefinition: a record of when, where, or how missing property was regained

examples.en: The officer added the bicycle's colour to the record of recovery before closing the file.
examples.zh: 结案前，警员把自行车的颜色写进了「财物找回记录」。

examples.en: The record of recovery showed that a student had found the wallet near campus.
examples.zh: 「财物找回记录」显示，一名学生在校园附近捡到了钱包。

words.enDefinition: A spoken announcement saved in advance for later playback.

examples.en: We heard a recorded announcement explaining that the public address system was being tested.
examples.zh: 我们听到一条「预录广播」，说明公共广播系统正在测试。

examples.en: A recorded announcement gave the building name twice before the speakers went quiet again.
examples.zh: 扬声器再次安静前，「预录广播」把楼名重复了两遍。

collocations: a prerecorded announcement in the lobby

words.enDefinition: Costs for which repayment may be available under the applicable terms

examples.en: The insurer described which recoverable costs were shown in its example.
examples.zh: 保险公司说明了示例里列出了哪些「可要求补偿的费用」。

examples.en: I asked why one item appeared under recoverable costs on the statement.
examples.zh: 我问说明上有一项为什么列在「可要求补偿的费用」下面。

words.enDefinition: Depreciation withheld initially that may later be paid under policy terms

examples.en: The US sample showed recoverable depreciation as a separate amount.
examples.zh: 美国样本把「可补偿的折旧额」单列为一笔金额。

examples.en: I asked where the letter described recoverable depreciation for that item.
examples.zh: 我问信件在何处说明了该物品的「可补偿的折旧额」。

words.enDefinition: belongings that have been located or retrieved after being lost or taken

examples.en: The campus desk called to say some recovered property matched the details I'd given.
examples.zh: 校园服务台来电说，有些「已找回的财物」和我提供的特征相符。

examples.en: We checked the recovered property list before making a second trip to the station.
examples.zh: 我们查看了「已找回财物」清单，才第二次前往车站。

words.enDefinition: A request for help with needs following a disruptive event

examples.en: The office acknowledged my recovery assistance application in a separate message.
examples.zh: 办公室另发了一条消息，确认收到了我的「事后恢复援助申请」。

examples.en: I checked the name on the recovery assistance application before meeting the adviser.
examples.zh: 见顾问之前，我核对了「事后恢复援助申请」上的姓名。

collocations: details of a recovery assistance application

words.enDefinition: A person organizing support and communication after a disruptive incident

examples.en: The recovery coordinator introduced herself at the accommodation office that morning.
examples.zh: 「后续恢复协调员」那天早上在住宿办公室作了自我介绍。

examples.en: I asked which message came from the recovery coordinator for our building.
examples.zh: 我问哪条消息来自我们大楼的「后续恢复协调员」。

collocations: an update from the recovery coordinator

words.enDefinition: an email address set up to help a user regain account access

examples.en: I found the confirmation message in the inbox for my recovery email that evening.
examples.zh: 那天晚上，我在「账号找回邮箱」的收件箱里找到了确认邮件。

examples.en: The campus portal asked me to verify my recovery email before continuing the request.
examples.zh: 校园门户网站要求我验证「账号找回邮箱」，才能继续办理。

words.enDefinition: An organized outline of support or work after a disruption

examples.en: The university shared its recovery plan with the residents' committee.
examples.zh: 大学与住户委员会分享了它的「后续恢复计划」。

examples.en: I asked which part of the recovery plan concerned our floor.
examples.zh: 我问「后续恢复计划」哪一部分涉及我们这层。

words.enDefinition: A group helping people manage the aftermath of an incident

examples.en: The recovery support team sent a single update to all affected residents.
examples.zh: 「恢复援助团队」给所有受影响的居民发了同一份动态。

examples.en: I asked where the recovery support team was meeting students that week.
examples.zh: 我问「恢复援助团队」那一周在哪里会见学生。

collocations: an update from the recovery support team

words.enDefinition: An outline of expected stages in recovering from an incident

examples.en: The recovery timeline listed the dates for updates about our rooms.
examples.zh: 「后续恢复时间安排」列出了发布房间情况动态的日期。

examples.en: I read the recovery timeline before checking my temporary housing details.
examples.zh: 我先读了「后续恢复时间安排」，再核对临时住宿详情。

words.enDefinition: A US warning that weather conditions favor dangerous fire activity

examples.en: The US county mentioned a Red Flag Warning in its park update.
examples.zh: 美国的这个县在公园动态中提到了一条「美国火险红旗警告」。

examples.en: The forecaster posted a Red Flag Warning on the fire weather map.
examples.zh: 预报人员在火险天气地图上发布了一条「美国火险红旗警告」。

collocations: an area under a Red Flag Warning

words.enDefinition: The highest UK weather warning level for expected severe impacts

examples.en: The UK bulletin displayed a red weather warning for the coastal district.
examples.zh: 英国公报为沿海地区发布了「红色天气警告」。

examples.en: I read which areas were covered by the red weather warning on that day.
examples.zh: 我读了当天的「红色天气警告」，确认它覆盖哪些地方。

collocations: a red weather warning in force
areas covered by a red weather warning

words.enDefinition: Conditions making it harder to see over normal distances

examples.en: The bus update mentioned reduced visibility near the river crossing.
examples.zh: 公交动态提到过河路段附近「能见度下降」。

examples.en: The weather report showed where reduced visibility was expected after dark.
examples.zh: 天气报告标出了天黑后哪些地方预计会「能见度下降」。

words.enDefinition: An intercom that allows someone in an area of refuge to communicate with staff.

examples.en: A yellow symbol on the accessibility map marked the refuge intercom on the upper floor.
examples.zh: 无障碍地图上的黄色图标标出了楼上的「避难区对讲装置」。

examples.en: Facilities staff recorded the date of the refuge intercom test on the inspection sheet.
examples.zh: 设施管理人员在检查表上记下了「避难区对讲装置」的测试日期。

collocations: a refuge intercom at the stairwell

words.enDefinition: to become conscious again after being unconscious

examples.en: The staff member asked whether I had seen him regain consciousness at all.
examples.zh: 那位工作人员问，我有没有看到他「恢复意识」。

examples.en: She didn't regain consciousness until after the event medic had reached the room.
examples.zh: 直到现场医护人员赶到房间后，她才「恢复意识」。

collocations: regain consciousness a few minutes later

words.enDefinition: to enter the details of something missing in an official system

examples.en: The visitor centre offered to register a loss while I checked the café upstairs.
examples.zh: 我去楼上的咖啡馆找时，游客中心主动提出帮我「登记遗失情况」。

examples.en: I could register a loss online if the station desk was already closed.
examples.zh: 如果车站服务台已经关了，我可以在线「登记遗失情况」。

words.enDefinition: a person who relays messages between callers using different modes of communication

examples.en: The relay operator read each typed message aloud to the person at reception.
examples.zh: 「中继话务员」把每条打出来的消息念给前台接听的人。

examples.en: I paused so the relay operator could finish passing my answer to the caller.
examples.zh: 我停了一下，让「中继话务员」把我的回答完整转达给来电者。

words.enDefinition: to allow a held item to be taken away by someone entitled to it

examples.en: The office agreed to release the property after comparing my ID with the record.
examples.zh: 办事处将我的证件与记录核对后，同意「交还保管的财物」。

examples.en: The clerk signed the form to release the property to my authorized collector.
examples.zh: 办事员签署表格，把「保管的财物交还」给我授权的代领人。

collocations: release the property to its owner

words.enDefinition: to stay able to respond or be contacted if needed

examples.en: The officer asked the witness to remain available by phone through the afternoon.
examples.zh: 警员请目击者下午「继续保持联络畅通」。

examples.en: I agreed to remain available while the crew looked for the correct campus entrance.
examples.zh: 我答应「继续保持联络畅通」，等救援队找到正确的校园入口。

words.enDefinition: a feature or command that locks a device from another location

examples.en: The university's mobile help page explained when a remote lock could take effect.
examples.zh: 大学手机帮助页面解释了「远程锁定设备」的操作何时可以生效。

examples.en: The support technician confirmed that the remote lock was pending while the phone was offline.
examples.zh: 技术支持人员确认，手机离线期间，「远程锁定设备」的操作仍在等待生效。

words.enDefinition: To start considering an insurance claim again after closing it

examples.en: The insurer explained what it meant to reopen the claim on the portal.
examples.zh: 保险公司解释了其网站上「重新开启理赔案件」的意思。

examples.en: The handler said the office had decided to reopen the claim.
examples.zh: 经办人说，办公室已决定「重新开启理赔案件」。

collocations: a request to reopen the claim
an insurer may reopen the claim

words.enDefinition: A notice that a place is expected to reopen later than previously announced.

examples.en: The website displayed “Reopening delayed” above the study center's hours on the following morning.
examples.zh: 第二天早上，网站在学习中心的开放时间上方显示「重新开放延期」。

examples.en: The status message changed to “Reopening delayed” while we were waiting outside the hall.
examples.zh: 我们在大厅外等候时，状态消息改成了「重新开放延期」。

collocations: a message that says reopening delayed

words.enDefinition: New information about when or how a closed place will reopen

examples.en: The reopening update gave the latest hours for the park entrance.
examples.zh: 「重新开放动态」公布了公园入口最新的开放时间。

examples.en: I saved the reopening update before checking the new bus timetable.
examples.zh: 我先存了「重新开放动态」，再看新的公交时刻表。

collocations: a reopening update from the council

words.enDefinition: A status indicating that a decision on authorizing repairs remains outstanding

examples.en: The property file showed repair approval pending beside the estimate we received.
examples.zh: 财产档案在我们收到的估价单旁显示「尚待维修批准」。

examples.en: I asked what repair approval pending meant in that part of the file.
examples.zh: 我问案卷那部分的「尚待维修批准」是什么意思。

collocations: an entry marked repair approval pending
a notice stating repair approval pending
a case marked repair approval pending

words.enDefinition: A message confirming that a specified repair job is finished

examples.en: The office delivered a repair completion notice before updating the room assignment.
examples.zh: 办公室更新房间分配之前，送达了一份「维修完工通知」。

examples.en: I checked which rooms were named on the repair completion notice.
examples.zh: 我核对了「维修完工通知」上列了哪些房间。

words.enDefinition: A document listing charges for repair work carried out

examples.en: I checked the address at the top of the repair invoice.
examples.zh: 我核对了「维修发票」顶部的地址。

examples.en: The office kept the repair invoice with the original estimate.
examples.zh: 办公室把「维修发票」和最初的估价单放在一起保存。

words.enDefinition: The specific tasks and areas included in proposed repair work

examples.en: The estimate set out the repair scope beneath the address.
examples.zh: 估价单在地址下方列出了「维修项目范围」。

examples.en: I asked whether our hallway appeared in the repair scope.
examples.zh: 我问「维修项目范围」里有没有我们那条走廊。

words.enDefinition: A status indicating the reported repair work is finished

examples.en: The latest bulletin said "Repairs complete" for the affected road.
examples.zh: 最新公报把受影响道路标为「维修已完成」。

examples.en: The provider sent "Repairs complete" as an update about our building.
examples.zh: 服务商发来一条有关我们这栋楼的更新，写着「维修已完成」。

words.enDefinition: to ask the same question again, usually to make sure it was heard

examples.en: Could you repeat the question while I move away from the traffic noise?
examples.zh: 你能「把问题再说一遍」吗？我先离车流远一点。

examples.en: I asked the call handler to repeat the question because the train was loud.
examples.zh: 列车噪声太大，我请接线员「把问题再说一遍」。

collocations: ask someone to repeat the question

words.enDefinition: a new access card issued in place of an earlier one

examples.en: I collected my replacement access card on the way back from the lecture hall.
examples.zh: 我从阶梯教室回来的路上领到了「补发的门禁卡」。

examples.en: The residence office confirmed that my replacement access card would work at both entrances.
examples.zh: 宿管办公室确认，「补发的门禁卡」在两个入口都能用。

words.enDefinition: Sheets, covers, or other bedding supplied in place of existing items

examples.en: The accommodation team brought replacement bedding to our temporary room.
examples.zh: 住宿团队把「替换用床上用品」送到了我们的临时房间。

examples.en: The note said where the replacement bedding had been left for us.
examples.zh: 提示写明了给我们准备的「替换用床上用品」放在哪里。

words.enDefinition: a key made or supplied in place of one that was lost or damaged

examples.en: The caretaker left a replacement key in a sealed envelope for me at reception.
examples.zh: 管理员把「补配的钥匙」装进密封信封，放在前台让我取。

examples.en: I tested the replacement key with the caretaker before taking it back upstairs.
examples.zh: 我和管理员试了试「补配的钥匙」，然后才把它带回楼上。

words.enDefinition: An estimated price for replacing a damaged item or property

examples.en: I attached a replacement quote for the damaged study desk.
examples.zh: 我为受损书桌附上了一份「更换物品的报价」。

examples.en: The adviser asked when the replacement quote had been issued.
examples.zh: 顾问问这份「更换物品的报价」是什么时候出具的。

words.enDefinition: a new SIM supplied to replace one that is missing or no longer usable

examples.en: My replacement SIM arrived in a small envelope from the network provider on Thursday.
examples.zh: 周四，运营商用一个小信封寄来了「补发的SIM卡」。

examples.en: The shop assistant checked my order before handing me the replacement SIM that afternoon.
examples.zh: 那天下午，店员核对订单后，把「补发的SIM卡」交给了我。

words.enDefinition: a transport pass issued in place of one that is lost or unusable

examples.en: The clerk confirmed where I could pick up my replacement travel pass that afternoon.
examples.zh: 办事员确认了当天下午我可以去哪里领取「补发的交通卡」。

examples.en: I tested my replacement travel pass on the bus outside the students' union.
examples.zh: 我在学生会大楼外的公交车上试了一下「补发的交通卡」。

collocations: apply for a replacement travel pass

words.enDefinition: to notify the responsible authorities that something has been stolen

examples.en: The caretaker showed me the number to call to report a theft in the building.
examples.zh: 管理员告诉我，在楼里「报告失窃」要拨哪个号码。

examples.en: Two students went to the reception desk to report a theft from their locker.
examples.zh: 两名学生到前台「报告储物柜失窃」。

collocations: report a theft to campus security

words.enDefinition: a message confirming that someone received an incident report

examples.en: The report acknowledgement included a contact address for questions about my missing bike.
examples.zh: 「报案收件确认」中有一个联系地址，可用于询问丢失的自行车。

examples.en: I saved the report acknowledgement separately from the later decision about my case.
examples.zh: 我把「报案收件确认」和之后关于本案的决定分开保存。

words.enDefinition: to notify the appropriate people or services of an urgent incident

examples.en: The night porter used the desk phone to report an emergency in the courtyard.
examples.zh: 夜间门卫用值班台的电话「报告了紧急情况」，地点是院子。

examples.en: Residents can use the posted number to report an emergency on the premises.
examples.zh: 如果楼内出现紧急情况，住户可以拨打张贴的电话「报告紧急情况」。

words.enDefinition: to tell a responsible person or organization about an injury

examples.en: I went to the counter to report an injury in the rehearsal room.
examples.zh: 我到柜台「报告排练室里有人受伤」。

examples.en: The instructor showed us where to report an injury on the campus website.
examples.zh: 老师给我们看了怎样在校园网站上「报告有人受伤」。

collocations: report an injury to a supervisor
report an injury at the desk

words.enDefinition: to tell an organization that an item can no longer be found

examples.en: I waited by the ticket desk to report an item missing from our coach.
examples.zh: 我在票务台旁等着，准备「报告有件物品落在」我们的大巴上。

examples.en: A resident used the front desk's website to report an item missing on campus.
examples.zh: 一名住宿生通过前台网站「报告一件物品在校园里遗失」。

collocations: call to report an item missing
report an item missing after a trip

words.enDefinition: To go to the designated gathering place so your presence can be checked.

examples.en: During the exercise, the recording asked residents to report to the assembly point outside.
examples.zh: 演习期间，录音广播请住户「到室外集合点报到」。

examples.en: We learned which path to take when asked to report to the assembly point.
examples.zh: 我们了解了在被要求「到集合点报到」时应走哪条路。

collocations: report to the assembly point outside
report to your assigned assembly point
be asked to report to the assembly point

words.enDefinition: a website where people submit information to an authority or organization

examples.en: I found the campus reporting portal on the student services page that evening.
examples.zh: 那天晚上，我在学生服务网页上找到了校园「线上申报平台」。

examples.en: The reporting portal let me attach a photograph of the missing bag before submission.
examples.zh: 「线上申报平台」允许我在提交前附上遗失包的照片。

collocations: submit a report through the reporting portal

words.enDefinition: A meeting or update giving residents information about their situation

examples.en: The housing manager held a resident briefing in the student centre.
examples.zh: 住宿管理员在学生中心举办了一场「住户情况说明会」。

examples.en: I read the notes from the resident briefing after my class.
examples.zh: 下课后，我看了「住户情况说明会」的记录。

words.enDefinition: to react when someone calls you by name

examples.en: The staff member asked if you could respond to your name after you fell.
examples.zh: 工作人员问，你摔倒后能不能「听到自己名字就有反应」。

examples.en: You didn't respond to your name when I called from across the room.
examples.zh: 我隔着房间喊了你的名字，可你「没有反应」。

collocations: respond to your name right away
able to respond to your name

words.enDefinition: a crew or vehicle assigned to respond to a particular incident

examples.en: The responding unit reached the building from the quieter side street behind campus.
examples.zh: 「出勤的应急单位」从校园后面较安静的小街抵达了这栋楼。

examples.en: The dispatcher passed the updated entrance details to the responding unit by radio.
examples.zh: 调度员通过无线电向「出勤的应急单位」补充了最新的入口信息。

words.enDefinition: Words indicating a service will take longer to return than expected

examples.en: The update said "Restoration delayed" and gave a new estimate.
examples.zh: 动态说「服务恢复延后」，并给出了新的预计时间。

examples.en: I read "Restoration delayed" next to the latest reported fault.
examples.zh: 我在最新报告的故障旁看到了「服务恢复延后」。

collocations: a service status saying restoration delayed

words.enDefinition: A status saying no recovery time can currently be provided

examples.en: The page said "Restoration estimate unavailable" beneath the affected area map.
examples.zh: 页面在受影响区域的地图下显示「暂无预计恢复时间」。

examples.en: I saw "Restoration estimate unavailable" before the revised time was posted.
examples.zh: 我在调整后的时间发布前看到「暂无预计恢复时间」。

collocations: a notice reading restoration estimate unavailable
a map marked restoration estimate unavailable
an outage status of restoration estimate unavailable

words.enDefinition: A status indicating work to return a service has begun

examples.en: The utility map showed "Restoration in progress" for several nearby streets.
examples.zh: 公用服务机构地图把附近几条街标为「服务正在恢复」。

examples.en: The second update said "Restoration in progress" under the service heading.
examples.zh: 第二条动态在服务标题下写着「服务正在恢复」。

collocations: a notice reading restoration in progress
a map marked restoration in progress
an outage update saying restoration in progress

words.enDefinition: An update saying service has returned for only some affected customers

examples.en: The utility said power was restored to some customers in the eastern district.
examples.zh: 供电机构表示，东部辖区的「部分用户已恢复供电」。

examples.en: I read that service was restored to some customers after the first repair.
examples.zh: 我看到消息说，第一轮维修后「部分用户服务已恢复」。

collocations: an update saying restored to some customers

words.enDefinition: To return to the usual schedule after a disruption

examples.en: The library said it would resume normal hours the following day.
examples.zh: 图书馆说，第二天会「恢复正常开放时间」。

examples.en: I checked when the sports centre planned to resume normal hours.
examples.zh: 我查了体育中心计划什么时候「恢复正常开放时间」。

collocations: announce when to resume normal hours

words.enDefinition: To return to the usual running of an institution or facility after a disruption.

examples.en: The student center was able to resume normal operations after the inspection ended that afternoon.
examples.zh: 当天下午检查结束后，学生活动中心得以「恢复正常运营」。

examples.en: The email said both libraries would resume normal operations at their regular time on Monday.
examples.zh: 邮件说，两家图书馆将于星期一的常规时间「恢复正常运营」。

collocations: be ready to resume normal operations
a date to resume normal operations

words.enDefinition: a face barrier designed for giving rescue breaths

examples.en: The volunteer recognised the resuscitation mask from a diagram in the training booklet.
examples.zh: 志愿者凭培训手册上的示意图认出了「复苏面罩」。

examples.en: The resuscitation mask was stored in a blue case with an illustrated label.
examples.zh: 「复苏面罩」放在蓝色盒子里，盒上贴着有图示的标签。

collocations: a case for a resuscitation mask

words.expression: return an item to its owner
words.lemma: return an item to its owner
words.enDefinition: to give a recovered object back to the person it belongs to
acceptedEnVariants: return an item to its owner

examples.en: Staff can return an item to its owner after checking the name on its label.
examples.zh: 工作人员核对标签上的姓名后，可以「把物品归还给物主」。

examples.en: The caretaker used the school register to return an item to its owner.
examples.zh: 管理员利用学校登记册「把物品归还给物主」。

collocations: help return an item to its owner
arrange to return an item to its owner
try to return an item to its owner

words.enDefinition: to formally remove a permission allowing someone or something to use a resource

examples.en: The librarian asked IT to revoke access for the missing staff card that afternoon.
examples.zh: 那天下午，图书管理员请 IT 部门对遗失的员工卡执行「撤销访问权限」操作。

examples.en: The support team confirmed that it could revoke access for my old device.
examples.zh: 支持团队确认，可以对我的旧设备执行「撤销访问权限」操作。

words.enDefinition: The possibility that normal services or activities will be interrupted

examples.en: The campus notice mentioned a risk of disruption to afternoon transport.
examples.zh: 学校的通知提到下午交通存在「服务受扰风险」。

examples.en: I read which services had a risk of disruption during the storm.
examples.zh: 我查看了暴风雨期间哪些服务有「服务受扰风险」。

collocations: warn of a risk of disruption

words.enDefinition: An official alert for a river expected to reach flood levels

examples.en: The river flood warning named the river by our field station.
examples.zh: 「河流洪水警告」点到了野外工作站旁边那条河。

examples.en: The map marked areas covered by the river flood warning in blue.
examples.zh: 地图用蓝色标出了「河流洪水警告」涵盖的地区。

collocations: a river flood warning for a basin
a river under a river flood warning

words.enDefinition: A prediction of how high the water in a river will be

examples.en: The river level forecast showed a rise near our fieldwork site.
examples.zh: 「河流水位预报」显示实地考察地点附近水位将上涨。

examples.en: I found the river level forecast beside the map of local roads.
examples.zh: 我在本地道路地图旁找到了「河流水位预报」。

words.enDefinition: The formation of ice on a paved road surface

examples.en: The shuttle operator reported road icing along the riverside route.
examples.zh: 班车运营方报告说，临河线路发生了「道路结冰」。

examples.en: The forecast highlighted a risk of road icing after dark.
examples.zh: 预报特别指出，天黑后可能出现「道路结冰」。

words.enDefinition: A status indicating a road cannot currently be used for travel

examples.en: The county map showed "Road impassable" beside the riverside road.
examples.zh: 县里的地图在临河道路旁显示「道路无法通行」。

examples.en: I asked which section was marked "Road impassable" that evening.
examples.zh: 我问当晚哪一段路被标记为「道路无法通行」。

collocations: a map entry reading road impassable

words.enDefinition: Work applied to road surfaces to manage snow or ice

examples.en: The local bulletin listed road treatment for the main roads overnight.
examples.zh: 本地公报列出了夜间对主要道路进行「道路防冰处理」的安排。

examples.en: The update showed where road treatment was already complete that morning.
examples.zh: 更新显示当天早上哪些地方已经完成「道路防冰处理」。

collocations: work crews carrying out road treatment

words.enDefinition: Damage where flowing water removes part of a roadway

examples.en: The local update linked the route closure to a road washout.
examples.zh: 本地动态说，线路封闭是因为「道路被水冲毁」。

examples.en: The council map marked the location of the road washout.
examples.zh: 市议会地图标出了「道路被水冲毁」的位置。

collocations: a route affected by a road washout

words.enDefinition: to twist your ankle sideways unexpectedly, often while stepping or landing

examples.en: Did you roll your ankle when you stepped off the edge of the path?
examples.zh: 你从小路边缘迈下去时「崴脚了」吗？

examples.en: It's easy to roll your ankle on the uneven grass behind the gym.
examples.zh: 体育馆后面那片草地不平，很容易「崴脚」。

collocations: roll your ankle on uneven ground
roll your ankle when you land

words.enDefinition: A planned series of temporary electricity interruptions in different areas

examples.en: The provider used the term rolling blackout in its public update.
examples.zh: 供电方在公开动态中用了「轮流停电」这个词。

examples.en: I checked which areas the rolling blackout notice named on the map.
examples.zh: 我核对了「轮流停电」通知在地图上列出的区域。

collocations: areas affected by a rolling blackout

words.enDefinition: A change assigning a resident to a different room

examples.en: The office explained where our room reassignment appeared in the housing portal.
examples.zh: 办公室说明了我们的「重新分配房间」安排显示在住宿平台的什么位置。

examples.en: I received a short note confirming the room reassignment for my floor.
examples.zh: 我收到一条简短通知，确认我们这层会「重新分配房间」。

words.enDefinition: Sea conditions with large or irregular waves and movement

examples.en: The ferry operator cited rough seas in its latest timetable update.
examples.zh: 渡轮运营方在时刻表最新动态里提到「海面风浪大」。

examples.en: I read the message about rough seas near the harbor.
examples.zh: 我读了关于港湾附近「海面风浪大」的消息。

collocations: a crossing cancelled due to rough seas

words.enDefinition: the approximate time at which an event occurred

examples.en: I remembered roughly when it happened because our class had just started.
examples.zh: 我记得事情「大概什么时候发生的」，因为当时刚开始上课。

examples.en: The officer asked roughly when it happened and whether the room was crowded.
examples.zh: 安全员问事情「大概什么时候发生的」，当时房间里人多不多。

words.enDefinition: A short meeting or talk covering safety information for a place or activity.

examples.en: Visitors joined a short safety briefing before going into the photography studio for their tour.
examples.zh: 访客进入摄影工作室参观前，参加了一场简短的「安全说明会」。

examples.en: The activity leader included a map of the building in the safety briefing for new students.
examples.zh: 活动负责人在面向新生的「安全说明会」中附上了楼宇地图。

words.enDefinition: a workplace fixture designed to rinse accidental contamination from the body

examples.en: The safety shower was marked on the map outside the chemistry lab.
examples.zh: 化学实验室门外的图上标有「应急冲淋装置」。

examples.en: Our guide pointed out the yellow sign above the safety shower near reception.
examples.zh: 向导给我们指了接待处附近「应急冲淋装置」上方的黄色标牌。

collocations: the location of a safety shower

words.enDefinition: a burn caused by hot liquid or steam

examples.en: The kitchen worker reported a scald after hot water spilled across her wrist.
examples.zh: 热水洒在手腕上后，厨房工作人员报告说自己「烫伤了」。

examples.en: I heard the volunteer say the red mark was a scald from steam.
examples.zh: 我听见志愿者说那片红印是蒸汽造成的「烫伤」。

words.enDefinition: A check of a system arranged in advance for a particular time.

examples.en: The university mentioned the scheduled system test in its newsletter two days before the event.
examples.zh: 大学在测试开始两天前的简报里提到了「预定的系统测试」。

examples.en: I received a text marked “Scheduled system test” while studying in the media room.
examples.zh: 我在媒体室学习时收到一条标有「预定的系统测试」的短信。

words.enDefinition: to rub skin off the knee against a rough surface

examples.en: Did you scrape your knee on the gravel when you fell outside?
examples.zh: 你刚才在外面摔倒时，「膝盖被碎石擦伤了」吗？

examples.en: How did you scrape your knee if you landed on your hands?
examples.zh: 如果是手先着地，你是怎么「擦伤膝盖」的？

collocations: scrape your knee in a fall

words.enDefinition: To leave a place in an emergency without assistance from other people.

examples.en: The planning form asked whether each participant would be able to self-evacuate from that room.
examples.zh: 计划表询问每位参与者能否从那间房「自行疏散」。

examples.en: Staff discussed how they would support students who might be unable to self-evacuate from upstairs.
examples.zh: 工作人员讨论了如何支持可能无法从楼上「自行疏散」的学生。

words.enDefinition: a status saying an item was transferred to a transport company's storage facility

examples.en: The umbrella had been sent to the depot before I reached the station that afternoon.
examples.zh: 当天下午我到车站前，雨伞「已送到车场保管」。

examples.en: The update showed sent to the depot beside the description of my blue bag.
examples.zh: 更新内容在我的蓝包描述旁显示「已送到车场保管」。

words.enDefinition: a unique number or code assigned to an individual manufactured item

examples.en: The receipt still showed the serial number of the laptop I had bought.
examples.zh: 购物凭条上还印着我买的那台笔记本电脑的「序列号」。

examples.en: I copied the serial number from the box into the lost property form.
examples.zh: 我把盒子上的「序列号」抄进了失物登记表。

words.enDefinition: an entrance normally used by workers or deliveries rather than the public

examples.en: The caretaker unlocked the service entrance so the crew could reach the lower floor.
examples.zh: 管理员打开「后勤出入口」，让救援队能到下一层。

examples.en: Our building plan shows the service entrance behind the row of bicycle racks.
examples.zh: 我们楼的平面图显示，「后勤出入口」在那排自行车架后面。

words.enDefinition: a smaller road running beside a major road or providing local access to facilities

examples.en: The caller said the stalled van was on the service road beside campus.
examples.zh: 来电者说，抛锚的货车停在校园旁的「辅路」上。

examples.en: The front desk pointed the crew toward the service road behind the laboratory.
examples.zh: 前台人员给救援队指了实验楼后面的「辅路」。

words.enDefinition: A record or confirmation that a claim settlement was accepted

examples.en: The insurer filed the settlement acceptance separately from the payment notice.
examples.zh: 保险公司把「接受理赔结算方案」的记录与付款通知分开存档。

examples.en: I asked which date appeared on the settlement acceptance form.
examples.zh: 我问「接受理赔结算方案」的表格上写的是哪个日期。

words.enDefinition: An itemized explanation of how a claim settlement amount was calculated

examples.en: I used the settlement breakdown to identify the amount for my desk.
examples.zh: 我查了「赔付金额明细」，确认其中分给书桌的金额。

examples.en: The settlement breakdown showed the repair and replacement amounts separately.
examples.zh: 「赔付金额明细」把维修与更换金额分开显示。

words.enDefinition: Money paid to resolve a loss under an insurance claim

examples.en: The statement showed which item the settlement payment was for.
examples.zh: 说明写明了「理赔结算款」对应哪件物品。

examples.en: I checked the settlement payment against the amount on the letter.
examples.zh: 我把「理赔结算款」和信件上的金额核对了一下。

collocations: a notice about a settlement payment

words.enDefinition: An official alert for thunderstorms expected to produce dangerous conditions

examples.en: The severe thunderstorm warning was posted while our workshop was still running.
examples.zh: 我们的讲座还在进行时，发布了一条「强雷暴警告」。

examples.en: I checked which towns the severe thunderstorm warning covered near the coast.
examples.zh: 我查看了「强雷暴警告」涵盖沿海哪些城镇。

collocations: an area under a severe thunderstorm warning

words.enDefinition: Weather likely to cause significant hazards or disruption in an area

examples.en: The library announced different hours because of severe weather in the area.
examples.zh: 由于当地有「恶劣天气」，图书馆公布了调整后的开放时间。

examples.en: The museum cited severe weather when it moved the workshop indoors.
examples.zh: 博物馆把讲座移到室内时，提到了「恶劣天气」。

words.enDefinition: To stay inside a building or designated place temporarily for protection.

examples.en: Our group discussed what “shelter in place” meant when reading an example campus alert.
examples.zh: 阅读校园警报示例时，我们小组讨论了「就地避险」的含义。

examples.en: The safety video used the phrase “shelter in place” in a sample announcement.
examples.zh: 安全视频中，一条例示广播用了「就地避险」这个说法。

collocations: an instruction to shelter in place
be asked to shelter in place
a notice to shelter in place

words.enDefinition: Financial help provided to meet needs over a limited period

examples.en: The campus adviser discussed short-term financial assistance in our first meeting.
examples.zh: 校园顾问在第一次会面中谈到了「短期经济援助」。

examples.en: I asked where the leaflet described short-term financial assistance for affected residents.
examples.zh: 我问说明单哪里介绍了受影响居民的「短期经济援助」。

words.enDefinition: a person who interprets between a signed language and another language

examples.en: The university arranged for a sign language interpreter to attend the safety briefing.
examples.zh: 学校安排了一名「手语口译员」参加安全说明会。

examples.en: A sign language interpreter helped the visitor understand the questions from campus staff.
examples.zh: 一名「手语口译员」帮助访客理解校方工作人员提出的问题。

words.zhGloss: 退出所有设备上的登录
words.enDefinition: to end the active logins for an account on all connected devices
acceptedZhAnswers: 退出所有设备上的登录

examples.en: The support team explained what would happen if I chose to sign out of all devices.
examples.zh: 支持团队解释了选择「退出所有设备上的登录」后会发生什么。

examples.en: I saw the option to sign out of all devices on the account page.
examples.zh: 我在账户页面上看到了「退出所有设备上的登录」的选项。

collocations: option to sign out of all devices
choose to sign out of all devices
button labelled “Sign out of all devices”

words.enDefinition: To register to receive safety warnings from a university or college.

examples.en: At orientation, the residence staff showed visitors where to sign up for campus alerts.
examples.zh: 新生说明会上，宿舍工作人员告诉访客去哪里「注册接收校园警报」。

examples.en: My tutor signed up for campus alerts after moving to the satellite campus this semester.
examples.zh: 导师本学期搬到分校区后，「注册接收了校园警报」。

collocations: sign up for campus alerts online
sign up for campus alerts by phone
help visitors sign up for campus alerts

words.enDefinition: the disappearance of a signal needed for a connection or transmission

examples.en: We experienced signal loss in the concrete stairwell and could no longer hear the operator.
examples.zh: 我们在混凝土楼梯间遇到了「信号丢失」，听不到接线员的声音了。

examples.en: The temporary signal loss ended as soon as the bus left the tunnel.
examples.zh: 公交车一出隧道，短暂的「信号丢失」就结束了。

words.enDefinition: A fictional emergency presented as part of a training activity or exercise.

examples.en: Our classmates read the alert about the simulated emergency and discussed its wording in pairs.
examples.zh: 同学们读了关于「模拟紧急情况」的警报，然后两人一组讨论它的措辞。

examples.en: The simulated emergency was described in a handout before the practice exercise began that afternoon.
examples.zh: 当天下午练习开始前，讲义中介绍了这次「模拟紧急情况」。

collocations: a briefing about a simulated emergency

words.enDefinition: A policy's maximum amount for a single item of property

examples.en: I asked where the single-item limit was listed for personal belongings.
examples.zh: 我问个人物品的「单件物品赔付上限」列在哪儿。

examples.en: The example showed the single-item limit beside the overall amount.
examples.zh: 示例在总额旁列出了「单件物品赔付上限」。

words.enDefinition: to lose your footing on a surface and fall

examples.en: I saw someone slip and fall as they came through the gym doors.
examples.zh: 我看见有人刚进体育馆大门就「滑倒了」。

examples.en: They were worried a visitor might slip and fall near the leaking water fountain.
examples.zh: 他们担心有访客会在漏水的饮水机旁「滑倒」。

collocations: slip and fall on a wet floor

words.enDefinition: leaning forward or sideways with the body hanging loosely

examples.en: I found him slumped over the desk when I arrived for the tutorial.
examples.zh: 我到教室上辅导课时，发现他「瘫靠在桌上」。

examples.en: She was slumped over the arm of the chair when we came in.
examples.zh: 我们进来时，她「瘫靠在椅子的扶手上」。

collocations: slumped over the arm of a chair

words.enDefinition: A wall or other building feature designed to limit the spread of smoke.

examples.en: The building diagram identified a smoke barrier between the rehearsal area and the main lobby.
examples.zh: 楼宇示意图标出了排练区与主大厅之间的「挡烟隔断」。

examples.en: The inspection summary listed the smoke barrier as a separate item under building safety features.
examples.zh: 检查摘要将「挡烟隔断」在楼宇安全设施下单独列为一项。

words.enDefinition: Physical harm or residue caused to property by exposure to smoke

examples.en: The maintenance note listed smoke damage in the shared laundry room.
examples.zh: 维护记录写着公共洗衣房有「烟熏损坏」。

examples.en: The assessor pointed out which photos showed the smoke damage.
examples.zh: 评估人员指出哪几张照片显示了「烟熏损坏」。

collocations: a room affected by smoke damage

words.enDefinition: The removal of snow from roads or other public surfaces

examples.en: The council posted the snow clearance schedule after the overnight storm.
examples.zh: 夜间风暴过后，市议会公布了「清除积雪」的安排。

examples.en: The bus notice mentioned snow clearance near the central station.
examples.zh: 公交通知提到中央车站附近正在「清除积雪」。

words.enDefinition: travelling or leading in the direction of south

examples.en: The radio report said the southbound carriageway had reopened after the morning crash.
examples.zh: 广播说，早上的撞车事故过后，「向南行驶的」一侧车道已重新开放。

examples.en: The emergency crew was approaching from the southbound side of the main road.
examples.zh: 救援队正从主路「向南行驶的」一侧过来。

words.enDefinition: to pronounce words so the listener can understand them easily

examples.en: I moved away from the crowd so I could speak clearly on the phone.
examples.zh: 我走到离人群远点的地方，好在电话里「说清楚一些」。

examples.en: The volunteer reminded us to speak clearly when reading out the building name.
examples.zh: 志愿者提醒我们念出楼名时要「说清楚一些」。

words.enDefinition: to take turns speaking so voices do not overlap

examples.en: Could you speak one at a time so I can follow what's happening?
examples.zh: 你们能「一个一个说」吗？这样我才能听清现在的情况。

examples.en: The teacher asked everyone to speak one at a time while she took notes.
examples.zh: 老师请大家「一个一个说」，她来做记录。

collocations: ask people to speak one at a time
take turns and speak one at a time
speak one at a time during the discussion

words.enDefinition: An official notice highlighting unusual or potentially disruptive weather conditions

examples.en: The Canadian forecast linked to a special weather statement for our region.
examples.zh: 加拿大的预报附上了本地区「特别天气说明」的链接。

examples.en: I noticed a special weather statement above the regular forecast for tomorrow.
examples.zh: 我注意到，明天的常规预报上方有一份「特别天气说明」。

collocations: details in a special weather statement

words.enDefinition: Insurance protection for a particular item listed in the policy

examples.en: The British policy listed specified item cover separately from the general contents section.
examples.zh: 英国这份保单把「列明物品的保险保障」与一般室内财物保障分开列出。

examples.en: I looked for my bicycle in the section on specified item cover.
examples.zh: 我在「列明物品的保险保障」一栏查找我的自行车。

collocations: a policy with specified item cover

words.enDefinition: a difficulty that affects the ability to produce clear speech

examples.en: A speech impairment made it harder for him to say the unfamiliar street name.
examples.zh: 由于「言语障碍」，他说出那条陌生的街名更费力。

examples.en: The student with a speech impairment asked to type the details on her phone.
examples.zh: 有「言语障碍」的学生问能不能在手机上打字说明情况。

words.enDefinition: to say the letters of a word individually for the listener

examples.en: I offered to spell it out when she asked how to write the street name.
examples.zh: 她问街名怎么写，我就主动提出「逐个字母拼出来」。

examples.en: Could you spell it out slowly so I get the building name right?
examples.zh: 你能慢慢地「逐个字母拼出来」吗？我想把楼名记对。

collocations: spell it out letter by letter

words.enDefinition: to say the individual letters in the name of a street

examples.en: The operator asked me to spell the street name because it sounded unfamiliar.
examples.zh: 接线员没听过这条街，就请我「拼出街名」。

examples.en: Could you spell the street name again while I write the letters down?
examples.zh: 你能再「拼一遍街名」吗？我把字母记下来。

collocations: ask someone to spell the street name

words.enDefinition: a cut in the lip caused by an impact

examples.en: I noticed a split lip when my teammate turned toward the bench.
examples.zh: 队友转身朝替补席走来时，我看到他「嘴唇裂伤了」。

examples.en: A split lip was the only injury she mentioned after colliding with another player.
examples.zh: 和另一名队员撞上后，她只说自己「嘴唇裂伤」。

collocations: a split lip after a collision

words.enDefinition: The individual fitting through which water is released in a fire sprinkler system.

examples.en: The maintenance request included a picture of a damaged sprinkler head in the study lounge.
examples.zh: 维修申请附了一张自习室里损坏的「消防喷头」的照片。

examples.en: A label next to each sprinkler head was visible in the model of the residence.
examples.zh: 宿舍模型里，每个「消防喷头」旁边的标签都看得见。

collocations: a sprinkler head in the ceiling

words.enDefinition: a written account describing what went missing and under what circumstances

examples.en: I gave the office a statement of loss describing where I last saw the document.
examples.zh: 我给办事处提交了一份「遗失情况说明」，写明最后一次见到文件的地点。

examples.en: The adviser read my statement of loss before discussing a replacement document with me.
examples.zh: 顾问读了我的「遗失情况说明」，再和我商量补发文件的事。

words.enDefinition: to remain close to a particular person or place

examples.en: I offered to stay nearby in case the staff needed another witness.
examples.zh: 我主动说可以「留在附近」，万一工作人员需要另一位目击者。

examples.en: She asked her roommate to stay nearby while she spoke with the officer.
examples.zh: 她请室友「留在附近」，自己和安全员交谈。

collocations: stay nearby for a few minutes

words.enDefinition: An exit that can be reached without having to use steps.

examples.en: The doorway on the north side was labeled as the step-free exit on the event map.
examples.zh: 活动地图把北侧门口标为「无台阶出口」。

examples.en: We could see the sign for the step-free exit from the entrance to the lecture hall.
examples.zh: 从阶梯教室入口可以看到「无台阶出口」的指示牌。

collocations: a step-free exit to the street

words.enDefinition: remaining on the floor after sitting down or falling

examples.en: I told the staff member she was still on the floor by the bench.
examples.zh: 我告诉工作人员，她「还在长凳旁的地上」。

examples.en: He was still on the floor when his teammate came back with the coach.
examples.zh: 队友带着教练回来时，他「还在地上」。

collocations: find someone still on the floor
someone is still on the floor
still on the floor by the bench

words.enDefinition: a bag that someone has taken without the owner's permission

examples.en: The student reported a stolen bag after two witnesses spoke to the station staff.
examples.zh: 两名目击者与车站工作人员沟通后，那名学生报告了「被偷的包」。

examples.en: One of the textbooks from the stolen bag was recovered later that afternoon.
examples.zh: 那天下午晚些时候，「被偷的包」里的一本教科书找了回来。

words.enDefinition: a credit card that someone has taken without the cardholder's permission

examples.en: The bank asked which recent purchases might have been made with the stolen credit card.
examples.zh: 银行询问近期有哪些消费可能是用「被盗的信用卡」完成的。

examples.en: I gave the officer the details of the stolen credit card for the report.
examples.zh: 我向警员提供了「被盗的信用卡」的资料，以便记录在报告中。

collocations: suspected use of a stolen credit card

words.enDefinition: a passport taken without the holder's permission

examples.en: The officer included the stolen passport in the report about my missing backpack.
examples.zh: 警员在有关背包丢失的报告中也写进了「被盗护照」。

examples.en: The consulate asked when I had last seen the stolen passport before the trip.
examples.zh: 领事馆问我，出发前最后一次看到「被盗护照」是什么时候。

words.enDefinition: possessions that someone has taken without the owner's permission

examples.en: The officer kept a separate list of stolen property recovered near the station.
examples.zh: 警员单独列了一张在车站附近找回的「被盗财物」清单。

examples.en: The shop found one of my missing items among the stolen property brought in.
examples.zh: 店员在送来的「被盗财物」中找到了我丢失的一件物品。

words.enDefinition: the number identifying a specific locker used to store personal items

examples.en: I gave the porter my storage locker number before he opened the register.
examples.zh: 门房打开登记册前，我向他报了「储物柜编号」。

examples.en: The storage locker number was still printed on the slip from the swimming pool.
examples.zh: 游泳馆的凭条上还印着「储物柜编号」。

words.enDefinition: An official check of damage to places or equipment after a storm
