examples.en: The city posted a storm damage assessment before updating the park schedule.
examples.zh: 市政府在更新公园开放安排前发布了「风暴灾损评估」。

examples.en: The crew mentioned its storm damage assessment in the afternoon bulletin.
examples.zh: 维护团队在下午公报中提到了他们的「风暴灾损评估」。

collocations: carry out a storm damage assessment
results of a storm damage assessment

words.enDefinition: Branches or other loose material left behind by a storm

examples.en: The park report listed storm debris on some of its paths.
examples.zh: 公园报告说，部分小路上有「风暴遗留的杂物」。

examples.en: The council said storm debris was affecting access to the gardens.
examples.zh: 市议会说，「风暴遗留的杂物」影响了进入花园的通道。

collocations: a route blocked by storm debris

words.enDefinition: Interruption of normal activities or services caused by a storm

examples.en: The council listed storm disruption separately from its regular maintenance.
examples.zh: 市议会把「风暴造成的服务中断」与常规维护分开列出。

examples.en: The local notice listed the services affected by storm disruption that morning.
examples.zh: 本地通知列出了当日上午受「风暴造成的服务中断」影响的服务。

words.enDefinition: Water flowing out of a drain meant to carry rainfall away

examples.en: The city reported a storm drain overflow beside the busiest junction.
examples.zh: 市政府报告说，最繁忙的路口旁出现了「雨水排水口溢流」。

examples.en: The road notice mentioned storm drain overflow after several hours of rain.
examples.zh: 连续下了几个小时雨后，道路通知提到了「雨水排水口溢流」。

collocations: a notice about storm drain overflow
an area affected by storm drain overflow

words.enDefinition: A US alert about expected coastal flooding from rising sea water

examples.en: The storm surge warning named the ports inside the coastal warning area.
examples.zh: 「风暴潮警告」列出了沿海警告区内的港口。

examples.en: The ferry operator linked to the storm surge warning beside its timetable.
examples.zh: 渡轮运营方在时刻表旁附上了「风暴潮警告」链接。

collocations: a storm surge warning for the coast
an area under a storm surge warning

words.enDefinition: Rainwater flowing across land or pavement after falling

examples.en: The report showed where stormwater runoff had reached the nearby path.
examples.zh: 报告显示了「雨水地表径流」是从哪里流到附近小路的。

examples.en: The council's map identified areas affected by stormwater runoff near campus.
examples.zh: 市议会地图标出了学校附近受「雨水地表径流」影响的区域。

words.enDefinition: an address identifying a building by its street and number

examples.en: The caretaker gave the street address of the workshop from the posted contact sheet.
examples.zh: 管理员照着张贴的联络表，说出了工场的「街道门牌地址」。

examples.en: The street address on the west gate belongs to the building next door.
examples.zh: 西门上的「街道门牌地址」是隔壁那栋楼的。

words.enDefinition: a sign on or beside a street showing its name or information

examples.en: We read the street sign aloud to make sure we had the right spelling.
examples.zh: 我们把「街道标识牌」上的街名念了出来，确保拼写正确。

examples.en: The shop awning partly covered the street sign at the end of the block.
examples.zh: 街区尽头的「街道标识牌」被商店的遮阳篷挡住了一部分。

words.enDefinition: An interruption leaving street lighting unavailable in a particular area

examples.en: The city listed a streetlight outage outside the library entrance.
examples.zh: 市政府列出了图书馆入口外的「路灯停电」。

examples.en: The notice said the streetlight outage affected both sides of the street.
examples.zh: 通知说，这次「路灯停电」影响了街道两侧。

collocations: a notice about a streetlight outage
an area affected by a streetlight outage

words.enDefinition: A device that flashes repeatedly to give a visible warning.

examples.en: During the demo, we could see the strobe light from the end of the corridor.
examples.zh: 演示时，我们在走廊尽头就能看见「频闪警示灯」。

examples.en: The accessibility review noted that a shelf partly blocked the view of the strobe light.
examples.zh: 无障碍检查记录指出，一个架子遮住了部分「频闪警示灯」。

words.enDefinition: A student's explanation of how an incident affected their circumstances

examples.en: I used the student impact statement to explain why I missed class.
examples.zh: 我用「学生受影响情况说明」解释了缺课的原因。

examples.en: The adviser compared my student impact statement with the dates of the repairs.
examples.zh: 顾问把我的「学生受影响情况说明」与维修日期作了核对。

words.enDefinition: An earlier warning replaced by a newer issue or update

examples.en: I compared the superseded warning with the latest one on the map.
examples.zh: 我把「已被替代的警告」与地图上最新的警告作了比较。

examples.en: The archive kept the superseded warning beside the earlier forecast notes.
examples.zh: 存档把「已被替代的警告」和此前的预报记录放在一起。

words.zhGloss: 在工作人员陪同下进入
words.enDefinition: Permission to enter an area with a staff member present
acceptedZhAnswers: 在工作人员陪同下进入

examples.en: The building manager described supervised access in the message to residents.
examples.zh: 楼管在面向居民的消息中介绍了「在工作人员陪同下进入」的安排。

examples.en: I asked which room was listed for supervised access on the notice.
examples.zh: 我问通知上写的是哪个房间可以「在工作人员陪同下进入」。

words.enDefinition: An additional request related to a loss already reported

examples.en: The letter explained which costs were listed in my supplemental claim.
examples.zh: 信件解释了我的「补充理赔申请」列出了哪些费用。

examples.en: I checked whether the supplemental claim was linked to the original report.
examples.zh: 我核对了「补充理赔申请」是否与原始报告关联。

words.enDefinition: A connection made by staff to another service providing help

examples.en: The adviser arranged a support referral after our discussion about housing.
examples.zh: 谈完住宿问题后，顾问安排我「转介至援助服务」。

examples.en: I asked which office the support referral was recorded under.
examples.zh: 我问「转介至援助服务」的记录归在哪个办公室。

words.enDefinition: an incident in which something may have been stolen but this is not certain

examples.en: The incident log described the missing equipment as a suspected theft from the storeroom.
examples.zh: 事件记录把设备不见一事登记为储藏室「疑似失窃」。

examples.en: The officer asked whether the suspected theft took place before or after the lecture.
examples.zh: 警员询问「疑似失窃」发生在讲座开始前还是结束后。

words.enDefinition: to temporarily stop a mobile line from providing calls or network access

examples.en: I asked whether the provider could suspend mobile service without closing my account.
examples.zh: 我问运营商能不能在保留账户的同时「暂停手机通信服务」。

examples.en: The provider confirmed when it would suspend mobile service on the missing phone.
examples.zh: 运营商确认了何时「暂停遗失手机的通信服务」。

collocations: suspend mobile service for a lost phone

words.enDefinition: to become larger or puffier, often after a knock or irritation

examples.en: His finger began to swell up while we waited for the coach.
examples.zh: 我们等教练时，他的手指开始「肿起来」。

examples.en: I told her the skin around my wrist had started to swell up.
examples.zh: 我告诉她，我手腕周围的皮肤开始「肿起来」了。

words.enDefinition: a lip noticeably larger than usual due to swelling

examples.en: I could see a swollen lip when she turned toward the light.
examples.zh: 她转向有光的地方时，我看见她的「嘴唇肿了」。

examples.en: The instructor asked whether the swollen lip had already been there before practice.
examples.zh: 教练问她训练前是不是就已经「嘴唇肿了」。

collocations: a swollen lip after a collision

words.enDefinition: A discussion-based exercise in which participants talk through responses to a simulated situation.

examples.en: The residence staff held a tabletop exercise to discuss a fictional building closure during exams.
examples.zh: 宿舍工作人员举行了一次「桌面推演」，讨论考试期间某栋楼虚构的关闭情境。

examples.en: At the tabletop exercise, each department explained what information it would need from campus management.
examples.zh: 「桌面推演」中，各部门说明了需要校园管理部门提供哪些信息。

collocations: take part in a tabletop exercise

words.enDefinition: to fall unexpectedly, especially while moving or playing a sport

examples.en: I saw him take a fall near the end of basketball practice.
examples.zh: 篮球训练快结束时，我看见他「摔了一跤」。

examples.en: She said she might take a fall if the loose board moved again.
examples.zh: 她说，那块松动的板子要是再挪动，她可能会「摔一跤」。

collocations: take a fall on the stairs
take a fall on the court

words.enDefinition: to assume responsibility for what happens from this point

examples.en: The duty officer thanked me and said, “I'll take it from here.”
examples.zh: 值班安全员向我道了谢，说「接下来我来处理」。

examples.en: I asked if the event organiser could take it from here while I called home.
examples.zh: 我问活动组织者能不能「接手处理接下来的事」，我好给家里打个电话。

collocations: can you take it from here
let someone take it from here

words.enDefinition: a business or service that arranges or provides taxi rides

examples.en: I asked the taxi operator whether a driver had handed in a blue notebook.
examples.zh: 我问「出租车运营方」有没有司机交来一本蓝色笔记本。

examples.en: The taxi operator looked up our booking after I gave the time we left.
examples.zh: 我报了出发时间后，「出租车运营方」查到了我们的预约记录。

collocations: report a loss to the taxi operator

words.enDefinition: an interpreter who translates spoken conversation over the phone

examples.en: The dispatcher connected a telephone interpreter after I gave the name of my language.
examples.zh: 我报出自己使用的语言后，调度员接通了一名「电话口译员」。

examples.en: The telephone interpreter asked one person to speak at a time during the conversation.
examples.zh: 交谈时，「电话口译员」请大家一个一个说。

words.enDefinition: a short-term pass allowing someone to enter specified campus areas

examples.en: The residence office issued a temporary campus pass while it checked the missing card report.
examples.zh: 宿管办公室核查卡片遗失报告期间，发了一张「校园临时通行证」。

examples.en: My temporary campus pass let me use the main gate for one day.
examples.zh: 凭「校园临时通行证」，我当天可以从正门出入。

words.enDefinition: A temporary barrier or marked boundary around an area to limit entry.

examples.en: A temporary cordon marked the area around the entrance while staff inspected the overhead sign.
examples.zh: 工作人员检查上方的标牌时，入口周围用「临时警戒线」标了出来。

examples.en: The temporary cordon was removed before the afternoon program in the courtyard started again.
examples.zh: 庭院里的下午活动重新开始前，「临时警戒线」撤掉了。

collocations: a temporary cordon around the area

words.enDefinition: an identity document issued for use for a limited time

examples.en: The campus desk gave me a temporary ID while my new card was being printed.
examples.zh: 新卡还在打印时，校园服务台给了我一张「临时身份证件」。

examples.en: The examiner checked the expiry date on my temporary ID before marking me present.
examples.zh: 监考人员查看了我的「临时身份证件」的到期日，然后登记我已到场。

words.enDefinition: Moving people to another location for a limited period

examples.en: The housing team arranged temporary relocation while the rooms were unavailable.
examples.zh: 客房不能使用期间，住宿团队安排了「临时搬迁」。

examples.en: I asked what the email meant by temporary relocation for our floor.
examples.zh: 我问邮件里我们这一层的「临时搬迁」指什么。

words.enDefinition: Short-term work carried out before a more permanent repair

examples.en: The office described temporary repairs separately from the later building work.
examples.zh: 办公室把「临时维修」和后续的楼宇施工分开介绍。

examples.en: The first report listed temporary repairs that had already taken place.
examples.zh: 第一份报告列出了已经完成的「临时维修」。

words.enDefinition: Expenses for storing belongings elsewhere for a limited period

examples.en: The statement listed temporary storage costs in a separate section from repairs.
examples.zh: 说明把「临时寄存费用」和维修费用分开列在不同栏目。

examples.en: I asked which dates the temporary storage costs covered for our furniture.
examples.zh: 我问我们家具的「临时寄存费用」涵盖哪些日期。

words.enDefinition: A place made available for academic work for a limited period

examples.en: The library offered a temporary study space for residents from our hall.
examples.zh: 图书馆为我们宿舍的住户提供了「临时学习场所」。

examples.en: I checked the schedule for the temporary study space before my seminar.
examples.zh: 我在研讨课前查了「临时学习场所」的开放安排。

collocations: hours for a temporary study space

words.enDefinition: A message sent to check whether a communication system is working.

examples.en: I got the test message during a seminar and recognized the label at once.
examples.zh: 研讨课上我收到了「测试消息」，一下就认出了它的标签。

examples.en: The test message showed up on my phone long before the copy in my inbox.
examples.zh: 手机上的「测试消息」比邮箱里的那份早到了很久。

words.enDefinition: A warning sent as a text message to a mobile phone.

examples.en: I got a text alert about the library closure on the way to class.
examples.zh: 我去上课的路上收到一条图书馆关闭的「短信警报」。

examples.en: The text alert named the closed building, and the email gave us a longer explanation.
examples.zh: 「短信警报」写明了关闭楼宇的名称，邮件则提供了更详细的说明。

words.enDefinition: a service that relays a conversation between typed text and speech

examples.en: Our residence handbook lists text relay under its options for accessible telephone calls.
examples.zh: 我们的宿舍手册把「文字中继通话」列在无障碍通话选项中。

examples.en: The front desk worker was familiar with text relay and waited for the reply.
examples.zh: 前台工作人员熟悉「文字中继通话」，便等对方回复。

words.enDefinition: a US service in participating areas for contacting 911 by text

examples.en: The county's accessibility page states whether text-to-911 is available in this part of town.
examples.zh: 县里的无障碍网页说明，这片城区是否提供「短信联系911服务」。

examples.en: Our orientation guide discussed text-to-911 in the section on accessible emergency communications.
examples.zh: 我们的迎新指南在应急通信无障碍章节中介绍了「短信联系911服务」。

words.enDefinition: an app that speaks typed or displayed words aloud

examples.en: My roommate used a text-to-speech app to tell the supervisor what she needed.
examples.zh: 室友用「文字转语音应用」告诉主管她需要什么。

examples.en: I asked whether a text-to-speech app would be easier for him to use.
examples.zh: 我问他用「文字转语音应用」会不会更方便。

words.enDefinition: a phrase meaning the call connection stopped carrying sound

examples.en: I heard a voice for a moment before the line went dead without warning.
examples.zh: 我听到了一小会儿人声，接着「电话突然没声了」。

examples.en: The operator had just asked for the postcode when the line went dead.
examples.zh: 接线员刚问了邮编，「电话就突然没声了」。

words.enDefinition: the taking of belongings from inside a vehicle without permission

examples.en: The car park notice mentioned a recent theft from a vehicle outside the gym.
examples.zh: 停车场告示提到，体育馆外最近发生过一起「车内财物被盗」事件。

examples.en: The officer recorded the missing backpack as a theft from a vehicle on campus.
examples.zh: 警员把背包失踪登记为校园内一起「车内财物被盗」事件。

collocations: investigate a theft from a vehicle

words.enDefinition: A statement indicating that a message or alarm is part of a system check.

examples.en: The email started with “This is a test” above the name of the campus.
examples.zh: 邮件以「这是一次测试」开头，下方是校区名称。

examples.en: I heard “This is a test” over the speakers before the tone played again.
examples.zh: 提示音再次响起前，我听见扬声器里说「这是一次测试」。

collocations: a message headed this is a test
start with this is a test

words.enDefinition: The time when someone first noticed damage or a loss

examples.en: I wrote down the time of discovery beside the description of the damage.
examples.zh: 我在受损情况描述旁记下了「发现受损的时间」。

examples.en: The manager read back the time of discovery during our follow-up meeting.
examples.zh: 后续会面时，管理员复述了「发现受损的时间」。

words.enDefinition: The time when the reported event is believed to have occurred

examples.en: The office asked whether the time of incident was exact or approximate.
examples.zh: 办公室问「事故发生时间」是准确记录还是估计的。

examples.en: I added a short note next to the time of incident field.
examples.zh: 我在「事故发生时间」一栏旁加了一条简短备注。

words.enDefinition: An account listing related events in the order they happened

examples.en: I prepared a timeline of events from the notes my flatmates sent.
examples.zh: 我根据室友发来的记录整理了一份「事件时间线」。

examples.en: The timeline of events helped us remember which room was checked first.
examples.zh: 「事件时间线」帮我们想起来最先检查的是哪个房间。

words.enDefinition: A US alert that a tornado has been observed or indicated

examples.en: The tornado warning named the towns in its projected path.
examples.zh: 「龙卷风警告」列出了预计路径上的城镇。

examples.en: I read the tornado warning while checking the university service page.
examples.zh: 我查看学校服务页面时，也看了「龙卷风警告」。

collocations: an area under a tornado warning

words.enDefinition: A US alert indicating conditions are favorable for tornado formation

examples.en: The US forecast listed a tornado watch for our county.
examples.zh: 美国预报列出了我们所在县的「龙卷风监视通报」。

examples.en: Our college mentioned the tornado watch in an afternoon bulletin.
examples.zh: 学院在下午的公报中提到了「龙卷风监视通报」。

collocations: a tornado watch for the region

words.enDefinition: Damage or loss treated as complete for insurance valuation purposes

examples.en: The report classified the damaged equipment as a total loss.
examples.zh: 报告把受损设备归为「全损」。

examples.en: I asked what total loss meant in the property assessment.
examples.zh: 我问财产评估中「全损」是什么意思。

collocations: record an item as a total loss
a report finding a total loss

words.enDefinition: A notice saying traffic signals are not currently working

examples.en: The traffic update read "Traffic signals out" beside the junction near campus.
examples.zh: 交通动态在学校附近的路口旁写着「交通信号灯停用」。

examples.en: I saw "Traffic signals out" on the map after the power failure.
examples.zh: 供电中断后，我在地图上看到了「交通信号灯停用」。

collocations: a notice reading traffic signals out
an intersection marked traffic signals out
a report saying traffic signals out

words.enDefinition: to send a connected telephone call to another person or number

examples.en: The dispatcher stayed with me long enough to transfer the call to the right desk.
examples.zh: 调度员一直和我保持通话，直到「转接电话」到正确的值班台。

examples.en: Let me transfer the call to the person covering your part of campus tonight.
examples.zh: 我来「转接电话」，让今晚负责你那片校园的人接听。

collocations: transfer the call to another department
transfer the call to a colleague
ask someone to transfer the call

words.enDefinition: A problem affecting equipment that changes voltage in an electricity supply

examples.en: The utility listed a transformer fault as the cause of the interruption.
examples.zh: 供电机构把「变压器故障」列为供电中断的原因。

examples.en: The evening notice included an update about the transformer fault near campus.
examples.zh: 晚间通知更新了学校附近「变压器故障」的情况。

collocations: an outage caused by a transformer fault

words.enDefinition: blunt-tipped scissors designed to cut sturdy material in emergencies

examples.en: The instructor showed a sealed pair of trauma shears during the equipment orientation.
examples.zh: 介绍设备时，讲解员展示了一把没拆封的「急救剪」。

examples.en: I found the trauma shears in the compartment with the bright orange zipper.
examples.zh: 我在有亮橙色拉链的夹层里找到了「急救剪」。

words.enDefinition: A policy benefit for certain costs arising from delayed travel

examples.en: The policy table showed a travel delay benefit under a separate heading.
examples.zh: 保单表格在单独的标题下列了「旅行延误保险给付」。

examples.en: I checked which expenses were listed beside the travel delay benefit.
examples.zh: 我查看了「旅行延误保险给付」旁列出了哪些费用。

collocations: a claim for a travel delay benefit

words.enDefinition: An insurance request concerning losses caused by interrupted travel plans

examples.en: The insurance app listed my travel disruption claim under the trip dates.
examples.zh: 保险应用在出行日期下面列出了我的「旅行中断理赔申请」。

examples.en: I asked which letter belonged with the travel disruption claim for that trip.
examples.zh: 我问哪封信应当和那趟出行的「旅行中断理赔申请」放在一起。

collocations: documents for a travel disruption claim

words.enDefinition: A document identifying a travel insurance policy and its insured travelers

examples.en: I checked the travel dates on my travel insurance certificate before the call.
examples.zh: 打电话之前，我核对了「旅行保险凭证」上的出行日期。

examples.en: The adviser asked what name appeared on my travel insurance certificate.
examples.zh: 顾问问我的「旅行保险凭证」上写的是哪个姓名。

collocations: a copy of the travel insurance certificate
details on the travel insurance certificate

words.enDefinition: a large triangular piece of cloth included in first aid supplies

examples.en: A diagram of the triangular bandage appeared on the outside of its wrapper.
examples.zh: 包装外面印了「三角绷带」的示意图。

examples.en: The equipment list included a triangular bandage in its own sealed pouch.
examples.zh: 装备清单上有一条单独用袋子密封的「三角绷带」。

words.enDefinition: Insurance for certain losses when a planned trip is cancelled

examples.en: The guide described trip cancellation cover in a section about unused bookings.
examples.zh: 指南在未使用的预订一节介绍了「行程取消保障」。

examples.en: My adviser asked which page explained the trip cancellation cover I had.
examples.zh: 顾问问哪一页解释了我保单里的「行程取消保障」。

collocations: a policy with trip cancellation cover

words.enDefinition: Insurance covering specified losses when a trip already underway is cut short

examples.en: The policy booklet described trip interruption cover in its travel section.
examples.zh: 保单手册在旅行一节介绍了「旅途中断保障」。

examples.en: I asked where the summary defined trip interruption cover for that trip.
examples.zh: 我问概要哪里定义了那次行程的「旅途中断保障」。

collocations: a policy with trip interruption cover

words.enDefinition: An Australian alert for areas expected to experience cyclone conditions

examples.en: The Australian tropical cyclone warning covered several towns along the coastline.
examples.zh: 澳大利亚这条「热带气旋警告」涵盖了沿海几个城镇。

examples.en: The ferry operator referred to the tropical cyclone warning in its update.
examples.zh: 渡轮运营方在更新中提到了「热带气旋警告」。

collocations: an area under a tropical cyclone warning

words.enDefinition: A US alert indicating tropical storm conditions are expected

examples.en: The website linked to a tropical storm warning for the islands.
examples.zh: 网站附上了群岛地区的「热带风暴警告」链接。

examples.en: The tropical storm warning named the districts in the affected area.
examples.zh: 「热带风暴警告」列出了受影响地区的各个区。

collocations: a tropical storm warning for the coast
an area under a tropical storm warning

words.enDefinition: a device recognized by an account service for confirming the user's identity

examples.en: The service still listed my old tablet as a trusted device after I replaced it.
examples.zh: 我换了平板后，该服务仍把旧平板列为「受信任的设备」。

examples.en: A message appeared on my trusted device when I tried to access the account.
examples.zh: 我尝试访问账户时，「受信任的设备」上出现了一条消息。

words.enDefinition: An alarm system that uses one signal to warn occupants and another to signal evacuation.

examples.en: The safety officer explained the two-stage alarm during orientation in the performing arts building.
examples.zh: 安全负责人在表演艺术楼的新生说明会上讲解了「两阶段警报」。

examples.en: The video used different colors to show the two signals of the two-stage alarm.
examples.zh: 视频用了不同颜色展示「两阶段警报」的两种信号。

collocations: a building with a two-stage alarm

words.enDefinition: not able to find a particular person, place, or thing

examples.en: The crew was unable to locate the entrance mentioned in the first call.
examples.zh: 救援队「找不到」第一次通话中提到的入口。

examples.en: The officer said he was unable to locate the building on his map.
examples.zh: 警员说他在地图上「找不到」那栋楼。

words.enDefinition: not able to get upright on one's feet

examples.en: The student said she was unable to stand after her foot slipped on the steps.
examples.zh: 那名学生说，她在台阶上一脚滑倒后就「无法站立」。

examples.en: I reported that he was unable to stand when the coach asked for an update.
examples.zh: 教练问现在怎样了，我说他「无法站立」。

words.enDefinition: Describes people whose whereabouts have not yet been verified.

examples.en: The warden said two visitors were unaccounted for until the reception team checked the register.
examples.zh: 疏散负责人说，接待团队核查登记册之前，有两名访客「去向尚未确认」。

examples.en: It turned out that the student marked as unaccounted for had already left for class.
examples.zh: 后来发现，标记为「去向尚未确认」的那名学生已经去上课了。

words.enDefinition: A practice exercise whose exact timing is not announced to participants in advance.

examples.en: The report described an unannounced drill that took place during a regular afternoon class.
examples.zh: 报告介绍了一次在下午正常上课时举行的「未提前通知的演习」。

examples.en: The residence handbook explained what the staff meant by an unannounced drill for new students.
examples.zh: 宿舍手册向新生解释了工作人员所说的「未提前通知的演习」是什么。

words.enDefinition: a bag that no one appears to be watching or looking after

examples.en: An attendant asked whether the unattended bag beside the bench belonged to our group.
examples.zh: 工作人员问长椅旁那个「无人照看的包」是不是我们这组的。

examples.en: The station announcement referred to an unattended bag in the main waiting area.
examples.zh: 车站广播提到，主候车区有一个「无人照看的包」。

words.enDefinition: money taken from an account without the owner's permission

examples.en: The statement showed an unauthorised withdrawal while I was away from campus on Friday.
examples.zh: 对账单显示，周五我离开校园期间有一笔「未经授权的取款」。

examples.en: I asked the bank to review the unauthorised withdrawal listed under the cash transactions.
examples.zh: 我请银行核查现金交易里的这笔「未经授权的取款」。

words.enDefinition: found property that no rightful owner has come to collect

examples.en: The transit company moved its unclaimed property to a warehouse outside the city centre.
examples.zh: 公交公司把「无人认领的物品」搬到了市中心外的一处仓库。

examples.en: We separated the unclaimed property from the bags people were coming to collect.
examples.zh: 我们把「无人认领的物品」与有人来领取的包分开。

words.enDefinition: the process of getting rid of found items no one has claimed

examples.en: The transit website explained its unclaimed property disposal policy in a separate section.
examples.zh: 公交网站设有单独的栏目，解释「无人认领财物处置」政策。

examples.en: The board discussed unclaimed property disposal after reviewing the number of items in storage.
examples.zh: 委员会查看保管的物品数量后，讨论了「无人认领财物处置」。

words.enDefinition: A dwelling reported to be unsuitable for people to live in

examples.en: The accommodation office described the flat as an uninhabitable unit in its report.
examples.zh: 住宿办公室在报告中将该公寓称为「无法居住的住宅」。

examples.en: The coordinator asked which residents had been assigned to the uninhabitable unit.
examples.zh: 协调员问原先有哪些住户被分到这个「无法居住的住宅」。

collocations: a notice describing an uninhabitable unit

words.enDefinition: A loss for which insurance coverage is not available

examples.en: The report identified an uninsured loss involving one piece of furniture.
examples.zh: 报告指出，有一件家具涉及「未获保险保障的损失」。

examples.en: The adviser asked whether the amount represented an uninsured loss.
examples.zh: 顾问问，这笔金额是不是「未获保险保障的损失」。

collocations: a record of an uninsured loss

words.enDefinition: An interruption of utility service that was not scheduled

examples.en: The utility posted a notice about an unplanned outage downtown.
examples.zh: 公用服务机构发布了市区「非计划性停运」的通知。

examples.en: I checked whether our street was included in the unplanned outage.
examples.zh: 我查了一下，我们这条街是否在「非计划性停运」的范围内。

collocations: a notice of an unplanned outage
an area affected by an unplanned outage

words.enDefinition: Costs that have not been repaid by another party

examples.en: The adviser asked which unreimbursed expenses remained in my records.
examples.zh: 顾问问我的记录里还有哪些「未获报销的开支」。

examples.en: My budget listed the unreimbursed expenses separately from routine living costs.
examples.zh: 我的预算表把「未获报销的开支」和日常生活开支分开列出。

words.enDefinition: not reacting when someone speaks to you or tries to get your attention

examples.en: He was unresponsive when the librarian first called to him from the doorway.
examples.zh: 图书管理员第一次站在门口喊他时，他「没有反应」。

examples.en: I told the safety officer she appeared unresponsive when I first saw her.
examples.zh: 我告诉安全员，我刚看见她时，她似乎「没有反应」。

words.enDefinition: Reservations for services that the customer did not end up using

examples.en: I separated the unused bookings from the services I had used.
examples.zh: 我把「未使用的预订」与我实际使用过的服务分开列出。

examples.en: The insurer checked which unused bookings were named in the report.
examples.zh: 保险公司核对了报告中列出了哪些「未使用的预订」。

words.enDefinition: a fall that nobody saw as it happened

examples.en: The supervisor recorded an unwitnessed fall because staff arrived after the sound.
examples.zh: 工作人员听到声响后才赶到，因此主管记录为「无人目睹的摔倒」。

examples.en: I was asked whether to mark the incident as an unwitnessed fall.
examples.zh: 有人问我，这件事是不是要标成「无人目睹的摔倒」。

collocations: an unwitnessed fall in the hallway

words.enDefinition: the part of the arm between the shoulder and elbow

examples.en: I saw her upper arm strike the doorframe as she turned to leave.
examples.zh: 她转身要离开时，我看见她的「上臂」撞到了门框。

examples.en: He said the mark on his upper arm was from last week's practice.
examples.zh: 他说「上臂」上的那道印子是上周训练时留下的。

collocations: the inside of the upper arm
a bruise on the upper arm
the upper arm near the shoulder

words.enDefinition: Damage to a pole carrying power or communication lines

examples.en: The provider mentioned utility pole damage in the evening outage update.
examples.zh: 服务商在晚间停运动态中提到了「电线杆受损」。

examples.en: The report showed where utility pole damage had been recorded after the storm.
examples.zh: 报告标出了风暴过后哪些地方记录到「电线杆受损」。

collocations: a notice about utility pole damage

words.enDefinition: Workers assigned to restore equipment used for public utility services

examples.en: The notice mentioned a utility repair crew working beside the road.
examples.zh: 通知提到一支「公用设施维修队」正在路边工作。

examples.en: The provider confirmed that a utility repair crew had reached our building.
examples.zh: 服务商确认，一支「公用设施维修队」已经到了我们楼。

collocations: a utility repair crew on site
updates from a utility repair crew

words.enDefinition: a service connecting sign language and spoken language through a video interpreter

examples.en: The interpreter on video relay signed while the call handler spoke over the phone.
examples.zh: 接线员在电话里说话时，「视频中继通话」服务的译员用手语转达。

examples.en: We watched a video relay demonstration during a session on accessible campus services.
examples.zh: 在介绍校园无障碍服务的活动上，我们看了「视频中继通话」演示。

words.enDefinition: Physical harm that can be seen without further examination

examples.en: The assessor marked the visible damage beside the lower corner of the door.
examples.zh: 评估人员标出了门下角旁边「可见的损坏」。

examples.en: The form had a space for a brief description of visible damage.
examples.zh: 表格留了一栏，用来简述「可见的损坏」。

words.enDefinition: noticeably upset or unsettled after a frightening experience

examples.en: The student was visibly shaken when her classmate asked what had happened.
examples.zh: 同学问发生了什么时，那名学生「明显受惊」。

examples.en: He was visibly shaken after seeing the accident in the workshop.
examples.zh: 在工坊目睹事故后，他「明显受惊」。

words.enDefinition: A warning communicated through a visible display or flashing light.

examples.en: The visual warning was easy to see from the back of the crowded hall.
examples.zh: 在拥挤的大厅后排也很容易看到「视觉警报」。

examples.en: The accessibility guide showed what the visual warning looked like in the residence hallway.
examples.zh: 无障碍指南展示了宿舍走廊里的「视觉警报」是什么样子。

words.enDefinition: to stay on the line until someone or another service answers

examples.en: A short recorded message played while I had to wait to be connected.
examples.zh: 我「等候接通」时，听到了一段简短的录音。

examples.en: The voice told me to wait to be connected to the local control room.
examples.zh: 语音提示我「等候接通」当地控制室。

collocations: wait to be connected to an operator
wait to be connected to the local office

words.enDefinition: to remain beside someone until another person or event arrives

examples.en: I'll wait with them while you go and get the duty officer.
examples.zh: 你去找值班安全员，我「陪他们等着」。

examples.en: The classmates offered to wait with them until the receptionist came back.
examples.zh: 同学们提出「陪他们等着」，直到接待员回来。

collocations: ask someone to wait with them
wait with them until staff arrive

words.enDefinition: A marked vest that makes an evacuation warden easy to recognize.

examples.en: I recognized our floor warden by the yellow warden vest she wore during the exercise.
examples.zh: 演习时，我们楼层的负责人穿着黄色「疏散负责人识别背心」，我一下就认出了她。

examples.en: The training photo showed a warden vest with the building name printed on the back.
examples.zh: 培训照片里有一件「疏散负责人识别背心」，背面印着楼名。

collocations: identify someone by their warden vest

words.enDefinition: The geographic area covered by a particular official warning

examples.en: I checked whether our campus was inside the warning area on the map.
examples.zh: 我查看了地图上的「警告覆盖区域」是否包括我们学校。

examples.en: The warning area was outlined in color on the official forecast page.
examples.zh: 官方预报网页用彩色线条划出了「警告覆盖区域」。

words.enDefinition: An update saying a weather warning now covers more places

examples.en: The bulletin said "Warning area expanded" and linked to a revised map.
examples.zh: 公报写着「警告区域已扩大」，并附上了更新后的地图链接。

examples.en: I saw "Warning area expanded" in the county's latest weather notice.
examples.zh: 我在县里最新的天气通知中看到「警告区域已扩大」。

collocations: a notice reading warning area expanded
an alert marked warning area expanded
a map update saying warning area expanded

words.enDefinition: An update indicating a reduction in the alert's severity level

examples.en: The page said "Warning downgraded" beside the newest entry for the coast.
examples.zh: 页面在沿海地区最新一条消息旁写着「警告级别已降低」。

examples.en: The warning downgraded message appeared below a link to the new advisory.
examples.zh: 「警告级别已降低」的消息出现在新提示链接下方。

words.enDefinition: An alert update indicating a warning's stated duration increased

examples.en: I saw "Warning extended" beside the revised times on the forecast page.
examples.zh: 我在预报页面调整后的时间旁看见「警告延长」。

examples.en: The evening bulletin said "Warning extended" and listed a later end time.
examples.zh: 晚间公报写着「警告延长」，并列出了更晚的结束时间。

words.enDefinition: Words indicating a weather warning currently applies to an area

examples.en: The forecast showed "Warning in effect" above the map of our town.
examples.zh: 预报在我们镇的地图上方显示「警告生效中」。

examples.en: The official map listed one warning in effect beside our district name.
examples.zh: 官方地图在本区名称旁标出了一条「警告生效中」的信息。

collocations: a warning in effect for the region
a warning in effect through the afternoon

words.enDefinition: An update indicating that a weather warning no longer applies

examples.en: The map said "Warning lifted" next to the city name that afternoon.
examples.zh: 当天下午，地图在城市名称旁显示「警告已解除」。

examples.en: I saw "Warning lifted" before the library posted its revised hours.
examples.zh: 图书馆发布调整后的时间前，我先看到了「警告已解除」。

words.enDefinition: An update indicating elevation to a more serious warning level

examples.en: The bulletin said "Warning upgraded" and linked to a fresh map.
examples.zh: 公报写着「警告级别已提高」，并附上最新地图的链接。

examples.en: The warning upgraded status appeared while our group was reading the updates.
examples.zh: 我们小组在看更新时，页面显示「警告级别已提高」。

words.enDefinition: A later than scheduled collection of household or public waste

examples.en: The council posted a waste collection delay for the streets near the river.
examples.zh: 市议会发布了河边街区「垃圾收运延迟」的通知。

examples.en: I checked whether the waste collection delay affected our student residence.
examples.zh: 我查了这次「垃圾收运延迟」是否影响我们宿舍。

collocations: a notice about a waste collection delay
areas with a waste collection delay

words.enDefinition: Words indicating a water advisory formally no longer applies

examples.en: The utility posted "Water advisory lifted" after publishing the test results.
examples.zh: 供水机构公布检测结果后发布了「用水通告已解除」。

examples.en: I saw "Water advisory lifted" on the public water service page.
examples.zh: 我在公共供水服务页面上看到「用水通告已解除」。

collocations: a notice saying water advisory lifted
an area marked water advisory lifted
a water service update reading water advisory lifted

words.enDefinition: A location where a utility or agency provides substitute water

examples.en: The council map showed a water distribution point near the park.
examples.zh: 市议会地图在公园附近标了一个「临时供水点」。

examples.en: The bulletin listed the hours of the water distribution point downtown.
examples.zh: 公报列出了市中心「临时供水点」的开放时间。

collocations: a map of a water distribution point

words.enDefinition: A break in a main pipe distributing water to an area

examples.en: The utility cited a water main break in its street notice.
examples.zh: 供水机构在街区通知中提到了「供水主管破裂」。

examples.en: I checked which road was affected by the water main break.
examples.zh: 我查了「供水主管破裂」影响了哪条路。

collocations: a street affected by a water main break
repairs after a water main break

words.enDefinition: The examination of water samples for quality or possible contamination

examples.en: The utility released a short report on water quality testing that morning.
examples.zh: 供水机构当天上午发布了一份「水质检测」简报。

examples.en: The update gave a separate date for water quality testing near campus.
examples.zh: 更新为学校附近的「水质检测」单独列了日期。

collocations: a notice about water quality testing

words.enDefinition: A status indicating water is available again after an interruption

examples.en: The update showed "Water supply restored" for the university neighborhood.
examples.zh: 动态把学校附近标为「供水已恢复」。

examples.en: We saw "Water supply restored" next to the earlier outage notice.
examples.zh: 我们在先前的停水通知旁看到了「供水已恢复」。

collocations: a status reading water supply restored
a message saying water supply restored
a map marked water supply restored

words.enDefinition: Ground holding so much water that it stays saturated

examples.en: The sports centre cited waterlogged ground in its field closure notice.
examples.zh: 体育中心在球场关闭通知中提到了「严重积水的地面」。

examples.en: I read that waterlogged ground was affecting the route beside the river.
examples.zh: 我看到消息说，「严重积水的地面」影响了河边的线路。

collocations: close a path due to waterlogged ground

words.enDefinition: A US notification about potentially disruptive conditions below a warning level

examples.en: I asked which symbol indicated a weather advisory on the US map.
examples.zh: 我问美国地图上哪个标志代表「天气注意提示」。

examples.en: The weather advisory explained which roads might be affected by the snow.
examples.zh: 「天气注意提示」说明了哪些道路可能受降雪影响。

collocations: a weather advisory for the area

words.enDefinition: An official message about potentially hazardous weather affecting an area

examples.en: I received a weather alert while waiting for my afternoon class.
examples.zh: 我在等下午上课时收到了一条「天气警报」。

examples.en: The weather alert named the counties covered by the latest forecast.
examples.zh: 「天气警报」列出了最新预报涵盖的几个县。

collocations: a weather alert for the area

words.enDefinition: An official written or broadcast update on current weather conditions

examples.en: I read the weather bulletin before looking at the campus schedule.
examples.zh: 我先读了「天气公报」，再去看校园安排。

examples.en: The weather bulletin said the strongest winds were expected near the coast.
examples.zh: 「天气公报」说，最强的风预计出现在沿海地带。

collocations: a weather bulletin from the forecaster

words.enDefinition: A closure of a place or facility because of weather

examples.en: The museum announced a weather-related closure through its local newsletter.
examples.zh: 博物馆通过本地简报宣布「因天气暂停开放」。

examples.en: I read the weather-related closure notice before heading to the sports centre.
examples.zh: 去体育中心之前，我看了「因天气暂停开放」的通知。

words.enDefinition: An official alert for dangerous weather occurring or expected in an area

examples.en: I checked whether the weather warning included the town where I lived.
examples.zh: 我查了一下，「危险天气警告」是否涵盖我住的小镇。

examples.en: The supervisor mentioned the weather warning when announcing the change of venue.
examples.zh: 主管宣布更改地点时，提到了「危险天气警告」。

collocations: a weather warning for heavy rain

words.enDefinition: A US alert indicating that conditions favor a specified weather hazard

examples.en: The US forecast explained what the weather watch meant for this area.
examples.zh: 美国的预报解释了这条「天气监视通报」对本地区意味着什么。

examples.en: The campus linked to a weather watch in its afternoon update.
examples.zh: 学校在下午的更新中附上了一条「天气监视通报」的链接。

collocations: a weather watch for the region

words.enDefinition: a question asking someone to indicate the part that hurts

examples.en: The coach asked, “Where does it hurt?” after the player described her fall.
examples.zh: 队员说完是怎么摔倒的，教练问她「哪儿疼？」

examples.en: “Where does it hurt?” my roommate asked when I pointed to my shoulder.
examples.zh: 我指向肩膀时，室友问「哪儿疼？」

collocations: “Where does it hurt when you move?”

words.enDefinition: the place where a feeling or event first began

examples.en: When I mentioned the pain, the first aider asked where it started.
examples.zh: 我提到疼痛时，急救员问我是「从哪里开始疼的」。

examples.en: I could point to where it started before I felt it in my shoulder.
examples.zh: 我能指出「最开始疼的地方」，疼痛后来延到了肩膀。

words.enDefinition: a question identifying the person accompanying someone now

examples.en: The staff member asked, “Who is with them?” and looked toward the doorway.
examples.zh: 那名工作人员问「谁在陪着他们？」同时朝门口望去。

examples.en: “Who is with them?” the coach asked when I reached the office.
examples.zh: 我到办公室时，教练问「谁在陪着他们？」

words.enDefinition: A disruption affecting a large area or many service users

examples.en: The operator described a widespread outage in its morning service notice.
examples.zh: 运营方在早间服务通知中介绍了「大范围停运」的情况。

examples.en: The local bulletin linked the widespread outage to the overnight storm.
examples.zh: 本地公报说，「大范围停运」与夜间的风暴有关。

collocations: customers affected by a widespread outage

words.enDefinition: A notice that smoke from wildfires is affecting air quality

examples.en: The city posted a wildfire smoke advisory with its outdoor venue update.
examples.zh: 市政府更新室外场地信息时发布了「野火烟霾注意提示」。

examples.en: Our campus bulletin linked to the wildfire smoke advisory for the valley.
examples.zh: 学校的公报附上了谷地「野火烟霾注意提示」的链接。

collocations: areas in a wildfire smoke advisory

words.enDefinition: How cold the air feels due to temperature and wind

examples.en: The forecast displayed wind chill separately from the air temperature.
examples.zh: 预报把「风寒体感」和实际气温分开显示。

examples.en: I read the note about wind chill in the morning forecast.
examples.zh: 我看了早间预报里有关「风寒体感」的说明。

words.enDefinition: A US alert for significant winter storm conditions expected or occurring

examples.en: The county was under a winter storm warning when campus hours changed.
examples.zh: 学校调整开放时间时，该县处于「冬季风暴警告」范围内。

examples.en: The winter storm warning mentioned both snow and possible ice on roads.
examples.zh: 「冬季风暴警告」提到了降雪和道路可能结冰。

collocations: areas under a winter storm warning

words.enDefinition: A US alert that significant winter storm conditions are possible

examples.en: The winter storm watch covered the time of our planned train journey.
examples.zh: 「冬季风暴监视通报」涵盖了我们计划坐火车的时间。

examples.en: I checked which counties were listed in the winter storm watch before class.
examples.zh: 上课前，我核对了「冬季风暴监视通报」列出的县。

collocations: a winter storm watch for the area
a county under a winter storm watch

words.enDefinition: A US alert for disruptive winter weather below warning severity

examples.en: I saw a winter weather advisory before reading the library's opening hours.
examples.zh: 我在看图书馆开放时间之前，看到了一条「冬季天气注意提示」。

examples.en: The forecast explained which roads were covered by the winter weather advisory.
examples.zh: 预报说明了「冬季天气注意提示」涵盖哪些道路。

collocations: a winter weather advisory for snow
an area under a winter weather advisory

words.enDefinition: A person's account of what they saw or heard during an event

examples.en: The residence team attached a witness statement to its written report.
examples.zh: 住宿团队在书面报告后面附了一份「证人陈述」。

examples.en: My flatmate checked the date before handing in her witness statement.
examples.zh: 室友在交「证人陈述」之前核对了日期。

words.enDefinition: a fall that another person saw happen

examples.en: The campus form had a box for a witnessed fall during an event.
examples.zh: 校园表格有一栏，用来注明活动中的「摔倒有人目睹」。

examples.en: I marked it as a witnessed fall because I had seen her trip.
examples.zh: 我当时看见她绊倒了，所以标记为「有人目睹的摔倒」。

words.enDefinition: a protective covering made to sit over a wound

examples.en: The wound dressing was listed separately from the rolls of white medical tape.
examples.zh: 清单上「伤口敷料」和一卷卷白色医用胶带是分开列出的。

examples.en: The label showed that the wound dressing was in a sealed packet.
examples.zh: 标签注明这片「伤口敷料」装在密封袋里。

collocations: a packet containing a wound dressing

words.enDefinition: to make a written record of an event as you recall it

examples.en: The supervisor asked me to write down what happened while I remembered it clearly.
examples.zh: 主管让我趁还记得清楚时「记下事情经过」。

examples.en: I stayed after the rehearsal to write down what happened in the hallway.
examples.zh: 排练后我留了下来，「记下走廊里发生的事」。

collocations: ask someone to write down what happened
write down what happened in order
write down what happened while it's fresh

words.enDefinition: A written description of what happened in a particular event

examples.en: The accommodation officer asked me for a written account of the leak.
examples.zh: 住宿办公室的工作人员请我提供漏水事件的「书面经过说明」。

examples.en: I kept my written account with the other records from that week.
examples.zh: 我把「书面经过说明」与那一周的其他记录一起存放。

words.enDefinition: written permission allowing another person to collect an item on the owner's behalf

examples.en: My sister showed written authorization for collection when she picked up my lost backpack.
examples.zh: 姐姐代领我遗失的背包时出示了「书面代领授权」。

examples.en: The clerk kept the written authorization for collection with the other papers about my keys.
examples.zh: 办事员把「书面代领授权」和有关我那串钥匙的其他材料放在一起。

words.enDefinition: an address entered or given that does not match the intended location

examples.en: I realised I had given the wrong address after checking the name above the door.
examples.zh: 我看了门上方的名称后，才发现自己「把地址弄错了」。

examples.en: The first crew was sent to the wrong address on another street downtown.
examples.zh: 第一支救援队被派到了市中心另一条街上的一个「错误地址」。

words.enDefinition: a dialled telephone number that does not reach the person or service intended

examples.en: I realised I had the wrong number when a shop answered instead of the desk.
examples.zh: 接电话的是一家商店，我才发现「电话打错了」。

examples.en: The receptionist told me I'd dialled the wrong number for the campus safety office.
examples.zh: 接待员告诉我，联系校园安全办公室的「电话打错了」。

words.enDefinition: A UK weather alert typically indicating possible disruptions or impacts

examples.en: The UK map showed a yellow weather warning over our county.
examples.zh: 英国的地图显示我们这个郡有一条「黄色天气警告」。

examples.en: I checked the text of the yellow weather warning before reading the route notices.
examples.zh: 我先看了「黄色天气警告」的内容，再看线路通知。

collocations: a yellow weather warning for rain
